local local_class = newclass('QueenShipPikachuController')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName =  queenship_pikachu @
		Comment = 메인 6스테이지 저작권 연구소 서브 이벤트 @
]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	-- 캐릭터

	-- 오브젝트
	self.get_magnet = function()
		return get_field_object('pikachu_magnet')
	end

	self.get_metal_push_block = function(i)
		return get_field_object('pikachu_metal_push_block_' .. i)
	end


	self.get_gimmick_reset_zone_1 = 'pikachu_gimmick_reset_zone_1'
	self.get_gimmick_reset_zone_2 = 'pikachu_gimmick_reset_zone_2'


end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if quest_util.is_available_section(self.current_section) then
		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

-- pre story section 설정
function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

-- main section 설정
function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section1')
	}
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.get_gimmick_reset_zone_1 or
				e.Zone.Name == self.get_gimmick_reset_zone_2 then
			-- 자석 리셋
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_magnet()) then
				self.reset_target_gimmick(self, self.get_magnet())
			else
				-- 금속 철제 블록 리셋
				for num = 1, 3 do
					local metal_push_block = self.get_metal_push_block(num)
					if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, metal_push_block) then
						self.reset_target_gimmick(self, metal_push_block)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		field_object_util.set_active_state(get_field_object('pikachu_mouse_tesla'), active_state_type.disabled)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(get_field_object('pikachu_mouse_tesla_2'), active_state_type.disabled)
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:reset_target_gimmick(target)
	message_system:SendSync(target, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
end


return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipPikachuSection1')
--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = queenship_pikachu @
		Comment = 메인 6스테이지 저작권 연구소 서브 이벤트 섹션 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 존 이름
	self.get_enter_zone = 'pikachu_enter_zone'
	self.get_gimmick_reset_zone_1 = 'pikachu_gimmick_reset_zone_1'
	self.get_gimmick_reset_zone_2 = 'pikachu_gimmick_reset_zone_2'

	-- 마커
	self.get_mouse_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker('pikachu_mouse_pos')
	end

	self.get_magnet_reset_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker('pikachu_magnet_reset_pos')
	end

	self.get_metal_push_block_rest_pos = function(i)
		return field:GetMarker('pikachu_metal_push_block_reset_pos_' .. i)
	end

	-- 케릭터
	self.get_invader_scientist = function(i)
		return get_character('pikachu_invader_scientist_' .. i)
	end

	-- 1 = 일반쥐, 2 = 전기쥐
	self.get_mouse = function(i)
		return get_character('pikachu_mouse_' .. i)
	end

	--오브젝트
	--투명 벽.
	self.get_mouse_tesla = function()
		return get_field_object('pikachu_mouse_tesla')
	end

	self.get_mouse_tesla_2 = function()
		return get_field_object('pikachu_mouse_tesla_2')
	end

	self.get_magnet = function()
		return get_field_object('pikachu_magnet')
	end

	self.get_metal_push_block = function(i)
		return get_field_object('pikachu_metal_push_block_' .. i)
	end

	self.get_power_source = function()
		return get_field_object('pikachu_power_source')
	end

	self.get_power_source_2 = function()
		return get_field_object('pikachu_power_source_2')
	end

	-- 스타피스

	-- 스타피스 이펙트
	self.star_piece_effect = nil

	-- Timeline Director
	self.director_name = 'qs_pikachu_s1'

	-- 오브젝트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece_effect_pool = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character')
	end

	--존 입장 이벤트 봤는지
	self.is_enter_enter_zone = false
	self.is_mouse_tesla_on = false

	--자성 비헤비이어 저장해 놓기 위함
	self.magnet_magnetizable_org = nil

	-- eat 애니메이션 루핑 사운드
	self.equipping_loop_sound = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_star_piece_effect_pool()
	timeline_util.load_playable('qs_pikachu_s1_1')
	timeline_util.load_playable('qs_pikachu_s1_2')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent), 'on_tesla_coil_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	local mouse_pos = self.get_mouse_pos()
	self.star_piece_effect = self.get_star_piece_effect_pool():Instantiate(mouse_pos.position)

	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_power_source_2(), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_mouse_tesla_2(), 'disabled')

	timeline_table.register_action('play_equipping_sound', self.play_equipping_sound, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('dispose_equipping_sfx', self.stop_equipping_sound, self)
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 연구원에게 eat 효과음 재생되도록
	self:play_equipping_sound()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	timeline_table.unregister_action('play_equipping_sound')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('dispose_equipping_sfx')

	if self.star_piece_effect then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		-- 존 엔터 이벤트 연출
		if e.Zone.Name == self.get_enter_zone and
				self.is_enter_enter_zone == false then
			self.is_enter_enter_zone = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_enter_zone, self))
		end

	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'remove_starpiece_effect' then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.remove_starpiece_effect, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_tesla_coil_on_off_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.CoilObject, self.get_mouse_tesla()) and
			e.IsTurningOn == true and
			self.is_mouse_tesla_on == false then

		self.is_enter_enter_zone = true
		self.is_mouse_tesla_on = true

		-- 자석메뉴얼 조작(강제적으로 켜지고 꺼지는 상태)으로 비활성화
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MagnetManualOnOffEvent.Create(self.get_magnet(), magnet_manual_active_state['force_deactivated']))

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.charge_mouse, self)
	end

	return false
end


--endregion

function local_class:enter_enter_zone()
	--인베이더 과학자1(left, idle) : 흐흐흐…
	--인베이더 과학자1(left, bomb_idle) : 이번 생체 실험만 성공하면 우리 인베이더군의 전력이 한층 더 강해지겠지.
	--인베이더 과학자2(right, victory_get) : 우린 특진에 인센티브도 엄청 받을거야!
	--이후, side(각각 left/right), eat.
	timeline_util.play_async(self.director_name, 'qs_pikachu_s1_1')
end

function local_class:charge_mouse()
	--인베이더 과학자1이 전기쥐의 오른쪽으로 가 left, cross_arm question 이모티콘
	--전기쥐는 인베이더 과학자1을 바라본다.(right)
	--인베이더 과학자1이 이번에는 전기쥐의 왼쪽으로 가 right, cross_arm question 이모티콘
	--전기쥐는 인베이더 과학자1을 바라본다. (left)
	--인베이더 과학자1 : 느낌표 이모티콘
	--인베이더 과학자1(right, bomb_idle) : 이건 피OO…드디어… 드디어 성공한건가!
	--인베이더 과학자2(left, bomb_idle) : 야! 조용히 해!우리의 역작! 전기쥐!
	--인베이더 과학자2(left, idle, cast) : 너 법원가고 싶어?오오, 이 완벽한 생물의 자태를 봐!
	--전기쥐(right, smile, idle) : 비카비카!
	--인베이더 과학자2(전기쥐에게 다가간 후, left, attack) : 이건 피OO이 아니라 전기쥐야! 전기쥐!울음소리마저 완벽해!
	--전기쥐 right
	--인베이더 과학자1(right, release) : 봐! 울음소리도 피OO이랑은 전혀 다를거라고!까먹지말고 전투 능력도 확인해야지!
	--인베이더 과학자2 left, idle, nod 2회.
	--인베이더 과학자2(left, attack, attack 1회 끝나면 idle) : 가라! 전기쥐!
	--전기쥐 jump 1회
	--전기쥐 아래로 1.5칸 걸어나온다.
	--카메라 아래로 이동하여 전기쥐와 테슬라코일 가운데 지점 포커스.
	--전기쥐(down, attack, cast) : 피…비카~
	--테슬라코일 이펙트가 전기쥐에게 발생.
	--전기쥐(down, mad, cast) : 쥬!
	--전기쥐의 몸에서 전기가 발사된다.
	--방 가운데 있는 테슬라 코일에 연결된다.
	--인베이더 과학자들 모두 down, surprise, idle
	--카메라 쉐이크
	--1초뒤 전기쥐의 몸에서도, 테슬라코일에도, 연결되었던 전기가 꺼진다. 그 후, 아래 대사 진행.
	--인베이더 과학자2(left, attack, attack 1회 끝나면 idle) : 돌아와! 전기쥐!
	--전기쥐 원래 자리로 되돌아간다. 이후, down, idle, idle.
	--인베이더 과학자1(right, mad, jump 2회) : (shout 말풍선, 위 대사와 겹치게 나오게 처리)멈춰!
	--인베이더 과학자1(right, mad, attack) : 더 이상 울면 안 돼!
	--인베이더 과학자2(left, attack, attack 1회) : 돌아와! 전기쥐!
	--인베이더 과학자1(right, scared, cast) : 누가 얘 울음소리를 듣기라도 하면…
	--인베이더 과학자2(left, scared, cast) : 우리는 고소당하고 말거야!
	--인베이더 과학자1, 2(idle, idle, shake 다음 말풍선까지 지속) : 이…
	--인베이더 과학자1, 2(서로바라보며, smile, victory_extra) : (shout말풍선)으아아아!이야! 성공이다아!
	--전기쥐도 smile로 제자리 jump 2회.
	--인베이더 과학자 1(right, smile, idle, jump1회) : 이 전기의 세기!
	--인베이더 과학자 1(right, smile, bomb_idle) : 거의 백만볼트는 되겠는데?
	--인베이더 과학자 2(left, smile, release) : 이럴 때가 아니야, 어서 보고하러 가자고!
	--인베이더 과학자 1(right, smile, victory_get 1회) : 기다려라! 승진!
	--victory_get 1회 끝나면 아래 대사 진행, 1회 끝나고도 자세 유지.
	--인베이더 과학자 2(left, smile, victory_get 1회) : 기다려라! 인센티브!
	--victory_get 1회 끝나면 아래 대사 진행, 1회 끝나고도 자세 유지.
	--인베이더 과학자 1, 2 : (shout말풍선)와하하하하하!!
	--위 대사와 동시에 인베이더 과학자2가 전기쥐를 들고, 인베이더 과학자 1, 2 둘다 왼쪽 격벽문을 열고 퇴장.
	--(좌측통로 바깥이 보이고 있어, 나가는 모습 끝까지 보여줘야 합니다. 퇴장속도 9)
	--카메라 포커스 왼쪽 격벽문까지 같이 이동.
	--문은 이후에도 열려있도록 설정.(재진입 했을 때도 열려 있음.)
	--이후 컨트롤 돌아오고, 스타피스 획득 가능.

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 2)
	timeline_util.play_async(self.director_name, 'qs_pikachu_s1_2')

	--퀘스트 완료
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

	-- 자석 메뉴얼 조작(강제적으로 켜지고 꺼지는 상태) 해제.
	-- 자석 홀더블은 들고 있지 않을 때 작동 하지 말아야 하므로, force_activated 가 아닌 none.
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MagnetManualOnOffEvent.Create(self.get_magnet(), magnet_manual_active_state['none']))

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 2)
end

--타임라인에서 호출되는 커스텀 이벤트
function local_class:remove_starpiece_effect()
	-- 스타피스 이펙트 제거
	if self.star_piece_effect then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end
end



function local_class:play_equipping_sound()
	self:stop_equipping_sound()

	local scientist = self.get_invader_scientist(1)
	self.equipping_loop_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true
	, parent = scientist })
end

function local_class:stop_equipping_sound()
	if self.equipping_loop_sound ~= nil then
		self.equipping_loop_sound:Stop()
		self.equipping_loop_sound = nil
	end
end

return local_class

-- 여러 섹션에서 공용으로 쓰이는 연출들
common_event_scene = {
	-- 화약통이 폭탄병 넉백하는 함수
	barrel_knock_back_plasma_bomber = function(self, damage_event)
		local target = damage_event.Info.target
		local sender = damage_event.Info.sender
		local plasma_bomber = get_character('plasma_bomber')
		local barrel_guardian_gimmick = self.duplicated_guardian_data[2].gimmick

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, plasma_bomber) and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(sender, barrel_guardian_gimmick) then
			local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_direction((target.Position - sender.Position)))
			local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
					'linear', true, dir, nil, nil,
					nil, true, nil, CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceTime,
					CS.Oak.Constants.WallBounceDistance)

			command_util.publish_knock_back(target.Owner, target, knock_back_info, target.Position)
		end
	end,

	-- 복제가디언 사용하는 스테이지 시작 연출 함수
	duplicated_guardian_entry_scene = function(self)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

		local pos = user_party.Leader.Position

		local n = user_party.Count - 6

		if n > 0 then
			pos = pos + vector(n * 0.65, 0, 0)
		end

		coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry(pos,
				user_party.Leader.Direction, game_string:GetString(stage.Name)))

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
		self.stage_enter_fade_in_complete = true
	end,

	-- 복제가디언 다리 건너기 이벤트 연출
	duplicated_guardian_bridge_scene = function(self)
		local cliff_wall = get_field_object('cliff_wall')

		-- 나레이션 : 혼자서는 건널 수 없는 넓은 절벽이 보인다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'qs_duplication_lab_bridge_1' })

		-- 나레이션 : 다리를 만드시겠습니까?
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = 'qs_duplication_lab_bridge_2' })

		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			-- 예
			{ 'qs_duplication_lab_bridge_3', 'mercy' },
			-- 아니오
			{ 'qs_duplication_lab_bridge_4', 'brutal' }
		})

		if choose_result == 2 then
			cliff_wall.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			return
		end

		local leader = user_party.Leader
		local pivot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(cliff_wall.Bounds.center) + vector(0, 0, -1)
		local guardians = {}
		local origin_sorting_orders = {}
		local layer_val = 100

		for i = 1, #self.guardians do
			if self:has_guardian(i) then
				local guardian = self.guardians[i]
				table.insert(guardians, guardian)

				local origin_layer = guardian.SpineController:GetLayerName()
				local origin_order = guardian.SpineController.SortingGroup.sortingOrder
				table.insert(origin_sorting_orders, {
					origin_layer = origin_layer,
					origin_order = origin_order
				})

				guardian.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', layer_val)
				layer_val = layer_val + 1
			end
		end

		leader.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', layer_val + 1)

		local align_routines = {}
		local leader_align_pos = pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0)
		table.insert(align_routines, util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, user_party.Leader, leader_align_pos, 4,  nil, { last_direction = 'right' }))

		for i = 1, #guardians do
			local target_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, (i - 1) * -0.65)
			table.insert(align_routines, util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, guardians[i], target_pos, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'up'}))
		end

		wait_all(align_routines)

		--복제 가디언 절벽 이동 연출
		local move_dis = 0.65
		local jump_dur = 0.5
		local start_pos = guardians[1].Position
		local target_pos = start_pos
		local end_cnt = 0
		local wps = {}

		for _ = 1, #guardians do
			local move_to = target_pos
			local jump_to = target_pos + vector(0, 0, move_dis)

			table.insert(wps, {
				move_to = move_to,
				jump_to = jump_to
			})

			target_pos = jump_to
		end

		camera_util.move_async(start_pos + vector(0, 0, 4), 1)

		--남은 복제 가디언이 없을 때까지 위의 복제 가디언 절벽 이동 연출 실행
		for i = 1, #guardians do
			local guardian = guardians[i]

			start_coroutine(function()
				--다음 복제 가디언은 이전에 설치된 복제 가디언 위치까지는 속도 1로 걸어감, 이후 위의 복제 가디언 절벽 이동 연출 실행
				character_util.move_to_async(guardian, wps[i].move_to, nil,  1, false, true)

				--복제 가디언 위에 다른 복제 가디언이 올라가면 복제 가디언 0.02 shake (다리 무너질 때까지 지속)
				if i > 1 then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
					scene_util.shake(guardians[i - 1], 0.02, 9999)
				end

				scene_util.set_direction(guardian, 'up')
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(guardian, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(guardian, 'cast2')

				--맨 앞의 복제 가디언이 아래 보고 방향 고정한 상태에서 절벽으로 0.5초간 0.5칸 걸어감
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
				target_pos = target_pos + vector(0, 0, move_dis)
				character_util.jump(guardian, 1, jump_dur)
				character_util.move_to_async(guardian, wps[i].jump_to, jump_dur, nil, true, false)
				end_cnt = end_cnt + 1
			end)
		end

		while end_cnt < #guardians do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		--가디언이 복제 가디언 다리를 밟고 속도 2로 걸어서 절벽 너머로 이동
		local speed = 1.25
		character_util.move_to_async(leader, start_pos, nil, speed5, true, true)

		local leader_move_dis = move_dis * 0.5
		for i = 1, #guardians do
			character_util.move_distance_async(leader, vector(0, 0, leader_move_dis),
					nil, speed, true, true)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bomb_holdup_fail_01')
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(guardians[i])
			character_util.move_distance_async(leader, vector(0, 0, leader_move_dis),
					nil, speed, true, true)
		end

		character_util.move_distance_async(leader, vector(0, 0, 0.15),
				nil, 2, true, true)

		--복제 가디언 수가 7명일 경우 다리 만들기 성공
		--떨어지는 연출
		local is_success = #guardians == 7
		local falling_routines = {}
		local falling_routine = function(character, dir, in_d)
			in_d = lua_helper.get_or_default(in_d, 0)
			-- 회전
			character_util.spine_rotate(character, 1440, 4)

			-- 자유 낙하
			local falling_start_pos = character.Position
			local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall()
			local cur_scale = 1

			free_fall:SetParameters(in_d, 10, character.Position.y, 0)

			while not free_fall:IsDone() do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
				local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
				free_fall:Proceed(dt)

				local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()
				local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(character.Position, dist_y)
				local cur_progress = free_fall:GetProgress()
				local scale_change_size = dt * 0.33

				cur_scale = cur_scale - scale_change_size

				if dir ~= nil then
					local moved_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(falling_start_pos, falling_start_pos + dir, cur_progress)
					cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(moved_pos, dist_y)
				end

				character.Position = cur_pos
				character_util.set_scale_factor(character, 'falling_size', cur_scale)
			end

			-- 스케일 줄이면서 떨어지는 것 처럼 보이게 한다.
			local time_passed = 0
			local dur = 1

			while time_passed <= dur do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(interpolations_constants.ease_out_quad(time_passed, 0, 1, dur))
				local scale = 1 - progress

				if scale < 0 then
					break
				end

				character_util.set_scale_factor(character, 'falling_size', scale)
			end
		end

		-- 가디언들 원상복구 하는 함수
		local guardians_reset = function()
			for i = 1, #guardians do
				local guardian = guardians[i]
				local origin_emo = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i].origin_emo
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(guardian, origin_emo)
				character_util.remove_anim(guardian)
				character_util.stop_shake(guardian)
				character_util.spine_rotate(guardian, 0, 0)
				character_util.remove_scale_factor(guardian, 'falling_size')

				local origin_layer = origin_sorting_orders[i].origin_layer
				local origin_order = origin_sorting_orders[i].origin_order
				guardian.SpineController:SetSortingLayer(origin_layer, origin_order)
			end
		end

		local make_guardians_falling = function(leader_falling)
			-- 복제가디언들 떨어지기 전에 쉐이크 1초
			for i = 1, #guardians do
				local guardian = guardians[i]
				character_util.stop_shake(guardian)
				scene_util.shake(guardian, 0.04, 1)
			end
			wait_for_sec(1)

			local z_dis = { 0.9, 0.6, 0.3, 0, -0.3, -0.6, -0.9 }

			if leader_falling then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
				character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'embarrassed')
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'damaged')

				table.insert(falling_routines, util.cs_generator(falling_routine, leader, vector(0, 0, z_dis[#guardians] + 0.3), 0.5))
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			for i = 1, #guardians do
				local guardian = guardians[i]
				character_util.spine_rotate(guardian, 0, 0)
				character_util.set_direction(guardian, 'down')
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(guardian, 'embarrassed')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

				table.insert(falling_routines, util.cs_generator(falling_routine, guardian, vector(0, 0, z_dis[i]), 0.5))
			end

			wait_all(falling_routines)
		end

		if is_success then
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
			character_util.move_distance_async(leader, vector(0, 0, 1.5), nil, 2, true, true)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(leader, 'victory_get')
			wait_for_sec(1)

			make_guardians_falling()
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

			guardians_reset()
			self:teleport_guardians_to_party_pos(true)
		else
			-- 실패했으면 리더도 떨어진다.
			make_guardians_falling(true)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			guardians_reset()

			-- 리더 떨어진 후 리셋
			character_util.remove_scale_factor(leader, 'falling_size')
			character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 0, 0)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

			leader.Position = start_pos
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
			self:teleport_guardians_to_party_pos()

			camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

			wait_for_sec(1)
			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end

		cliff_wall.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end,

	-- 가드, CCTV에 걸렸을 때 이벤트 연출
	on_detect = function(self, e)
		local event_name = e:GetParamAt(0)
		local detector_name = e:GetParamAt(1)
		local detector = get_character(detector_name)
		local leader = user_party.Leader

		self.is_detected = true

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_siren_oneshot_01')
		start_coroutine(function()
			local siren_tint_key = 'siren_tint'

			local tint_duration = 0.5
			local current_time = unity_class.time.time
			local is_tint = false

			self.stop_siren = false

			while not self.stop_siren do
				if unity_class.time.time - current_time > tint_duration then
					current_time = unity_class.time.time

					if is_tint then
						is_tint = false

						field:RemoveTint(siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
					else
						is_tint = true

						field:Tint(siren_tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)
					end
				end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if is_tint then
				field:RemoveTint(siren_tint_key, 0)
			end
		end)

		character_util.look_at(leader, detector)

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			user_party[i].Direction = leader.Direction
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })
		party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed' })
		party_util.jump(1, 0.5)

		if event_name == 'guard_detect' then
			character_util.normal_jump(detector)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			-- 누구냐!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(detector, 'qs_duplication_lab_s3_1')
		else
			-- 침입자 발견!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(detector, 'qs_duplication_lab_s3_2')
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		self.stop_siren = true

		-- 파티 리셋 세팅
		party_util.remove_animation()
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
		self:reset_duplicated_guardians_emotion()

		local reset_marker = field:GetMarker(self.detector_marker_data[detector_name])

		leader.Position = reset_marker.position
		leader.Direction = reset_marker.direction

		if self.duplicated_guardians_gimmick_on then
			self.duplicated_guardians_gimmick_on = false
			self.button:SetIcon('actbtn_ic_ar_change.png')
			self:gimmick_mode_off()
		end

		self:teleport_guardians_to_party_pos()

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		self.is_detected = false
	end
}

return {
	create = function()
		return common_event_scene
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipDuplicationLabController')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = QueenShipDuplicationLab @
		Comment = QueenShipDuplicationLab 퀘스트/이벤트 @
]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	-- 버튼
	self.button = nil

	-- 버튼이 켜진 상태인지
	self.button_active = true

	-- 던져지는 것 상태
	self.thrown_state = {
		none = 0,
		held = 1,
		thrown = 2,
		thrown_end_reserve = 3
	}

	-- 점프 상태
	self.jump_state = {
		not_jumping = 0,
		jump_start = 1,
		jumping = 2,
		jump_end = 3
	}
	-- 리더의 점프 상태
	self.leader_jump_state = self.jump_state.not_jumping

	-- 점프 스테이트가 끝난 후에 점프 끝난 것으로 간주하는 것에 대한 대기 시간
	self.jump_end_delay_time_by_jump_type = 0
	self.cur_jump_end_delay_time = 0

	-- 복제 가디언이 기믹화 상태인지
	self.duplicated_guardians_gimmick_on = false

	-- 복제 가디언 데이터 테이블
	self.duplicated_guardian_data = {}

	-- 가디언만 따로 캐싱
	self.guardians = {}

	self.game_ended = false
	self.guardians_disabled = false

	-- LuaICombustibleBehaviour 클래스
	self.bust_cs = nil

	-- 버튼 조작이 가능한 상태인지
	-- 유지보수를 위해 update_button_active_state() 에서만 can_touch_button 값 바꿔 주도록
	self.can_touch_button = true
	self.reserve_button_enable = false

	self.gimmick_enum = {
		cute_useless_guardian = 1,
		barrel = 2,
		brazier = 3,
		tesla = 4,
		s_magnet = 5,
		n_magnet = 6,
		hookshot = 7
	}

	self.duplicated_guardian_stage = 'queenship_substage_duplication_lab'

	self.dp_guardian_get_custom_key = 'duplicated_guardian_get_data'

	-- 복제가디언 획득 상태
	self.cur_dp_guardian_get_progress = 0

	-- 리셋 이펙트
	self.reset_effect = 'FX_reset_object'

	-- 스테이지 입장 시 페이드 인 연출 끝난 후 부터 버튼 조작 가능하도록 한다.
	self.stage_enter_fade_in_complete = false

	self.detector_marker_data = {
		guard_1 = 'detect_reset_a',
		guard_2 = 'detect_reset_a',
		guard_3 = 'detect_reset_a',
		cctv_1 = 'detect_reset_b',
		cctv_2 = 'detect_reset_f',
		cctv_3 = 'detect_reset_c',
		cctv_4 = 'detect_reset_d'
	}

	-- 사이렌을 멈출 것인지
	self.stop_siren = false

	-- 감지 되었는지
	self.is_detected = false

	-- 스테이지 입장 시 그레이드
	self.starting_grade = nil

	-- 여러 섹션어서 쓰이는 공용 연출
	self.common_event_scene = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FallInHoleStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FallInHoleEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	for i = 1, #self.duplicated_guardian_data do
		local guardian = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i].guardian
		character_util.remove_relate_event(guardian, self)

		timeline_util.clear_all_character_key('duplicated_guardian_' .. i)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.duplicated_guardian_data do
		local gimmick_emoticon = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i].gimmick_emoticon_data.emoticon
		if gimmick_emoticon ~= nil then
			gimmick_emoticon:Dispose()
			gimmick_emoticon = nil
		end
	end

	self.game_ended = true

	self.bust_cs = nil
	self.button = nil
	self.gimmick_enum = nil
	self.duplicated_guardian_data = nil
	self.guardians = nil
	self.common_event_scene = nil

	if quest_util.is_available_section(self.current_section) then
		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	if stage.Name == self.duplicated_guardian_stage then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_fo_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent), 'on_brazier_on_off_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_throw_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FallInHoleStartEvent), 'on_fall_in_hole_start_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FallInHoleEndEvent), 'on_fall_in_hole_end_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	end

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

-- pre story section 설정
function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'PreSection')
end

-- main section 설정
function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section2'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section3')
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'PostSection')
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.reset_effect)
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
			self:on_stage_start_event(e)
		end
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	self.common_event_scene = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/QueenShip/QueenShipDuplicationLab/CommonEventScene')

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if stage.Name == self.duplicated_guardian_stage then
			self:set_duplicated_guardians()
		end

		self.starting_grade = self.quest_progress.Grade
	else
		self.starting_grade = -1
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(_)
	if stage.Name == self.duplicated_guardian_stage then
			self.cur_dp_guardian_get_progress = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.dp_guardian_get_custom_key)

		if self.cur_dp_guardian_get_progress == -1 then
			self.cur_dp_guardian_get_progress = 0
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.can_touch_button then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.CustomFunction1TouchDown and self.button_active then
		return self:button_pressed()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if not self.can_touch_button then
		return false
	end

	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightTriggerDown and
			self.button_active then
		return self:button_pressed()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	if not self.duplicated_guardians_gimmick_on then
		return false
	end

	-- gimmick_fo를 사용하는 복제 가디언이라면 gimmick_fo 가 움직이면 위치 업데이트 한다.
	for i = 1, #self.duplicated_guardian_data do
		if self:has_guardian(i) then
			local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i]
			local guardian = data.guardian
			local gimmick = data.gimmick
			local moving_obj = data.moving_obj

			-- 캐릭터 자체가 움직이면 패스
			if gimmick ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, moving_obj) then
				-- 움직이는 대상이 기믹이 아니라면 기믹의 위치 갱신
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(gimmick, moving_obj) then
					gimmick.Position = moving_obj.Position
				end

				guardian.Position = gimmick.Position
			end
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_brazier_on_off_event(e)
	local brazier_data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[self.gimmick_enum.brazier]

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.BrazierObject, brazier_data.gimmick) then
		brazier_data.thrown_data.can_change_anim = not e.IsTurningOn

		if e.IsTurningOn then
			scene_util.set_embarrassed_anim(brazier_data.guardian)
		else
			character_util.remove_anim(brazier_data.guardian)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.duplicated_guardian_data do
		if self:has_guardian(i) then
			local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i]
			data.thrown_data.state = self.thrown_state.held

			-- 들린 상태에서 훅샷 사용 못하도록 막기
			if i == self.gimmick_enum.hookshot then
				local character_hookshot_fo = get_field_object('character_hookshot_fo')
				character_hookshot_fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				character_hookshot_fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7))
			end

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(data.moving_obj, e.Target) then
				scene_util.set_embarrassed_anim(data.guardian)
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(data.guardian, 'damaged')
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.duplicated_guardian_data do
		if self:has_guardian(i) then
			local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i]
			local thrown_data = data.thrown_data

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(data.moving_obj, e.Target) then
				local leader_dir = user_party.Leader.Direction
				data.guardian.Direction = direction_util.to_side_dir(leader_dir)

				if thrown_data.can_change_anim then
					character_util.set_anim(data.guardian, { name = 'prostrate' })
				end

				-- 던저진 상태로 변경
				thrown_data.state = self.thrown_state.thrown
				thrown_data.thrown_dir = leader_dir
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_fall_in_hole_start_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.duplicated_guardian_data do
		if self:has_guardian(i) then
			local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i]

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, data.moving_obj) then
				data.thrown_data.falling_in_hole = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_fall_in_hole_end_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.duplicated_guardian_data do
		if self:has_guardian(i) then
			local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i]

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, data.moving_obj) then
				self.duplicated_guardian_data[i].thrown_data.falling_in_hole = false

				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(data.moving_obj, data.guardian) then
					data.guardian.Transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local detector = e:GetParamAt(1)

	if self.detector_marker_data[detector] ~= nil and not self.is_detected then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.common_event_scene.on_detect, self, e)
	end
end
--endregion

--region 캐릭터 따라오는 상태
-- 따라오는 캐릭터 관리
function local_class:gimmick_mode_off()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	-- 화로 가디언에 불 붙었으면 꺼준다.
	if self:has_guardian(self.gimmick_enum.brazier) then
		local brazier_data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[self.gimmick_enum.brazier]
		self.bust_cs:GetExtinguishedBy(brazier_data.gimmick, nil)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.duplicated_guardian_data do
		if self:has_guardian(i) then
			local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i]
			local guardian = data.guardian
			local moving_obj = data.moving_obj
			local gimmick = data.gimmick
			local thrown_data = data.thrown_data

			character_util.remove_anim(guardian)

			-- 던저진 상태 초기화
			thrown_data.state = self.thrown_state.none

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(moving_obj, guardian) then
				-- 캐릭터가 움직이는 기믹이라면 Holdable 상태 해제
				guardian.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable()
			else
				character_util.set_active_state(guardian, 'enabled')
			end

			-- 파티 따라오도록
			character_util.convert_to_following_npc(guardian, user_party,
					false, CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)

			if lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) and
					lua_helper.reference_equals(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget, moving_obj) then
				-- 플레이어가 기믹 들고있다면 내려놓는다.
				character_util.release_hold_object(leader, moving_obj)

				-- 기믹에 붙어있는 캐릭터의 y 위치를 리더랑 동일하게 만든다.
				guardian.Position = vector(moving_obj.Position.x, leader.Position.y, moving_obj.Position.z)
			end

			-- 움직이던 대상이 캐릭터가 아닌 경우
			if gimmick ~= nil then
				-- FieldObjectIdleState 바꿔서 위치 이동후 리셋 함수 타지 않도록 한다.
				message_system:SendSync(moving_obj, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance))

				-- 움직이는 대상이 기믹이 아닌 경우
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(gimmick, moving_obj) then
					moving_obj.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				end

				gimmick.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			end

			-- 자석에 영향을 받고 있는 경우 처리
			if moving_obj.Magnetizable.IsAffectingByMagnet then
				moving_obj.Magnetizable:OnReset()
			end

			-- 역할 이모티콘 제거
			self:hide_emoticon(i)
		end
	end

	local play_fx = self.stage_enter_fade_in_complete
	self:teleport_guardians_to_party_pos(play_fx)
end
--endregion

-- [GT-7866] holdable 들고있으면 떨어트림
function local_class:release_holdable()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(
			leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) then

		character_util.release_hold_object(leader, leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget)
	end
end

--region 캐릭터 기믹화 상태
-- 기믹 모드 활성화
function local_class:gimmick_mode_on()
	self:release_holdable()

	for i = 1, #self.duplicated_guardian_data do
		if self:has_guardian(i) then
			local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i]
			local guardian = data.guardian
			local moving_obj = data.moving_obj
			local gimmick = data.gimmick

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(moving_obj, guardian) then
				-- 캐릭터가 움직이는 물체면 들릴 수 있어야 한다.
				guardian.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
				character_util.set_active_state(guardian, 'enabled')
			else
				-- 캐릭터가 실제로 움직이지 않는다면 보이도록만 하고, 다른 기능은 끈다.
				character_util.set_active_state(guardian, 'visible')
			end

			moving_obj.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '01_land_01'

			character_util.convert_to_npc(guardian)

			-- 움직이던 대상이 캐릭터가 아닌 경우
			if gimmick ~= nil then
				-- 움직이는 대상이 기믹이 아닌 경우
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(gimmick, moving_obj) then
					moving_obj.Position = guardian.Position
				end

				-- FIXME: 기믹의 Holder가 남아 있는 경우가 있다.(Barrel)
				-- 임시조치이니 원인 찾아서 고쳐야함
				character_util.clear_holdup_state(get_party_leader(), gimmick)

				gimmick.Position = guardian.Position
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(guardian, moving_obj) then
				-- 캐릭터가 움직이는 경우 캐릭터 아날로그스테이트로 변경
				local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Create(guardian)
				message_system:SendSync(guardian, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
			end

			-- 역할 이모티콘 표시
			self:show_or_create_emoticon(i)
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--region 복제 가디언 관련 시작 세팅 관련 함수
function local_class:set_duplicated_guardians()
	local duplicated_guardian_colors = {
		-- 어둡게
		unity_color({ 0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 1 }),
		-- 노란색
		unity_color({ 1, 1, 0, 1 }),
		-- 주황색
		unity_color({ 1, 0.5, 0, 1 }),
		-- 초록색
		unity_color({ 0, 1, 0, 1 }),
		-- 파란색
		unity_color({ 0, 0, 1, 1 }),
		-- 빨간색
		unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 1 }),
		-- 보라색
		unity_color({ 1, 0, 1, 1 })
	}

	-- 복제 가디언의 기믹들 이름
	local gimmick_names = {
		'character_fo',
		'character_barrel_fo',
		'character_brazier_fo',
		'character_tesla_rod_fo',
		'character_s_magnet',
		'character_n_magnet',
		'character_hookshot_fo'
	}

	-- 연출 없을 때 기본으로 짓는 표정들
	local origin_emos = {
		'smile',
		'mad',
		'attack',
		'damaged',
		'doyagao',
		'tired',
		'sleep_deep'
	}

	-- 기믹 상태일 때 이모티콘에 표시되는 이미지 이름
	local gimmick_emoticon_sprite_names = {
		'merch_zaco_figure',
		'explosive_barrell',
		'portable_brazier',
		'tesla_coil_block',
		'magnet_holdable_s',
		'magnet_holdable_n',
		'hookshot_pillar'
	}

	-- 기믹 상태일 때 이모티콘 그림 p2w 사이즈
	local gimmick_emoticon_sprite_size = {
		0.0115, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 0.02
	}

	if stage.Name == 'queenship_substage_duplication_lab' then
		for i = 1, 7 do
			-- 캐릭터 얻기
			local prefix_name = user_util.has_knight_male() and 'male_' or 'female_'
			local name = prefix_name .. 'duplicated_guardian_' .. i
			local guardian = get_character(name)
			local color = duplicated_guardian_colors[i]

			-- 기믹 얻기
			local gimmick_name = gimmick_names[i]
			local gimmick = get_field_object(gimmick_name)

			-- 기믹의 히트박스 크기 통일
			if gimmick ~= nil then
				local hitbox_size = guardian.Hitbox.size * 0.75
				gimmick.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(hitbox_size)
			end

			-- 캐릭터 초기 설정
			character_util.set_active_state(guardian, 'enabled')
			character_util.add_color(guardian, guardian.Name, color, 0.5, 0)
			guardian.SpineController:AddFadeColor(guardian.Name, color, 0.3, 0)

			-- 복제가디언 죽지 않도록 무적 처리
			if guardian.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
				guardian.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
						stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
			end

			-- 리더가 들때 들리는 대상 (캐릭터 or 기믹)
			-- 사용하는 기믹이 없다면 캐릭터 자식이 들릴 것임
			local moving_obj = gimmick == nil and guardian or gimmick

			local data = {
				-- 자기 자신
				guardian = guardian,
				-- 연결된 기믹
				gimmick = gimmick,
				-- 실제 움직이는 대상 (들리는 등의 이유로)
				moving_obj = moving_obj,
				-- 기본 표정
				origin_emo = origin_emos[i],
				-- 색
				color = color,

				-- 기믹 상태에 사용할 이모티콘 관련 데이터
				gimmick_emoticon_data = {
					-- 표시할 이미지 이름
					sprite_name = gimmick_emoticon_sprite_names[i],
					-- 표시할 이미지 사이즈
					sprite_size = gimmick_emoticon_sprite_size[i],
					-- 이모티콘
					emoticon = nil,
				},

				-- 들리는 것 관련 데이터
				thrown_data = {
					state = self.thrown_state.none,
					-- 방향
					thrown_dir = nil,
					-- 던저지는 중 애니메이션 바꿀 수 있는지 (예: 불타고 있다면 바꾸면 안되는 경우 대응)
					can_change_anim = true,
					-- 홀에 떨어지고 있는지
					falling_in_hole = false
				},

				-- 점프 관련 데이트
				jump_data = {
					-- 점프 했는지
					jumped = false,
					--
					jump_end_next_frame = false
				}
			}

			table.insert(self.duplicated_guardian_data, data)
			table.insert(self.guardians, guardian)

			-- 타임라인에서 찾을 수 있도록 키 등록
			timeline_util.set_character_key('duplicated_guardian_' .. i, name)
		end
	end

	-- 별도로 세팅이 필요한 기믹들
	self:set_character_brazier_fo()
	self:set_character_tesla_rod_fo()
	self:set_character_hookshot_fo()
end

function local_class:start_duplicated_guardians()
	for i = 1, #self.guardians do
		local guardian = self.guardians[i]

		if self:has_guardian(i) then
			self:add_guardian(i)
		else
			--획득하지 못한 복제가디언 맵에 배치 및 기본 세팅
			local marker = field:GetMarker('duplicated_guardian_start_pos_' .. i)
			local start_anim_emo_data = {
				{ anim = 'idle', emo = 'smile', },
				{ anim = 'cast', emo = 'tired', },
				{ anim = 'sleep', emo = 'sleep', },
				{ anim = 'cast', emo = 'tired', },
				{ anim = 'cast', emo = 'tired', },
				{ anim = 'cast', emo = 'tired', },
				{ anim = 'cast', emo = 'tired', }
			}

			scene_util.set_anim_loop(guardian, start_anim_emo_data[i].anim)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(guardian, start_anim_emo_data[i].emo)
			character_util.set_active_state(guardian, 'enabled')
			character_util.add_listener(guardian, self)
			guardian.Direction = marker.direction
			guardian.Position = marker.position
		end
	end

	-- 버튼 생성
	self:create_button()

	self.duplicated_guardians_gimmick_on = false
	self:gimmick_mode_off()

	-- 이모티콘 미리 생성
	for i = 1, #self.guardians do
		self:show_or_create_emoticon(i)
		self:hide_emoticon(i)
	end

	-- 업데이트 코루틴 시작
	start_coroutine(self.update_coroutine, self)
end
--endregion

--region 버튼 관련
-- 버튼 생성 및 초기 설정
function local_class:create_button()
	local ui_type = CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomButton1

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader,ui_type)

	self.button = field_ui_manager:GetUI(user_party.Leader)[ui_type]
	self.button:SetIcon('actbtn_ic_ar_change.png')

	self:set_button_active_state(true)
end

-- 버튼 활성화 상태 변경
function local_class:set_button_active_state(active)
	if active then
		-- 버튼 킴
		self.button_active = true
		field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomButton1, user_party.Leader)
	else
		-- 버튼 끔
		self.button_active = false
		field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomButton1, user_party.Leader)
	end
end

-- 버튼 눌렸을 떄
function local_class:button_pressed()
	-- 맵에 전투 있으면 추가 처리 필요

	-- 배틀 액션이 실행중이면 버튼 작동하지 않도록 함
	for _, action in pairs(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions) do
		if action.IsActive then
			return true
		end
	end

	self.duplicated_guardians_gimmick_on = not self.duplicated_guardians_gimmick_on
	self.button:SetIcon('actbtn_ic_ar_change.png')

	-- 새로운 상태에 맞게 복제 가디언들 설정
	if self.duplicated_guardians_gimmick_on then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_party_add_01')
		self:gimmick_mode_on()
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
		self:gimmick_mode_off()
	end
end
--endregion

-- 업데이트 처럼 프레임 마다 체크 해야하는 로직들
function local_class:update_coroutine()
	while true do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		if self.game_ended or self.guardians_disabled then
			break
		end

		-- 리더 관련 예외처리 업데이트
		self:update_leader_jump_state()

		-- 복제가디언 관련 예외처리 업데이트
		for i = 1, #self.duplicated_guardian_data do
			if self:has_guardian(i) then
				if self.duplicated_guardians_gimmick_on then
					-- 복제 가디언 던져지는 상태 관련 처리
					self:update_duplicated_guardian_thrown_state(i)
					-- 복제 가디언 역할 표시 이모티콘 처리
					self:update_duplicated_guardian_emoticon(i)
					-- 이상한 위치 픽서
					self:fix_wrong_party_position(i)
				else
					-- 표정 풀리는 경우 디폴트 표정으로 다시 세팅
					self:set_duplicated_guardian_default_emotion_after_jump(i)
					-- 이상한 위치 픽서
					self:fix_wrong_gimmick_position(i)
				end
			end
		end

		-- 버튼 상태 체크
		self:update_button_active_state()
	end
end

--- 리더 관련 예외처리 업데이트
function local_class:update_leader_jump_state()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if self.leader_jump_state == self.jump_state.jump_start then
		-- 점프 시작 1 프레임 후 점핑 상태로 변경
		self.leader_jump_state = self.jump_state.jumping
	elseif self.leader_jump_state == self.jump_state.jump_end then
		-- 점프 종료 1 프레임 후 점프 상태 해제
		self.leader_jump_state = self.jump_state.not_jumping
	end

	if leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying then
		if self.leader_jump_state == self.jump_state.not_jumping then
			self.leader_jump_state = self.jump_state.jump_start

			-- 점프 타입에 맞춰 점프 스테이트 끝난 이후에 점프 끝난 것으로 간주하는 시간 값 설정
			if leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState.JumpType == CS.Oak.JumpType.JumpExitTileJump then
				self.jump_end_delay_time_by_jump_type = 1
			else
				self.jump_end_delay_time_by_jump_type = 0
			end

			self.cur_jump_end_delay_time = 0

			-- 플레이어가 점프 타일로 올라갈 때 HoleCrashBehaviour라도 정상적으로 이동 가능하도록 트윅
			leader.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0
		end
	else
		if self.leader_jump_state == self.jump_state.jumping then
			self.cur_jump_end_delay_time = self.cur_jump_end_delay_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if self.cur_jump_end_delay_time > self.jump_end_delay_time_by_jump_type then
				self.leader_jump_state = self.jump_state.jump_end

				leader.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player0
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 복제 가디언 던져지는 상태 관련 처리
function local_class:update_duplicated_guardian_thrown_state(guardian_num)
	local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[guardian_num]
	local guardian = data.guardian
	local gimmick = data.gimmick
	local moving_obj = data.moving_obj
	local thrown_data = data.thrown_data
	local is_gimmick_moving = lua_helper.reference_equals(gimmick, moving_obj)

	if thrown_data.state == self.thrown_state.thrown then
		if moving_obj.Position.y - stage_util.get_height(moving_obj.Position) <= 0.001 then
			-- 점프를 바로 끝내지 않고 예약만 하여 다음 프레임에 구멍에 떨어질 수 있게 한다.
			thrown_data.state = self.thrown_state.thrown_end_reserve
		end
	elseif thrown_data.state == self.thrown_state.thrown_end_reserve then
		thrown_data.state = self.thrown_state.none

		moving_obj.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(moving_obj.Position, stage_util.get_height(moving_obj.Position))

		-- 구멍에 떨어지고 있지 않으면 바운스 없이 점프 끝낸다.
		if not thrown_data.falling_in_hole then
			if thrown_data.can_change_anim then
				character_util.remove_anim(guardian)
			end

			if guardian_num == self.gimmick_enum.hookshot then
				local character_hookshot_fo = get_field_object('character_hookshot_fo')
				character_hookshot_fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
				character_hookshot_fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.8, 0.5, 0.8))
			end

			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(guardian, data.origin_emo)

			-- 기믹이 움직이는 주체면 캐릭터 스퀴시를 직접 해야한다.
			if is_gimmick_moving then
				character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(guardian)
				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(guardian)
			end

			-- 현재 위치가 바닥이 아니면 리더 위치로 리셋
			if not field:IsThereFloorAt(moving_obj.Position) then
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.reset_effect):Instantiate(moving_obj.Position)
				moving_obj.Position = user_party.Leader.Position
			end

			--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
			message_system:Send(moving_obj, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
		end
	end

	if thrown_data.falling_in_hole then
		-- 기믹이 움직이는 주체면 캐릭터의 크기를 직접 줄여야 한다. (떨어지는 것 처럼 보이게 하기)
		if is_gimmick_moving then
			guardian.Transform.localScale = moving_obj.Transform.localScale
		end
	end
end

--- 복제 가디언 역할 표시 이모티콘 처리
function local_class:update_duplicated_guardian_emoticon(guardian_num)
	if self.leader_jump_state == self.jump_state.jump_start then
		self:hide_emoticon(guardian_num)
	elseif self.leader_jump_state == self.jump_state.jump_end then
		self:show_or_create_emoticon(guardian_num)
	end
end

--- 이상한 위치에 있는 복제가디언의 위치 수정
function local_class:fix_wrong_party_position(guardian_num)
	local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[guardian_num]
	local fix_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

	if data.gimmick ~= nil then
		if data.moving_obj.Position == vector(999, 0, 999) then
			data.moving_obj.Position = fix_pos
			data.gimmick.Position = fix_pos
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fix_wrong_gimmick_position(guardian_num)
	local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[guardian_num]
	local fix_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

	if data.gimmick ~= nil then
		if data.moving_obj.Position ~= vector(999, 0, 999) then
			data.moving_obj.Position = fix_pos
			data.gimmick.Position = fix_pos
		end
	end
end

--- 점프 타일, 구멍 등 외부 코루틴에서 표정 풀리는 경우 디폴트 표정으로 다시 세팅
function local_class:set_duplicated_guardian_default_emotion_after_jump(guardian_num)
	local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[guardian_num]
	local guardian = data.guardian
	local jump_data = data.jump_data
	local action = guardian.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction
	local is_analogue = lua_helper.type_compare(guardian.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState,
			typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState))

	-- 구멍으로 떨어지는 연출(HoleInteractable)은 이모션을 낙하 후
	-- 한 프레임 뒤에 지우기 때문에 실제로 이모션 적용을 한 프레임 뒤에 한다.
	if jump_data.jump_end_next_frame then
		jump_data.jump_end_next_frame = false
		jump_data.jumped = false
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(guardian, data.origin_emo)
	end

	if jump_data.jumped then
		if is_analogue and action ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stop and
				action ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying then
			jump_data.jump_end_next_frame = true
		end
	else
		if not is_analogue and action == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying then
			jump_data.jumped = true
		end
	end
end

--- 버튼이 비활성화 되는 상태를 순차적으로 체크 해서 현재 버튼이 활성화 되어야하면 활성화 시킨다.
function local_class:update_button_active_state()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local prev_touch_button = self.can_touch_button

	self.can_touch_button = true

	-- 스테이지 시작 전에는 버튼 조작 못 하도록 한다.
	self.can_touch_button = self.stage_enter_fade_in_complete

	-- 가드, cctv에게 걸렸을 때 버튼 조작 못 하도록 한다.
	if self.is_detected then
		self.can_touch_button = false
	end

	-- 리더가 점프 중이면 버튼 조작 못 하도록 한다.
	if self.can_touch_button then
		self.can_touch_button = self.leader_jump_state == self.jump_state.not_jumping
	end

	-- 가디언 중 하나라도 점프 중이거나 떨어지는 중이면 버튼 조작 못 하도록 한다.
	if self.can_touch_button then
		for i = 1, #self.duplicated_guardian_data do
			if self:has_guardian(i) then
				local jump_data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i].jump_data
				local thrown_data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i].thrown_data

				if jump_data.jumped or thrown_data.falling_in_hole then
					self.can_touch_button = false
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 리더가 든 물체가 자석에 끌려가는 중이면 버튼 조작 못 하도록 한다.
	if self.can_touch_button then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(
				leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) then
			local action_state = leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState

			if action_state.IsMagnetHolding or action_state.IsMagnetHoldingCliffMove then
				if self.can_touch_button then
					self.can_touch_button = false
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local is_screenplay = lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState)

	if not is_screenplay then
		-- 스크린 플레이가 아닐 때 버튼을 키는 것을 예약 했고, 버튼이 여전히 활성화 되어야 하는 상태면 버튼 활성화
		if self.can_touch_button and self.reserve_button_enable then
			prev_touch_button = false
		end
		self.reserve_button_enable = false
	end

	if prev_touch_button ~= self.can_touch_button then
		-- 리더가 스크린 플레이 중이면 FieldUIcustomButton은 무조건 꺼지기 활성화 하는 것을 예약한다.
		if is_screenplay then
			if self.can_touch_button and not self.reserve_button_enable then
				self.reserve_button_enable = true
			end
		end

		self:set_button_active_state(self.can_touch_button)
	end
end

function local_class:has_guardian(idx)
	return self.cur_dp_guardian_get_progress & (1 << idx) ~= 0
end

--- 새로운 복제 가디언을 합류 시킨다.
function local_class:add_guardian(idx)
	if self:has_guardian(idx) then
		return false
	end

	self.cur_dp_guardian_get_progress = self.cur_dp_guardian_get_progress | (1 << idx)
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.dp_guardian_get_custom_key, self.cur_dp_guardian_get_progress)
	return true
end

--- 복제가디언들 기본 표정으로 세팅
function local_class:reset_duplicated_guardians_emotion()
	for i = 1, #self.duplicated_guardian_data do
		if self:has_guardian(i) then
			local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i]
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(data.guardian, data.origin_emo)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:teleport_guardians_to_party_pos(play_fx)
	local pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	local dir = user_party.Leader.Direction
	local dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(dir)
	local was_on_floor = true

	for i = 1, #self.guardians do
		if self:has_guardian(i) then
			local guardian = self.guardians[i]
			guardian.Position = pos
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.guardians do
		if self:has_guardian(i) then
			local guardian = self.guardians[i]

			if was_on_floor then
				local next_pos = pos + dir_vec * -0.6

				if field:IsThereApproachableFloorAt(next_pos) and
						field:GetFieldObjectAt(next_pos) == nil and
						field:GetTileInfoAt(next_pos).types == CS.Tilemaps.TileTypes.None
						then
					pos = next_pos
				else
					was_on_floor = false
				end
			end

			guardian.Position = pos
			guardian.Direction = dir

			if play_fx == true then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_fail_01')
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.reset_effect):Instantiate(pos)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:play_custom_screenplay(func, ...)
	local args = { ... }
	local routine = function()
		if self.duplicated_guardians_gimmick_on then
			self.duplicated_guardians_gimmick_on = false
			self.button:SetIcon('actbtn_ic_ar_change.png')
			self:gimmick_mode_off()
		end

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		local cached_leader = user_party.Leader
		if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
			cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
					stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
		end

		yield_return_func(func, table.unpack(args))

		if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
			cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
					stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
		end

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

	return start_coroutine(routine)
end

-- 역할 이모티콘 표시
function local_class:show_or_create_emoticon(guardian_num)
	local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[guardian_num]
	local gimmick_emoticon_data = data.gimmick_emoticon_data

	if gimmick_emoticon_data.sprite_name ~= nil then
		if gimmick_emoticon_data.emoticon == nil then
			gimmick_emoticon_data.emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(
					data.guardian, nil, 'item', gimmick_emoticon_data.sprite_name,
					{ emoticon_time = { 0.15, 1, 0 }, no_time_limit = true, attach_to_fo = true,
					  item_sprite_p2w = gimmick_emoticon_data.sprite_size })
		else
			gimmick_emoticon_data.emoticon:ShowOn(data.guardian,
					vector(1, 1, 1), CS.Oak.EmoticonType.Item,
					gimmick_emoticon_data.sprite_name, 1, nil, true,
					gimmick_emoticon_data.sprite_size)
		end
	end
end

-- 역할 이모티콘 제거
function local_class:hide_emoticon(guardian_num)
	local gimmick_emoticon_data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[guardian_num].gimmick_emoticon_data

	if gimmick_emoticon_data.emoticon ~= nil then
		gimmick_emoticon_data.emoticon:Clear()
	end
end

function local_class:disable_guardians()
	self.can_touch_button = false
	self.reserve_button_enable = false
	self:set_button_active_state(false)

	for i = 1, #self.duplicated_guardian_data do
		local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i]
		local guardian = data.guardian
		local gimmick = data.gimmick

		character_util.convert_to_npc(data.guardian)
		character_util.set_active_state(guardian, 'disabled')
		guardian.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		if gimmick ~= nil then
			gimmick.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			gimmick.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end

	self.guardians_disabled = true
end

-- 다음에 얻어야하는 복제가디언의 번호 얻기
function local_class:get_next_collectable_guardian_idx()
	for i = 1, #self.guardians do
		if not self:has_guardian(i) then
			return i
		end
	end

	return #self.guardians + 1
end

--region CommonEventScene 에 있는 함수들 편하게 쓰기 위한 레핑 함수는 여기에 정의
function local_class:play_duplicated_guardian_bridge_scene()
	local duplicated_guardian_bridge_scene = self.common_event_scene.duplicated_guardian_bridge_scene
	self:play_custom_screenplay(duplicated_guardian_bridge_scene, self)
end

function local_class:play_duplicated_guardian_entry_scene()
	local duplicated_guardian_entry_scene = self.common_event_scene.duplicated_guardian_entry_scene
	start_coroutine(duplicated_guardian_entry_scene, self)
end

function local_class:play_barrel_knock_back_plasma_bomber(damage_event)
	local barrel_knock_back_plasma_bomber = self.common_event_scene.barrel_knock_back_plasma_bomber
	barrel_knock_back_plasma_bomber(self, damage_event)
end
--endregion

-- 암실 설정 (복제가디언도 어둡게 해야해서 여기서 처리)
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'last_note_zone') then
		self:enter_dark_room()
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'last_note_zone') then
		self:leave_dark_room()
	end
end

--TODO: 복제가디언 데이터 글로벌 테이블로 받아올 수 있게 해서 연구일지 퀘스트에서 색 변경 가능하게 수정 필요
function local_class:enter_dark_room()
	self.aircraft_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_aircraft_loop_01',
		loop = true, type_priority = 'event'
	})

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tv_off_02')

	field:Tint('dark_tint', unity_color({ 0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1 }), 1)

	for i = 1, 7 do
		if self:has_guardian(i) then
			local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i]
			local color_to = unity_color({ (data.color.r + 0.1) / 4, (data.color.g + 0.1) / 4, (data.color.b + 0.1) / 4, 1 })
			start_coroutine(self.change_duplicated_guardian_color, self, data.guardian, data.color, color_to, 0.5, 1, 1)
		end
	end

	local leader_color_to = unity_color({ 0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 1 })
	character_util.add_color(user_party.Leader, 'leader_dark', leader_color_to, 1, 1)
end

function local_class:leave_dark_room()
	if self.aircraft_sfx ~= nil then
		self.aircraft_sfx:Stop()
		self.aircraft_sfx = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_mayreel_charge_01')

	field:RemoveTint('dark_tint', 1)

	for i = 1, 7 do
		if self:has_guardian(i) then
			local data = self.duplicated_guardian_data[i]
			local color_form = unity_color({ (data.color.r + 0.01) / 4, (data.color.g + 0.01) / 4, (data.color.b + 0.01) / 4, 1 })
			start_coroutine(self.change_duplicated_guardian_color, self, data.guardian, color_form, data.color, 1, 0.5, 1)
		end
	end

	character_util.remove_color(user_party.Leader, 'leader_dark', 1)
end

--TODO: 복제가디언 색 변경 함수 통합 해야함
function local_class:change_duplicated_guardian_color(target, color_from, color_to, mag_from, mag_to, dur)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < dur do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / dur)
		local cur_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color.Lerp(color_from, color_to, progress)
		local cur_mag = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(mag_from, mag_to, progress)

		character_util.add_color(target, target.Name, cur_color, cur_mag, 0)
		target.SpineController:AddFadeColor(target.Name, cur_color, 0.3, 0)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

		return get_field_object('duplication_lab_test_tube')
	end

	self.scientists = {}

	self.timeline_director_name = 'qs_duplication_lab_pre'

	self.zone_event_data = {
		duplication_lab_event_1 = {
			saw = false,
			timeline_asset_name = 'qs_duplication_lab_pre_1'
		},
		duplication_lab_event_2 = {
			saw = false,
			timeline_asset_name = 'qs_duplication_lab_pre_2'
		},
		duplication_lab_event_3 = {
			saw = false,
			timeline_asset_name = 'qs_duplication_lab_pre_3'
		}
	}

	self.camera_grid_timeline_asset_name = 'qs_duplication_lab_pre_4'

	self.loop_asset_4 = true
	self.loop_asset_4_ended = true
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	-- 존 데이터에 있는 playable asset 만큼 등록
	for _, v in pairs(self.zone_event_data) do
		timeline_util.load_single_playable(v.timeline_asset_name)
	end

	timeline_util.load_single_playable(self.camera_grid_timeline_asset_name)
end

function local_class:enter()
	local scientists_colors = {
		-- 주황색
		unity_color({ 1, 0.5, 0, 1 }),
		-- 초록색
		unity_color({ 0, 1, 0, 1 }),
		-- 파란색
		unity_color({ 0, 0, 1, 1 })
	}

	-- 맵이 있는 만큼 과학자 npc 캐싱
	local idx = 1
	while true do
		local scientist = get_character('duplication_lab_scientist_' .. idx)

		if scientist == nil then
			break
		end

		local color = scientists_colors[idx]

		if color ~= nil then
			character_util.add_color(scientist, scientist.Name, color, 0.5, 0)
			scientist.SpineController:AddFadeColor(scientist.Name, color, 0.3, 0)
		end

		idx = idx + 1
		table.insert(self.scientists, scientist)
	end

	local tube = self.get_duplication_lab_test_tube()
	tube.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(tube)


	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.scientists = nil
	self.zone_path_data = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.loop_asset_4 = false

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, e.FieldObject) then
		return false
	end

	local zone = self.zone_event_data[e.Zone.Name]

	if zone ~= nil and zone.saw == false then
		zone.saw = true
		timeline_util.play(self.timeline_director_name, zone.timeline_asset_name)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'duplication_lab_grid') then
		if self.loop_asset_4_ended then
			start_coroutine(self.timeline_asset_4_custom_loop_routine, self)
		end

		self.loop_asset_4 = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'duplication_lab_grid') then
		self.loop_asset_4 = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local duplication_lab_test_tube = self.get_duplication_lab_test_tube()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, duplication_lab_test_tube) then
		duplication_lab_test_tube.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.open_substage_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 루프를 하며 카메라 그리드를 나가도 타이라인을 끝까지 플레이하고 멈춘다.
-- 만약 다시 카메라 그리드를 들어가면 루프를 계속 한다.
function local_class:timeline_asset_4_custom_loop_routine()
	self.loop_asset_4_ended = false
	self.loop_asset_4 =  true

	for i = 1, #self.scientists do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.scientists[i], 0, 0)
	end

	while self.loop_asset_4 do
		timeline_util.play_async(self.timeline_director_name, self.camera_grid_timeline_asset_name)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.scientists do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.scientists[i], 'disabled')
	end

	self.loop_asset_4_ended = true
end

--- 서브 스테이지 열리는 연출
function local_class:open_substage_scene()
	-- 수상한 시험관이 있는 인베이더 군단의 실험실 위치를 알아냈습니다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_duplication_lab_pre_4', mintotalduration = 1 })

	-- 서브 스테이지 오픈 이벤트 중에 타임라인 정지 (사운드 이슈)
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(1)
		timeline_util.stop(self.timeline_director_name)
		self.loop_asset_4 = false
	end)

	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = 'queenship_substage_duplication_lab'
	})

	quest_icon_util.remove(self.get_duplication_lab_test_tube())

	quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller)
end

return local_class

		quest_marker.get_quest_marker_data(self)
	end

	local next_progress = quest_marker.progress

	if self:has_guardian(7) then
		next_progress = 20
	elseif self:has_guardian(6) then
		next_progress = 17
	elseif self:has_guardian(5) then
		next_progress = 14
	elseif self:has_guardian(4) then
		next_progress = 12
	elseif self:has_guardian(3) then
		next_progress = 6
	elseif self:has_guardian(2) then
		next_progress = 3
	elseif self:has_guardian(1) then
		next_progress = 1
	end

	if next_progress > quest_marker.progress then
		quest_marker.progress = next_progress
	end
end

function quest_marker.show_ground_quest_marker(self)
	local target = quest_marker.data[quest_marker.progress].ground

	if target ~= nil then
		quest_marker_util.show(self, quest_marker.key, target)
	else
		quest_marker_util.remove(quest_marker.key)
	end

	quest_marker.showing_ground_marker = true
end

function quest_marker.show_underground_quest_marker(self)
	local target = quest_marker.data[quest_marker.progress].underground

	if target ~= nil then
		quest_marker_util.show(self, quest_marker.key, target)
	else
		quest_marker_util.remove(quest_marker.key)
	end

	quest_marker.showing_ground_marker = false
end

function quest_marker.update_marker(self)
	if quest_marker.showing_ground_marker then
		quest_marker.show_ground_quest_marker(self)
	else
		quest_marker.show_underground_quest_marker(self)
	end
end

-- 더 낮은 프로그래스는 거른다.
function quest_marker.increase_or_set_progress(self, progress)
	if progress == nil then
		quest_marker.progress = quest_marker.progress + 1
	elseif quest_marker.progress < progress then
		quest_marker.progress = progress
	end

	quest_marker.update_marker(self)
end

-- 프로그래스는 더 적게 낮출 수 있다.
function quest_marker.decrease_or_set_progress(self, progress)
	if progress == nil then
		quest_marker.progress = quest_marker.progress -1
	elseif quest_marker.progress > progress then
		quest_marker.progress = progress
	end

	quest_marker.update_marker(self)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return quest_marker
	end
}

		return true
	end

function local_class:guardian_being_duplicated_scene()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local tube = self.get_duplication_lab_test_tube()
	party_util.align_party(tube.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'down', 1)

	-- 시험관에서 이상한 기운이 느껴집니다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_duplication_lab_s1_1' })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 건드린다
		{ 'qs_duplication_lab_s1_2', 'brutal' },
		-- 들어간다
		{ 'qs_duplication_lab_s1_3', 'mercy' },
		-- 그만둔다
		{ 'qs_duplication_lab_s1_4', 'normal'}
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		self:touch_tube_scene()
	elseif choose_result == 2then
		self:into_tube_scene()
		quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
		return
	end

	local duplication_lab_test_tube = self.get_duplication_lab_test_tube()
	duplication_lab_test_tube.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 건드린다 선택지 이벤트 연출
function local_class:touch_tube_scene()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local tube = self.get_duplication_lab_test_tube()

	for _ = 1, 2 do
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(leader, { name = 'spear_attack', sfx = '01_swing_01' })

-- 연기 이팩트 관련 기능 모음
function local_class:cloud(name)
	if name == 'create' then
		-- 연기 생성
		self.gradient = CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient(unity_class.color.black)
		self.smoke_effect = self.get_smoke_effect():Instantiate(
				stage_camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.Transform)

		local main_module = self.smoke_effect.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
				typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main
		local color = main_module.startColor.color

		self.gradient.color = unity_color({ color.r, color.g, color.b, 0.6 })
		main_module.startColor = self.gradient

	elseif name == 'fade_away' then
		-- 연기 서서히 사라지는 연출
		local main_module = self.smoke_effect.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
				typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main

		main_module.startColor = self.gradient
		local color = main_module.startColor.color

		local smoke_duration = 2
		local time_passed = 0

		local start_alpha = 0.6
		local end_alpha = 0

		while time_passed < smoke_duration do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local cur_alpha = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_alpha, end_alpha, time_passed / smoke_duration)

			self.gradient.color = unity_color({ color.r, color.g, color.b, cur_alpha })
			main_module.startColor = self.gradient
		end


	elseif name == 'dispose' then
		-- 연기 제거
		if self.smoke_effect ~= nil then
			self.smoke_effect:Dispose()
			self.smoke_effect = nil
		end

		self.gradient = nil
	end
end

function local_class:open_tube_door()
	self.tube_animator:Play('open')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	wait_for_sec(0.667)

function local_class:close_tube_door()

	wait_for_sec(0.667)
end

function local_class:reveal_color(idx)

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

	end

function local_class:toilet_shake()
	local guardian_1 = self.controller.guardians[1]
	character_util.move_distance_async(guardian_1, vector(0, 0, 3), 1, nil, true, true)

	-- 변기 흔들리는 연출
	self.shake_toilet = true
	local toilet = self.get_toilet()
	local shake_time = 1
	local shake_state = {
		stopped = 0,
		shaking = 1
	}
	local cur_state = shake_state.stopped
	local time_passed = shake_time

	self.get_toilet().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(toilet)

	while true do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		if self.game_ended then
			break
		end

		if not self.shake_toilet then
			break
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= shake_time then
			time_passed = 0

			if cur_state == shake_state.shaking then
				cur_state = shake_state.stopped
				toilet:CancelShake()
			elseif cur_state == shake_state.stopped then
				start_coroutine(function()
					character_util.set_animation_n_times(guardian_1, { name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
					wait_for_sec(0.233)
					self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(guardian_1.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0.6))
					cur_state = shake_state.shaking
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
					toilet:Shake(0.06, 0.3)
				end)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			end
		end
	end

	if cur_state == shake_state.shaking then
		toilet:CancelShake()
	end
end

function local_class:reveal_guardian_1_color()
	local data = self.controller.duplicated_guardian_data[1]
	local guardian = data.guardian
	local name = guardian.Name
	local color = data.color

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.5
	local color_from = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 })
	local color_to = unity_color({ color.r, color.g, color.b, 1 })

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color.Lerp(color_from, color_to, progress)
		local cur_mag = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(1, 0.5, progress)

		character_util.add_color(guardian, name, cur_color, cur_mag, 0)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_loop_sfx()
	if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		for _, sfx in pairs(self.loop_sfx) do
			if sfx ~= nil then
				sfx:Stop()
				sfx = nil
			end
		end
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipDuplicationLabSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = QueenShipDuplicationLab @
		Comment = QueenShipDuplicationLab 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = self.controller.duplicated_guardian_stage

	self.timeline_director_name = 'lab_director'

	self.get_toilet = function()
		return get_field_object('toilet')
	end

	self.get_cliff_wall = function()
		return get_field_object('cliff_wall')
	end

	self.get_alarm_clock_wall = function()
		return get_field_object('alarm_item')
	end

	self.get_invader = function(idx)
		return get_character('invader_' .. idx)
	end

	self.get_duplication_lab_test_tube = function()
		return get_field_object('duplication_lab_test_tube')
	end

	self.get_holdable_key = function()
		return get_field_object('holdable_key')
	end

	end

	self.final_zone_entered = false

	self.timeline_asset_names = {

		take_alarm = 'qs_duplication_lab_s3_2',
		wake_up_sleeping_guardian = 'qs_duplication_lab_s3_3',

	}

	-- 퀘스트 마커 관련

	self.quest_marker_table = nil

	-- 알람 이벤트 관련
	self.wake_up_progress = {
		none = 1,
		sleeping_guardian_talked = 2,
		took_alarm = 3
	}
	self.cur_wake_up_progress = self.wake_up_progress.none

	-- 총 쏘는 연출 관련
	self.pooled_bullet = {}
