function super_invader_simulator:attack_knight_qte()
	local target_tap_count = 21
	local target_cam_size = 2.7
	local start_cam_size = 4
	local prev_tap_count = 0
	local get_attack_speed = function(progress)
		if progress > 0.7 then
			return 5
		end

		local small_progress = progress / 0.7

		return (1 - small_progress) + small_progress * 5
	end

	self.tap_count = 0

	local super_invader = get_party_leader()
	local knight = self.super.get_knight()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(knight, 'walk4legs', { scale = 0 })

	screen_util.show_turbo_tap()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	--연타 횟수에 따라 속도가 점점 빨라지지만, 입력 없을 경우, 때리지 않고 대기.
	local cur_delay = 0
	local last_hit_time = unity_class.time.time

	while prev_tap_count < target_tap_count do
		-- 터치 딜레이 부여. 안그러면 때리다가 말아서 추가함
		if unity_class.time.time - last_hit_time < cur_delay then
			self.tap_count = prev_tap_count

		elseif prev_tap_count < self.tap_count then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.tap_count / target_tap_count)
			local is_first = prev_tap_count == 0
			local scale = get_attack_speed(progress)
			local dur = 1 / scale

			character_util.remove_anim(super_invader)
			character_util.set_anim(super_invader, {
				name = 'attack2', loop = false, remove_after = dur, scale = scale, sfx_name = function()
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_heavy_slash_01')
					music_player_util.play_sfx({
						sfx_name = '02_heavy_slash_01', start_clip_time = 0.4,
						type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player',
					})

					if is_first then
						character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
						scene_util.set_anim_loop(knight, 'prostrate')
						character_util.add_color(knight, 'super_invader',
								unity_class.color.black, 1, 0.5)
						character_util.stop_shake(knight)
					end

					camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.15)

					character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(knight)
					character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(knight)

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_sneak_blood_01')
					self.controller.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(knight.Position + vector(-0.3, 0.3, 0))
					self.controller.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(knight.Position + vector(-0.3, 0.3, 0))
				end
			})

			prev_tap_count = self.tap_count

			last_hit_time = unity_class.time.time

function eva_simulator:training_qte_routine()
	local knight = self.super.get_knight()
	local scarecrows = {
		self.get_scarecrow(1),
		self.get_scarecrow(2),
		self.get_scarecrow(3),
		self.get_scarecrow(4),
	}
	local order = {
		{
			dir = 'right',
			index = 1,
		},
		{
			dir = 'left',
			index = 3,
		},
		{
			dir = 'up',
			index = 4,
		},
		{
			dir = 'down',
			index = 2,
		},
	}

	local cur_order_index = 1

	local get_info = function()
		return order[cur_order_index]
	end

	local progress_order = function()
		cur_order_index = cur_order_index % 4 + 1
	end

	local execute_hit = function(info, dur)
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		character_util.set_direction(knight, info.dir)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
		character_util.set_anim(knight, {
			name = 'attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'sword_idle', scale = 0.5 / dur,
			sfx_name = function()
				local dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(info.dir)
				local hit_pos = knight.Position + dir_vec * 0.7 + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
				self.controller.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(hit_pos)
				self.controller.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(hit_pos)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
				scarecrows[info.index]:Deviate(dir_vec * 0.1, 0.1, 0.2)

				camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
			end})
	end

	character_util.hide_weapon(knight, false)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(knight, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(knight, 'sword_idle')

	--가디언 PT체조 4번 시작.(빨강)
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qs_virtual_simulator_59_1', 'brutal' }
	})

	--가디언이 4개의 허수아비를 하나씩 때린다.
	--총 6번째 때렸을 때
	for i = 1, 6 do
		execute_hit(get_info(), 0.6)
		progress_order()

		wait_for_sec(0.6)
	end

	-- 다음 선택지 진행.
	--가디언 선택지
	--동작 봐라. 빨리빨리 움직여!
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qs_virtual_simulator_59_2', 'brutal' }
	})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	--가디언 tired로 허수아비들을 때린다.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(knight, 'tired')

	--7번 때리면 다음 선택지 진행.
	for i = 1, 7 do
		execute_hit(get_info(), 0.53)
		progress_order()

		wait_for_sec(0.53)
	end

	--가디언 선택지
	--거기 손 보인다, 손! 빨리빨리 움직여!
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qs_virtual_simulator_59_3', 'brutal' }
	})

	--가디언 scared로 허수아비들을 때린다.
	--7번 때리면 다음 선택지 진행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(knight, 'scared')

	for i = 1, 7 do
		execute_hit(get_info(), 0.45)
		progress_order()

		wait_for_sec(0.45)
	end

	--가디언 선택지
	--더 빠르게!
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qs_virtual_simulator_59_4', 'brutal' }
	})

	--가디언 damaged로 허수아비들을 때린다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(knight, 'damaged')
	for i = 1, 7 do
		execute_hit(get_info(), 0.4)
		progress_order()

		wait_for_sec(0.4)
	end
end

function princess_simulator:waker_rotate_routine()
	local waker = self.super.get_invader_waker()
	local cur_rotation = 180
	local start_rot_speed = 90
	local end_rot_speed = 360 * 4
	local duration = 3
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		cur_rotation = cur_rotation +
				(start_rot_speed * (1 - progress) + end_rot_speed * progress) * unity_class.time.deltaTime

		character_util.spine_rotate(waker, cur_rotation, 0)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	character_util.spine_rotate(waker, cur_rotation + end_rot_speed * 5, 5)
end

	--공이 화면 밖으로 날아가더니 화면 shake와 함께 창문 깨지는 소리 + 가디언 쪽 화면 끝에서 창문 깨지는 이펙트(fx_windowbreak).
	--티탄 주민 한 명이 나타나 이벤트 진행.
	--티탄 주민(mad, cast2) : 누구야! 우리 집 유리창 깬 놈이!
	--가디언 선택지
	--유, 유리창 깬 적 없어요…
	--tired, idle.
	--티탄 주민이 가디언을 바라보며 화를 낸다.
	--티탄 주민(mad, attack) : 그럼 너야?!
	--가디언 scared
	--티탄 주민(mad, jump 2회) : 너 일로와!
	--가디언 티탄주민에게 끌려간다.

	timeline_util.play_async(self.controller.director_name, 'qs_simulator_common_11')

	timeline_table.unregister_action('baseball_create')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('baseball_throw_1')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('baseball_throw_2')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('baseball_gone')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_contact_01')
	self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_73', true, true)

	--이후 대사는 훈련 성공 이벤트 진행.
	self.current_simulation_state = self.simulation_state.win

	self.controller:succeed_simulation_scene()
end

function princess_simulator:baseball_create()
	local baseball_item_id = 20782

	self.baseball_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = baseball_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		pos = vector(999, 0, 999)
	})

	self.baseball_item.ConsumeTarget = nil

	self.baseball_item.Position = self.super.get_knight().Position + vector(-0.2, 0, 0.45)
end

function princess_simulator:baseball_throw_1(duration)
	local start_pos = self.baseball_item.Position
	local target_pos = get_party_leader().Position + vector(-2.5, start_pos.y, 0)
	local y_adder = 1.5
	local time_passed = 0
	local rotation = 360

	self.baseball_req_id = 1

	while time_passed < duration and self.baseball_req_id == 1 do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local cur_y_adder = math.sin(progress * math.pi / 2) * y_adder
		local cur_rotation = progress * rotation

		self.baseball_item.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress + vector(0, cur_y_adder, 0)

		self.baseball_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rotation)
		self.baseball_item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rotation)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	if self.baseball_req_id ~= 1 then
		return
	end

	self.baseball_item.Position = target_pos + vector(0, y_adder, 0)
	self.baseball_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	self.baseball_item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
end

function princess_simulator:baseball_throw_2(duration)
	local target_pos = get_party_leader().Position + vector(-0.3, 0.3, 0)
	local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.baseball_item.Position, target_pos.y)
	local y_adder = self.baseball_item.Position.y - target_pos.y
	local time_passed = 0
	local rotation = 360

	self.baseball_req_id = 2

	while time_passed < duration and self.baseball_req_id == 2 do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local cur_y_adder = math.cos(progress * math.pi / 2) * y_adder
		local cur_rotation = progress * rotation

		self.baseball_item.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress + vector(0, cur_y_adder, 0)
		self.baseball_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rotation)
		self.baseball_item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rotation)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	if self.baseball_req_id ~= 2 then
		return
	end

	self.baseball_item.Position = target_pos

	self.baseball_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	self.baseball_item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
end

function princess_simulator:baseball_gone(duration)
	local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('enemy_knight_start') + vector(-2, 2, 0)
	local start_pos = self.baseball_item.Position
	local y_height = 3
	local time_passed = 0
	local rotation = -720

	self.baseball_req_id = 3

	while time_passed < duration and self.baseball_req_id == 3 do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local cur_y_adder = math.sin(progress * math.pi) * y_height
		local cur_rotation = progress * rotation

		self.baseball_item.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress + vector(0, cur_y_adder, 0)
		self.baseball_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rotation)
		self.baseball_item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rotation)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	if self.baseball_req_id ~= 3 then
		return
	end

	self.baseball_item.Position = target_pos

	self.baseball_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	self.baseball_item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	self.baseball_item:ConsumeComplete()
end

function event_manager_base:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.get_invader = function(group_num, index)
		return get_character('invader_' .. group_num .. '_' .. index)
	end

	self.get_teatan = function(group_num, index)
		return get_character('teatan_' .. group_num .. '_' .. index)
	end

	self.get_invader_boss = function()
		return get_character('invader_boss')
	end

	self.get_dummy_talker = function(group_name)
		return get_character('event_dummy_talker_' .. group_name)
	end

	self.get_waypoint = function()
		return get_field_object('waypoint_1')
	end

	self.get_blocked_waypoint = function()
		return get_field_object('blocked_waypoint')
	end

	self.get_star_piece = function()
		return get_field_object('waypoint_star_piece')
	end

	self.get_fx_hidden_star_piece = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character')
	end

	self.activated_waypoint = nil

	self.waypoint_origin_pos = nil

	self.event_activated = false

	self.hidden_star_piece_effect = nil

	self.get_small_rock = function(index)
		return get_field_object('small_rock_' .. index)
	end

	self.small_rock_count = 2
end

function event_manager_base:enter()
	self.event_activated = true

	-- 오버플로우는 상정하지 않음
	self.controller.current_event_req_id = self.controller.current_event_req_id + 1
end

function event_manager_base:exit()
	self:hide_hidden_effect()

	self.event_activated = false

	for fo, _ in pairs(self.controller.simulation_breakables) do
		message_system:SendSync(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	for i = 1, self.small_rock_count do
		local rock = self.get_small_rock(i)

		message_system:SendSync(rock.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
	end
end

function event_manager_base:dispose()
	self:hide_hidden_effect()

	self.controller = nil
end

function event_manager_base:is_done(req_id)
	return not self.event_activated or req_id ~= self.controller.current_event_req_id
end

function event_manager_base:is_star_piece_eaten()
	return star_piece_util.has_star_piece('waypoint_star_piece')
end

function event_manager_base:show_hidden_effect(target)
	local waypoint_center_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Bounds.center)

	self.hidden_star_piece_effect = self.get_fx_hidden_star_piece():Instantiate(waypoint_center_pos)
end

function event_manager_base:hide_hidden_effect()
	if not is_unity_null(self.hidden_star_piece_effect) then
		self.hidden_star_piece_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.hidden_star_piece_effect = nil
end

function enemy_event_manager:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.controller:change_invader_to_monster()
	self.controller:change_teatans_to_monster()

	self.controller:set_simulation_npcs(false)

	self.super.get_invader_boss().DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = death_type_constants.smallexplosion

	self.chat_invaders_event_activated = false
	self.military_song_event_activated = false

	self.active_show_speech = true

	local waypoint = self.super.get_blocked_waypoint()
	self.super.get_waypoint().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	waypoint.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	if not self.super:is_star_piece_eaten() then
		self.super:show_hidden_effect(waypoint)
	end

	-- FIXME : 이거를 줄일 수가 있을까...?
	start_coroutine(self.bully_1_talk_routine, self)
	start_coroutine(self.bully_1_throw_routine, self)
	start_coroutine(self.bully_2_talk_routine, self)
	start_coroutine(self.bully_2_fight_routine, self)
	start_coroutine(self.patrol_invader_routine, self)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

function enemy_event_manager:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self:dispose_patrol_invader_emoticon()

	self.controller:stop_simulation_npcs()

	self.super:exit()
end

function enemy_event_manager:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.military_song_soldiers = nil

	self:dispose_patrol_invader_emoticon()

	self.speech_talkers = nil
end

function enemy_event_manager:is_done(req_id)
	return self.super:is_done(req_id)
end

function enemy_event_manager:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.military_song_event_activated and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.military_song_zone_name) then
		self.military_song_event_activated = true
		start_coroutine(self.military_song_scene, self)

		return true

	elseif not self.chat_invaders_event_activated and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.chat_invaders_zone_name) then
		self.chat_invaders_event_activated = true
		start_coroutine(self.chat_invaders_routine, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function enemy_event_manager:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.super.get_blocked_waypoint()) then
		--사용할 수 없는 대상입니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, 'qs_virtual_simulator_92')

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function enemy_event_manager:dispose_patrol_invader_emoticon()
	if self.patrol_invader_emoticon then
		self.patrol_invader_emoticon:Dispose()
	end

	self.patrol_invader_emoticon = nil
end

function enemy_event_manager:stop_npc_screenplay(npc)
	character_util.stop(npc)
	character_util.stop_shake(npc)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(npc, self.super.get_invader(3, 1)) then
		self:dispose_patrol_invader_emoticon()
	elseif self.military_song_soldiers[npc] and self:get_military_song_soldier_alive_count() <= 0 then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.super.get_dummy_talker('military_song'))
	end
end

function enemy_event_manager:stop_show_speeches()
	self.active_show_speech = false

	for i = 1,#self.speech_talkers do
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.speech_talkers[i])
	end
end

--- 커스텀하게 정지가 가능한 wait_for_sec
function enemy_event_manager:wait_for_sec_stoppable(sec, req_id)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < sec and not self:is_done(req_id) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

--- 인베이더 병사들이 티탄족 괴롭히고 있음 (3번 방)
--- 대사 출력
function enemy_event_manager:bully_1_talk_routine()
	local invaders = {
		self.super.get_invader(1, 1),
		self.super.get_invader(1, 2),
		self.super.get_invader(1, 3),
		self.super.get_invader(1, 4),
	}

	local str_keys = {
		'qs_virtual_simulator_74',
		'qs_virtual_simulator_75',
		'qs_virtual_simulator_76',
	}

	local req_id = self.controller.current_event_req_id

	while not self:is_done(req_id) do
		local is_all_dead = true

		for i = 1, #invaders do
			if not invaders[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				is_all_dead = false
				break
			end
		end

		if is_all_dead then
			break
		end

		local talker_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #invaders)
		local str_key_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #str_keys)

		--이 오염생물놈들!
		--벌레같은 놈들!
		--구세주님을 위하여!
		-- 죽지 않은 NPC들만 말풍선 띄워줌
		if not invaders[talker_index].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			if self.active_show_speech then
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invaders[talker_index], str_keys[str_key_index], false)
			else
				self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(2, req_id)
			end
		end

		self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(0.4, req_id)
	end
end

--- 인베이더 병사들이 티탄족 괴롭히고 있음 (3번 방)
--- 돌 던짐
function enemy_event_manager:bully_1_throw_routine()
	local teatans = {
		self.super.get_teatan(1, 1),
		self.super.get_teatan(1, 2)
	}

	local invaders = {
		self.super.get_invader(1, 1),
		self.super.get_invader(1, 2),
		self.super.get_invader(1, 3),
		self.super.get_invader(1, 4),
	}

	local throw_info = {
		{
			invader_index = 1,
			teatans_priority = {
				1, 2
			},
		},
		{
			invader_index = 3,
			teatans_priority = {
				2, 1
			},
		},
		{
			invader_index = 2,
			teatans_priority = {
				1, 2
			},
		},
		{
			invader_index = 4,
			teatans_priority = {
				2, 1
			},
		},
	}

	local current_throw_index = 1

	local req_id = self.controller.current_event_req_id

	local current_item_req_id = 0
	local items = {}

	local throw_done_cb_generator = function(target)
		local item_req_id = current_item_req_id

		return function(_)
			if not self:is_done(req_id) and not target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '01_hit_comic_01', parent = target, max_distance = 5, min_distance = 3,
					type_priority = 'default', player_priority = 'default', volume = 0.5,
				})
				self.controller.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.4, 0))

				character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(target)
				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)
			end

			drop_item_util.dispose_item(items[item_req_id])
			items[item_req_id] = nil
		end
	end

	local cooltime = 0.7
	local time_passed = 0

	while self.event_activated and req_id == self.controller.current_event_req_id do
		local is_all_dead = true

		for i = 1, #teatans do
			if not teatans[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				is_all_dead = false
				break
			end
		end

		if is_all_dead then
			return
		end

		if time_passed >= cooltime then
			local current_throw_info = throw_info[current_throw_index]
			local thrower = invaders[current_throw_info.invader_index]

			if not thrower.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				local teatan = nil

				for i = 1, #current_throw_info.teatans_priority do
					-- 아직 안죽었으면 타겟으로 결정
					if not teatans[current_throw_info.teatans_priority[i]].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
						teatan = teatans[current_throw_info.teatans_priority[i]]
						break
					end
				end

				if teatan ~= nil then
					--둘러싼 인베이더들이 번갈아가며 돌을 던진다.
					music_player_util.play_sfx({
						sfx_name = '02_shoot_ghost_01', parent = thrower, max_distance = 5, min_distance = 3,
						type_priority = 'default', player_priority = 'default', volume = 0.5
					})
					scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(thrower, 'attack', { remove_after = 0.5 })

					local rock_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
						itemid = 20741, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
						pos = thrower.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
						target = teatan.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
						showoncharacter = true, bounce_callback = throw_done_cb_generator(teatan),
						sprscale = 0.5
					})

					items[current_item_req_id] = rock_item

					current_item_req_id = current_item_req_id + 1
				end
			end

			current_throw_index = (current_throw_index % #throw_info) + 1
			time_passed = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	for _, item in pairs(items) do
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
	end
end

--- 신병들 군가 배우는 중
function enemy_event_manager:military_song_scene()
	local priestess = self.super.get_invader(2, 1)
	-- 단체 대사가 쓰이는 경우라 remove_bubble을 타면 단체 대사도 같이 지워져버려서 더미로 만듦
	local dummy_talker = self.super.get_dummy_talker('military_song')
	local invaders = {
		priestess,
		self.super.get_invader(2, 2),
		self.super.get_invader(2, 3),
		self.super.get_invader(2, 4),
	}
	local talk_pos = priestess.Position + vector(-1, 0, -2.5)

	local req_id = self.controller.current_event_req_id

	--군가 배우는 신병들
	--위 인베이더(invader_priestess, left, rifle_reload) : 인베이더로 태어나서~
	if self.active_show_speech then
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(priestess, 'qs_virtual_simulator_77', false)
	else
		self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(2, req_id)
	end

	if self:is_done(req_id) then
		return
	end

	--아래 인베이더들 다같이(invader_soldier, left, rifle_reload) : 인베이더로 태어나서~
	local alive_count = self:get_military_song_soldier_alive_count()

	if alive_count > 0 and self.active_show_speech then
		-- NPC가 많으면 대사가 더 크게 보이도록
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dummy_talker, 'qs_virtual_simulator_78', false, {
			world_pos = talk_pos, scale = 1 + 0.1 * alive_count
		})
	else
		self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(2, req_id)
	end

	if self:is_done(req_id) then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #invaders do
		if not invaders[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			character_util.set_direction(invaders[i], 'right')

			music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = invaders[i], type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
			})
		end
	end

	--위 인베이더(invader_priestess, right, rifle_reload) : 할 일도 많다만~
	if not priestess.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and self.active_show_speech then
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(priestess, 'qs_virtual_simulator_79', false)
	else
		self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(2, req_id)
	end

	if self:is_done(req_id) then
		return
	end

	--아래 인베이더들 다같이(invader_soldier, right, rifle_reload) : 할 일도 많다만~
	alive_count = self:get_military_song_soldier_alive_count()
	if alive_count > 0 and self.active_show_speech then
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(dummy_talker, 'qs_virtual_simulator_80', false, {
			world_pos = talk_pos, scale = 1 + 0.1 * alive_count
		})
	end
end

function enemy_event_manager:get_military_song_soldier_alive_count()
	local count = 0
	for npc, _ in pairs(self.military_song_soldiers) do
		if not npc.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			count = count + 1
		end
	end

	return count
end

---티탄족 괴롭히는 인베이더 병사2
function enemy_event_manager:bully_2_talk_routine()
	local invaders = {
		self.super.get_invader(10, 1),
		self.super.get_invader(10, 2),
		self.super.get_invader(10, 3),
		self.super.get_invader(10, 4),
	}

	local req_id = self.controller.current_event_req_id

	--잭, 저 오염생물을 혼내줘!
	--잭, 날려버려!
	local str_keys = {
		'qs_virtual_simulator_81',
		'qs_virtual_simulator_82',
	}

	while not self:is_done(req_id) do
		local talker_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #invaders)
		local str_key_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #str_keys)

		if not invaders[talker_index].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and self.active_show_speech then
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invaders[talker_index], str_keys[str_key_index], false)
		else
			self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(2, req_id)
		end

		if self:is_done(req_id) then
			break
		end

		self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(1, req_id)
	end
end

function enemy_event_manager:bully_2_fight_routine()
	--아래 인베이더 중 한 명이 아래 대사 리스트 중 랜덤으로 재생.
	local teatan = self.super.get_teatan(10, 1)
	local teatan_origin_pos = teatan.Position
	local invader = self.super.get_invader(10, 5)

	local req_id = self.controller.current_event_req_id
	local damaged_anims = {
		'damaged',
		'damaged2'
	}

	while not self:is_done(req_id) do
		if invader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			break
		end

		--인베이더가 공격하면 티탄이 맞는다. boong_attack으로 공격
		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_01', parent = invader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
		})
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(invader, 'boong_attack',
				{ remove_after = 0.5 })

		self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(0.07, req_id)

		--티탄 맞을 때마다 (damaged, damaged2), (damaged, damaged) + 피격 이펙트 + 뒤로 밀려난다.
		if self:is_done(req_id) or teatan.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			break
		end

		local damaged_anim_name = damaged_anims[random_util.get_random_int(1, #damaged_anims)]

		scene_util.set_anim_loop(teatan, damaged_anim_name)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(teatan, 'damaged')

		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(teatan)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(teatan)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = teatan, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
		})
		self.controller.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(teatan.Position + vector(-0.3, 0.3, 0))
		self.controller.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(teatan.Position + vector(-0.3, 0.3, 0))

		teatan.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		local knockback_duration = 0.5
		local time_passed = 0
		while not self:is_done(req_id) and
				not teatan.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and time_passed < knockback_duration do
			local progress = time_passed / knockback_duration
			teatan.Position = teatan_origin_pos + math.sin(progress * math.pi / 2) * vector(2, 0, 0)

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		if self:is_done(req_id) or teatan.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			break
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(teatan)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(teatan, 'attack')

		--티탄이 다시 제자리로 뛰어와
		--attack, dagger_idle.
		wp_util.move_async(teatan, teatan_origin_pos, 4, nil, { run = true })

		teatan.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

		if self:is_done(req_id) or teatan.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			break
		end

		scene_util.set_anim_loop(teatan, 'dagger_idle')

		self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(1.5, req_id)
	end
end

--- 잡담 중인 인베이더
function enemy_event_manager:chat_invaders_routine()
	local invader_1 = self.super.get_invader(5, 1)
	local invader_2 = self.super.get_invader(5, 2)
	local invader_3 = self.super.get_invader(5, 3)

	local req_id = self.controller.current_event_req_id

	-- 둘 다 죽을 때까진 계속 반복
	while not self:is_done(req_id) and
			not invader_1.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and
			not invader_2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and
			not invader_3.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead do
		--왼쪽 인베이더(cross_arm) : 오염생물들 중 한 놈이 쳐들어온다며?
		if not invader_1.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(invader_1, 'cross_arm')

			if self.active_show_speech then
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invader_1, 'qs_virtual_simulator_83', false)
			else
				self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(2, req_id)
			end
		else
			self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(2, req_id)
		end

		if self:is_done(req_id) then
			return
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(invader_1)

		--오른쪽 인베이더(bomb_idle) : 나도 들었어, 캔터베리 가디언이라던데?
		if not invader_2.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(invader_2, 'bomb_idle')

			if self.active_show_speech then
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invader_2, 'qs_virtual_simulator_84', false)
			else
				self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(2, req_id)
			end
		end

		if self:is_done(req_id) then
			return
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(invader_2)

		--그 녀석, 겁도 없구만!
		if not invader_3.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			if self.active_show_speech then
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invader_3, 'qs_virtual_simulator_84_1', false)
			else
				self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(2, req_id)
			end
		end
	end
end

function enemy_event_manager:patrol_invader_routine()
	local invader = self.super.get_invader(3, 1)

	local req_id = self.controller.current_event_req_id
	local right_wp = vector(self.super.get_teatan(3, 2).Position.x, 0, invader.Position.z)
	local left_wp = invader.Position

	while not self:is_done(req_id) and not invader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead do
		--오른쪽 지점에 도착하면
		wp_util.move_async(invader, right_wp, 3, nil)

		if self:is_done(req_id) or invader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			break
		end

		--up으로 1초.
		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = invader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
		})
		character_util.set_direction(invader, 'up')
		self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(2.5, req_id)

		if self:is_done(req_id) or invader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			break
		end

		--왼쪽 지점에 도착하면
		wp_util.move_async(invader, left_wp, 3, nil)

		if self:is_done(req_id) or invader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			break
		end

		--question, question이모티콘
		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', parent = invader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
		})
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(invader, 'question')
		self.patrol_invader_emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(invader, nil,
				'question', nil, { no_time_limit = true })
		self:wait_for_sec_stoppable(2.5, req_id)

		if self:is_done(req_id) or invader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			break
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(invader)

		self:dispose_patrol_invader_emoticon()
	end
end

--region Invader Event Manager

function invader_event_manager:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)

	self.victim_type = {
		boss = 1,
		invader_normal = 2,
		invader_sleep = 3,
		invader_song = 4,
		teatan_normal = 5,
		teatan_old = 6,
		teatan_female = 7,
		teatan_zaco = 8
	}

	-- Character -> type
	self.victim_to_type_dict = {}

	self.boss_treason_progress = {
		before_attack = 1,
		before_half_hp = 2,
		before_kill = 3,
		killed = 4,
	}

	self.current_boss_treason_progress = self.boss_treason_progress.before_attack

	self.team_kill_count = 0

	self.in_screenplay = false
end

function invader_event_manager:on_stage_loaded()
	self.super:on_stage_loaded()

	-- victim_to_type_dict 세팅
	for invader, _ in pairs(self.controller.invader_npcs) do
		self.victim_to_type_dict[invader] = self.victim_type.invader_normal
	end

	self.victim_to_type_dict[self.super.super.get_invader_boss()] = self.victim_type.boss
	self.victim_to_type_dict[self.super.super.get_invader(2, 1)] = self.victim_type.invader_song
	self.victim_to_type_dict[self.super.super.get_invader(4, 1)] = self.victim_type.invader_sleep

	for teatan, _ in pairs(self.controller.teatan_npcs) do
		self.victim_to_type_dict[teatan] = self.victim_type.teatan_normal
	end

	self.victim_to_type_dict[self.super.super.get_teatan(1, 2)] = self.victim_type.teatan_zaco
	self.victim_to_type_dict[self.super.super.get_teatan(3, 1)] = self.victim_type.teatan_old
	self.victim_to_type_dict[self.super.super.get_teatan(3, 2)] = self.victim_type.teatan_female
end

function invader_event_manager:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	-- 자다가 깬 인베이더의 경우에는 victim_type을 변경하므로 원복시켜줘야 함
	self.victim_to_type_dict[self.super.super.get_invader(4, 1)] = self.victim_type.invader_sleep

	self.current_boss_treason_progress = self.boss_treason_progress.before_attack

	self.team_kill_count = 0

	self.super.super.get_invader(5, 1).Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(unity_class.vector3.one)
	self.super.super.get_invader(5, 3).Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(unity_class.vector3.one)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
end

function invader_event_manager:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	self.in_screenplay = false

	self.super:exit()
end

function invader_event_manager:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	self.super:dispose()
end

function invader_event_manager:on_damage_event(e)
	-- MonsterConstantDamagedBehaviour로 처리한 데미지인 경우에만 추가 데미지 계산해줌
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_party_leader()) or
			self.victim_to_type_dict[e.Info.target] == nil then
		return false
	end

	local victim = e.Info.target
	local victim_type = self.victim_to_type_dict[victim]

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
	damage_info.sender = victim
	damage_info.target = victim

	if victim_type == self.victim_type.boss then
		--인베이더 사령관은 15회 이상 공격해야 사망한다.
		damage_info.damage = math.ceil(victim.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP / 15) - 1

		if self.current_boss_treason_progress == self.boss_treason_progress.before_attack then
			--최초 공격시

			self.current_boss_treason_progress = self.boss_treason_progress.before_half_hp

			--기계장치 : 상관에 대한 공격은 반역행위입니다.
			self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_104', false)

		elseif self.current_boss_treason_progress == self.boss_treason_progress.before_half_hp and
				victim.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio <= 0.5 then
			-- FIXME : 추가 데미지 들어온 시점으로 변경 필요
			--인베이더 사령관 체력 절반 남을 경우

			self.current_boss_treason_progress = self.boss_treason_progress.before_kill

			--기계장치 : 사회 질서를 어지럽히는 반체제적 사상을 감지했습니다.
			self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_105', false)
		end

	elseif victim_type == self.victim_type.invader_normal then
		--일반 인베이더 공격 시
		--일반 인베이더들은 모두 5회 공격해야 사망한다.
		damage_info.damage = math.ceil(victim.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP / 5) - 1

		--기계장치 : 전우를 아끼고 사랑해주세요.
		self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_107', false)

	elseif victim_type == self.victim_type.invader_sleep then
		--자고있는 인베이더 공격 시
		--일반 인베이더들은 모두 5회 공격해야 사망한다.
		damage_info.damage = math.ceil(victim.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP / 5) - 1

		--자고 있는 인베이더 일어난다.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(victim)
		self.victim_to_type_dict[victim] = self.victim_type.invader_normal

		--기계장치 : 전우에게 그런 비겁한 공격은 삼가주세요.
		self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_108', false)

	elseif victim_type == self.victim_type.invader_song then
		--음악 가르치는 인베이더 공격 시
		--일반 인베이더들은 모두 5회 공격해야 사망한다.
		damage_info.damage = math.ceil(victim.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP / 5) - 1

		--기계장치 : 군악대에 대한 공격을 멈춰주세요.
		self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_109', false)
	else
		--티탄들은 공격 3회하면 사망한다.
		damage_info.damage = math.ceil(victim.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP / 3) - 1
	end

	command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

	return true
end

function invader_event_manager:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	local victim = e.FieldObject
	local victim_type = self.victim_to_type_dict[victim]

	if victim_type == nil then
		return false
	end

	self.super:stop_npc_screenplay(victim)

	if victim_type == self.victim_type.boss then
		if self.current_boss_treason_progress ~= self.boss_treason_progress.before_kill then
			return false
		end

		--인베이더 사령관 살해한 경우
		self.current_boss_treason_progress = self.boss_treason_progress.killed

		--기계장치 : 훈련병 번호 208번, 빠른 시일 내에 군법회의 소환장이 발송될 예정입니다.
		self.in_screenplay = true
		self.super:stop_show_speeches()
		start_coroutine(self.killed_invader_boss_scene, self)

	elseif victim_type == self.victim_type.teatan_normal then
		--기계장치 : 오염생물을 제거하여 훈련점수가 추가됩니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_o_01')
		self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_110', false)

	elseif victim_type == self.victim_type.teatan_female then
		--teatan_female 처치 시
		--기계장치 : 여성 오염생물을 제거하여 훈련점수가 2배로 추가됩니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_o_01')
		self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_111', false)

	elseif victim_type == self.victim_type.teatan_old then
		--teatan_old 처치 시
		--기계장치 : 늙은 오염생물을 제거하여 훈련점수가 2배로 추가됩니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_o_01')
		self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_112', false)

	elseif victim_type == self.victim_type.teatan_zaco then
		--teatan_zaco 처치 시
		--기계장치 : 병사 오염생물을 제거하여 훈련점수가 3배로 추가됩니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_o_01')
		self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_113', false)

	else
		self.team_kill_count = self.team_kill_count + 1

		if self.team_kill_count < 3 then
			--기계장치 : 주의! 아군 병사를 살해하면 훈련이 강제종료될 수 있습니다.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
			self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_32', false)
		elseif not self.in_screenplay then
			self.in_screenplay = true
			self.super:stop_show_speeches()

			--3번째에는 시뮬레이션 종료되고, 기계장치 밖으로 나가진다.
			start_coroutine(self.controller.force_end_simulation_scene, self.controller)
		end

	end

	return true
end

function invader_event_manager:killed_invader_boss_scene()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_die_boss_invader_01', delayed_time = 2.3, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'elite_monster'
	})

	--인베이더 사령관 살해한 경우
	--기계장치 : 훈련병 번호 208번, 빠른 시일 내에 군법회의 소환장이 발송될 예정입니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
	self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_106', true, true)

	self.controller:force_end_simulation_scene()

	self.in_screenplay = false
end

	self.victim_type = {
		teatan = 1,
		invader = 2,
		boss = 3,
	}

	-- Character -> type
	self.victim_to_type_dict = {}

	self.is_invader_boss_first_hit = true

	self.invader_kill_count = 0
end

function super_invader_event_manager:on_stage_loaded()
	self.super:on_stage_loaded()

	for i = 1, self.big_rock_count do
		self.big_rock_hashset[self.get_big_rock(i)] = true
	end

	-- victim_to_type_dict 세팅

	for invader, _ in pairs(self.controller.invader_npcs) do
		self.victim_to_type_dict[invader] = self.victim_type.invader
	end

	for teatan, _ in pairs(self.controller.teatan_npcs) do
		self.victim_to_type_dict[teatan] = self.victim_type.teatan
	end

	self.victim_to_type_dict[self.super.super.get_invader_boss()] = self.victim_type.boss
end

function super_invader_event_manager:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	for i = 1, self.big_rock_count do
		self.get_big_rock(i).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	for fo, _ in pairs(self.controller.simulation_breakables) do
		fo.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	end

	self.is_invader_boss_first_hit = true

	self.invader_kill_count = 0

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
end

function super_invader_event_manager:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	-- 부쉈을 수도 있으니 원복
	for i = 1, self.big_rock_count do
		self.get_big_rock(i).ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	for fo, _ in pairs(self.controller.simulation_breakables) do
		fo.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	end

	self.super:exit()
end

function super_invader_event_manager:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	self.breakables = nil
	self.big_rock_hashset = nil

	self.super:dispose()
end

function super_invader_event_manager:on_damage_event(e)
	-- MonsterConstantDamagedBehaviour로 처리한 데미지인 경우에만 추가 데미지 계산해줌
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_party_leader()) or
			self.victim_to_type_dict[e.Info.target] == nil then
		return false
	end
	local victim = e.Info.target
	local victim_type = self.victim_to_type_dict[victim]

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
	damage_info.sender = victim
	damage_info.target = victim

	if victim_type == self.victim_type.boss then
		--인베이더 사령관은 공격 3회에 사망.
		damage_info.damage = math.ceil(victim.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP / 3)

		--1회
		if self.is_invader_boss_first_hit then
			self.is_invader_boss_first_hit = false

			--실력으로 자신의 존재를 증명하십시오!
			self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_98', false)
		end
	else
		--슈퍼인베이더는 인베이더도 티탄도 모두 한번에 죽일 수 있다.
		damage_info.damage = victim.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	end

	command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

	return false
end

function super_invader_event_manager:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	local victim = e.FieldObject
	local victim_type = self.victim_to_type_dict[victim]

	if victim_type == nil then
		return false
	end

	self.super:stop_npc_screenplay(victim)

	if victim_type == self.victim_type.boss then
		--인베이더 사령관 살해
		--앞으로도 자신보다 더 약한자의 말은 듣지 마십시오!
		self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_99', false)

	elseif victim_type == self.victim_type.teatan then
		--티탄 살해 시
		--오염생물은 좋은 양분입니다!
		self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_100', false)

	elseif victim_type == self.victim_type.invader then
		self.invader_kill_count = self.invader_kill_count + 1

		if self.invader_kill_count <= 3 then
			--최초 1 ~ 3회
			--기계장치 : 약한 개체는 강한 개체를 위한 좋은 양분입니다.
			self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_101', false)
		elseif self.invader_kill_count <= 6 then
			--3 ~ 6회
			--기계장치 : 또 다른 비상식량을 찾으셨군요!
			self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_102', false)
		else
			--7회 이상
			--기계장치 : 바로 이것이 강자의 삶입니다!
			self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_103', false)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function super_invader_event_manager:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.big_rock_hashset[e.Target] and not self.in_screenplay then
		self.in_screenplay = true

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.try_break_rock, self, e.Target)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function super_invader_event_manager:try_break_rock(rock)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local rock_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(rock.Bounds.center, rock.Position.y)
	local look_diff = rock_pos - get_party_leader().Position
	local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(look_diff)

	for dir_str, dir in pairs(direction_constants) do
		if dir == look_dir then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
			qte_util.swipe(dir_str)
			break
		end
	end

	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(leader, 'attack1', { sfx_name = '02_wolf_boss_slash_01' })
	wait_for_sec(0.65)

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
	damage_info.sender = leader
	damage_info.target = rock
	damage_info.damage = 100

	command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

	local effect_pos = rock_pos + vector(0, 0.5, 0) + look_diff.normalized
	self.controller.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(effect_pos)
	self.controller.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(effect_pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_02')

	wait_for_sec(0.35)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	self.controller:machine_talk_in_simulation('qs_virtual_simulator_94', false)

	self.in_screenplay = false
end

function ally_event_manager:init(controller)

end

function ally_event_manager:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	local waypoint = self.super.get_waypoint()

	waypoint.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	self.super.get_blocked_waypoint().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	if not self.super:is_star_piece_eaten() then

		self.super:show_hidden_effect(waypoint)
	end

function ally_event_manager:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointOpenedEvent))

	local star_piece = self.super.get_star_piece()
	local star_piece_behaviour = star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour

	-- 인터랙트했지만 먹지 않고 나간 경우
	if not self.super:is_star_piece_eaten() and not star_piece_behaviour.IsHidden then
		-- 다시 비활성화 시켜줌
		star_piece_behaviour.IsHidden = true
		star_piece.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	self.super:exit()
end

function ally_event_manager:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointOpenedEvent))

	self.super:dispose()
end

function ally_event_manager:on_waypoint_opened_event(e)
	-- 숨겨져있고, 아직 먹지 않았으면 Appear 이벤트 발동
	if self.super.get_star_piece().FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden and not self.super:is_star_piece_eaten() then
		self:appear_star_piece()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function ally_event_manager:appear_star_piece()
	local waypoint = self.super.get_waypoint()
	local appear_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(waypoint.Bounds.center, 0.5)

	star_piece_util.appear(self.super.get_star_piece(), appear_pos)

	self.super:hide_hidden_effect()
end

	end

	self.battle_state = {

		before_battle = 2,

	}

	self.zone_to_battle_info = {
		['simulation_room_1'] = {
			battle_group_name = 'simulation_room_1_battle',
			battle_gate_name = 'simulation_room_1_battle_gate_',
			battle_gate_count = 1,
			group_num = 1,
			invader_count = 1,
			teatan_groups = { 'hidden_teatans' },
			invader_origin_info = {},
			state = self.battle_state.disabled,
		},
		['simulation_room_2'] = {
			battle_group_name = 'simulation_room_2_battle',
			battle_gate_name = 'simulation_room_2_battle_gate_',
			battle_gate_count = 5,
			group_num = 2,
			invader_count = 9,
			teatan_groups = { 'bully_2' },
			invader_origin_info = {},
			state = self.battle_state.disabled,
		},
		['simulation_room_3'] = {
			battle_group_name = 'simulation_room_3_battle',
			battle_gate_name = 'simulation_room_3_battle_gate_',
			battle_gate_count = 4,
			group_num = 3,
			invader_count = 8,
			teatan_groups = { 'bully_1' },
			invader_origin_info = {},
			state = self.battle_state.disabled,
		},
		['simulation_room_4'] = {
			battle_group_name = 'simulation_room_4_battle',
			battle_gate_name = 'simulation_room_4_battle_gate_',
			battle_gate_count = 4,
			group_num = 4,
			invader_count = 9,
			teatan_groups = {},
			invader_origin_info = {},
			state = self.battle_state.disabled,
		},
	}

	self.battle_done_group_hashset = {}

	self.in_screenplay = false
end

function eva_event_manager:on_stage_loaded()
	for zone_name, _ in pairs(self.zone_to_battle_info) do
		local info = self.zone_to_battle_info[zone_name]

		for i = 1, info.invader_count do
			local monster = self.get_battle_invaders(info.group_num, i)

			character_util.convert_to_npc(monster)

			character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'disabled')

			info.invader_origin_info[i] = {
				pos = monster.Position,
				dir = monster.Direction
			}
		end
	end
end

function eva_event_manager:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	self.controller:set_simulation_npcs(true)
	self.controller:disable_invaders()
	self.controller:change_teatans_to_npc()

	self.battle_done_group_hashset = {}

	for zone_name, _ in pairs(self.zone_to_battle_info) do
		local info = self.zone_to_battle_info[zone_name]

		for i = 1, info.invader_count do
			local monster = self.get_battle_invaders(info.group_num, i)

			character_util.convert_to_monster(monster, info.battle_group_name, nil)

			-- 죽은 상태이면 부활도 같이 시켜줌
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.sender = monster
			heal_info.target = monster
			heal_info.heal = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.skipEffect = true
			heal_info.isRevive = true

			command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

			monster.Position = info.invader_origin_info[i].pos
			monster.Direction = info.invader_origin_info[i].dir

			-- 공격 맞지 않도록 막음
			character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'visible')
		end

		info.state = self.battle_state.before_battle
	end

	-- 인베이더 보스
	self.get_battle_invaders(4, 9).DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = death_type_constants.smallexplosion

	self.in_screenplay = false
end

function eva_event_manager:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	for zone_name, _ in pairs(self.zone_to_battle_info) do
		local info = self.zone_to_battle_info[zone_name]

		for i = 1, info.invader_count do
			local monster = self.get_battle_invaders(info.group_num, i)

			character_util.convert_to_npc(monster)

			character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'disabled')
		end

		info.state = self.battle_state.disabled
	end

	self.controller:stop_simulation_npcs()

	self.super:exit()
end

function eva_event_manager:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self.super:dispose()
end

function eva_event_manager:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local battle_info = self.zone_to_battle_info[e.Zone.Name]
	if battle_info ~= nil and battle_info.state == self.battle_state.before_battle and
			e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		battle_info.state = self.battle_state.in_battle

		self:activate_battle(self.zone_to_battle_info[e.Zone.Name])
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function eva_event_manager:on_damage_event(e)
	local monster_start_str = 'battle_'

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_party_leader()) and
			string.sub(e.Info.target.Name, 1, #monster_start_str) == monster_start_str and
			(e.Info.type & CS.Oak.DamageType.Death) == CS.Oak.DamageType.None then
		local victim = e.Info.target

		if e.HpBefore - e.Info:GetTotalDamage() > 0 and not victim.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = get_party_leader()
			damage_info.target = victim

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_battle_invaders(4, 9)) then
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(victim.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP / 3)
			else
				damage_info.damage = victim.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			end

			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

			return true
		end
	elseif not self.in_screenplay and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, get_party_leader()) and
			e.HpBefore - e.Info:GetTotalDamage() <= 1 then
		self.in_screenplay = true
		start_coroutine(self.fail_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function eva_event_manager:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	for zone_name, _ in pairs(self.zone_to_battle_info) do
		local info = self.zone_to_battle_info[zone_name]

		if e.BattleGroupName == info.battle_group_name then
			-- 전투 중이 아니었을 때에는 그냥 나가버림
			if info.state ~= self.battle_state.in_battle then
				return false
			end

			info.state = self.battle_state.done

			for i = 1, #info.teatan_groups do
				self:activate_group_wp_move(info.teatan_groups[i])
			end

			for i = 1, info.battle_gate_count do
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(info.battle_gate_name .. i))
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- 전투 시작
function eva_event_manager:activate_battle(info)
	if info.group_num == 4 then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_battle_boss', state = 'combat', mix = 0 })
	else
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_battle_normal', state = 'combat', mix = 0 })
	end

	for i = 1, info.invader_count do
		local monster = self.get_battle_invaders(info.group_num, i)

		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'enabled')

		command_util.execute_monster_notice(monster, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
	end

	for i = 1, info.battle_gate_count do
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(info.battle_gate_name .. i))
	end
end

--- 전투 완료 시 애들 뛰어나옴
function eva_event_manager:activate_group_wp_move(group_name)
	local group_data = self.controller.cached_npc_data[group_name]
	local req_id = self.controller.current_event_req_id

	--전투 끝나면 방 가운데로 뛰어와 대사 이후, 원라인.
	for npc, data in pairs(group_data) do
		-- 티탄인 경우만
		if self.controller.teatan_npcs[npc] then
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc, 'smile')

			if #data.wp_info.waypoints > 0 then
				character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'visible')

				wp_util.move(npc, data.wp_info.waypoints, 5, nil, {
					run = true, play_sfx = true, last_dir = data.wp_info.last_dir, callback = function(wp_index)
						if not self.super.super:is_done(req_id) and wp_index == (#data.wp_info.waypoints - 1) then
							character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

							--(smile, victory_extra)
							if data.wp_info.last_dir ~= nil then
								character_util.set_locked_dir(npc, data.wp_info.last_dir)
							end

							scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, 'victory_extra')

							--캔터베리 기사단장 만세!
							music_player_util.play_sfx({
								sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', parent = npc,
								type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
							})

							speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc, {
								key = data.talk_key,
								skip = false,
								lower_priority = true
							})

							npc.Interactable.Talk = data.talk_key
						end
					end
				})
			else
				if data.wp_info.last_dir ~= nil then
					character_util.set_direction(npc, data.wp_info.last_dir)
				end

				scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, 'victory_extra')
			end
		end
	end
end

function eva_event_manager:fail_scene()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	for zone_name, _ in pairs(self.zone_to_battle_info) do
		local info = self.zone_to_battle_info[zone_name]

		if info.state == self.battle_state.in_battle then
			for i = 1, info.battle_gate_count do
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(info.battle_gate_name .. i))
			end
		end
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })

	-- 전투에서 빠지게 만듦
	character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'visible')

	-- 리더 쓰러짐
	character_util.set_locked_dir(leader, direction_util.to_side_dir(leader.Direction))
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'damaged')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'dead', keep_anim = true })

	character_util.set_direction(leader, leader.LockedDirection)
	character_util.reset_locked_dir(leader)

	self.controller:fail_simulation_scene()

	self.in_screenplay = false
end

	for i = 1, self.search_interactable_count do
		local fo = self.get_search_interactable(i)

		fo.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('princess_search_interactable_pos_' .. i)

		self.search_interactable_hashset[fo] = true

		local twinkle_effect = self.get_fx_twinkle():Instantiate(
				fo.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, fo.Transform)
		self.twinkle_effects[i] = twinkle_effect

		fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function princess_event_manager:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.controller:disable_invaders()
	self.controller:disable_teatans()

	for i = 1, self.small_rock_count do
		self.super.super.get_small_rock(i).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	for i = 1, self.search_interactable_count do
		self.get_search_interactable(i).ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	self.is_first_search = true

	if not self:is_search_star_piece_eaten() then
		-- 숨겨져있는 위치 랜덤 돌림

		local rand_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, self.search_interactable_count)

		self.hidden_search_fo = self.get_search_interactable(rand_index)

	else
		self.hidden_search_fo = nil
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function princess_event_manager:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	for i = 1, self.small_rock_count do
		self.super.super.get_small_rock(i).Interactable = CS.Oak.SmallRockInteractable()
	end

	for i = 1, self.search_interactable_count do
		self.get_search_interactable(i).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	for i = 1, #self.trash_items do
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.trash_items[i])
	end

	self.trash_items = {}

	self.hidden_search_fo = nil

	local star_piece = self.get_search_star_piece()
	local star_piece_behaviour = star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour

	-- 인터랙트했지만 먹지 않고 나간 경우
	if not self:is_search_star_piece_eaten() and not star_piece_behaviour.IsHidden then
		-- 다시 비활성화 시켜줌
		star_piece_behaviour.IsHidden = true
		star_piece.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	self.super:exit()
end

function princess_event_manager:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	for i = 1, #self.trash_items do
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.trash_items[i])
	end

	self.trash_items = nil

	for i = 1, #self.twinkle_effects do
		self.twinkle_effects[i]:Dispose()
	end

	self.twinkle_effects = nil

	self.hidden_search_fo = nil
	self.small_rock_hashset = nil
	self.search_interactable_hashset = nil

	self.super:dispose()
end

function princess_event_manager:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.small_rock_hashset[e.Target] and not self.in_screenplay then
		self.in_screenplay = true

		start_coroutine(self.try_break_rock, self)
		return true

	elseif self.search_interactable_hashset[e.Target] and not self.in_screenplay then
		self.in_screenplay = true

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.try_search_star_piece, self, e.Target)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function princess_event_manager:try_break_rock()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local princess = get_party_leader()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(princess)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(princess, 0.02, 0.25)
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'damaged' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(princess, 'qs_virtual_simulator_95')

	party_util.reset_controllers()

	self.in_screenplay = false
end

function princess_event_manager:try_search_star_piece(target)
	--인터랙트 하면 내레이션 박스
	if self.is_first_search then
		self.is_first_search = false
		--가디언의 펫 특수 능력이 개방됩니다.(최초 1회만)
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_virtual_simulator_96' })
	end

	local search_probability =
	(self.hidden_search_fo ~= nil and self.hidden_search_fo.ActiveState == active_state('enabled')) and 33 or 0

	--특수 능력 : 반짝 찌리릿
	-- twinkle tingle(스파이더맨 피터 팅글 패러디)
	--가디언을 위해 반짝이는 걸 찾아낸다.(성공률 33%)
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_virtual_simulator_97', parameters = { search_probability } })

	local princess = get_party_leader()
	local is_left = princess.Position.x < target.Position.x

	character_util.set_direction(princess, is_left and 'right' or 'left')

	--공주 eat 1초
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc',
		duration = 1, fade_out_time = 0.3
	})
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(princess, 'eat')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(princess)

	target.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	--2가지 경우 존재
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.hidden_search_fo) then
		--이것들 중 하나는 스타피스가 튀어나온다.
		self:appear_search_star_piece(target.Position)

		--공주가 따로 먹어야 획득된다.
	else
		--쓰레기 스프라이트가 튀어나온다.
		self:appear_trash(target.Position)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--공주 tired, idle로 1초.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(princess, 'tired')
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_emotion(princess)

		--쓰레기 스프라이트는 충돌x 그 자리 그대로 남아있는다.
	end

	self.in_screenplay = false
end

function princess_event_manager:is_search_star_piece_eaten()
	return star_piece_util.has_star_piece('princess_search_star_piece')
end

function princess_event_manager:appear_search_star_piece(appear_pos)
	star_piece_util.appear(self.get_search_star_piece(), appear_pos, appear_pos)
end

function princess_event_manager:appear_trash(appear_pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')

	local trash_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = self.trash_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		pos = appear_pos, target = appear_pos,
	})

	trash_item.ConsumeTarget = nil

	table.insert(self.trash_items, trash_item)
end

--endregion Princess Event Manager

--endregion Ally

--endregion 지나가는 이벤트 매니저

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'simulator_open') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_interact

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.meet_invader_scene, self)

function local_class:meet_invader_scene()
	--들고 있던 물건을 내려 놓음
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		character_util.release_hold_object(leader, leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--방에 진입하면 인베이더 병사가(qs_invader_soldier - 스파인 리소스 나오는대로 수정 예정) 카메라 쉐이크와 함께 빔다운 해 등장한다.
	--가디언 무기 숨김 상태.
	--인베이더 병사(right, idle) : 드디어 나타났군.
	--인베이더 병사(left, dagger_idle) : 가디언!
	--인베이더 병사(gauntlet_combo_attack 반복) : 널 처치하기 위해 지옥과도 같은 훈련을 견뎌냈다!
	--인베이더 병사(bomb_idle) : 대 가디언 전투 훈련용 가상현실 시뮬레이터의 힘을 보여주마!
	--인베이더 병사(eyelight, dagger_idle) : 덤벼라!
	--가디언이 활베라를 꺼내자 인베이더 병사가 당황한다.
	--인베이더 병사(surprise, jump 2회) : 자, 잠깐만!
	--인베이더 병사(mad, release) : 대 가디언 전투 훈련용 가상현실 시뮬레이터에서 너는 검만 썼잖아!
	--가디언 question 이모티콘
	--인베이더 병사(attack, victory_get) : 정정당당하게 검으로 싸우자!
	--가디언 tired 표정, annoyed 이모티콘.
	--가디언 검베라를 꺼낸다.
	--QTE로 가디언이 공격을 3회 하지만 인베이더 병사는 모두 다 회피한다.
	--QTE 공격 3회
	--가디언 리베라 공격패턴 3단계를 QTE 각각 1회에 대응시킨다.
	--위 아래 오른쪽으로 슬라이드.
	--각각, sword_attack, sword_attack2, sword_attack_stab
	--인베이더는 idle 상태 유지.
	--카메라 줌인, 슬로우 걸어서 진행.
	--처음 sword_attack 진행 구도
	--인베이더는 순간이동 이펙트(FX_reset_object)와 함께 다음 위치로 이동.
	--두번째 sword_attack2 진행 구도
	--인베이더는 순간이동 이펙트와 함께 다음 위치로 이동.
	--세번째 sword_attack_stab 진행 구도
	--인베이더는 순간이동 이펙트와 함께 이벤트 첫 위치로 이동.
	--인베이더 병사(cast2) : 음하하! 너의 공격 패턴은 이미 모두 분석했다!
	--인베이더 병사(boong_attack_ready 1회) : 이게 바로!
	--애니메이션 끝난 후 진행.
	--인베이더 병사(boong_attack 1회) : 대 가디언 전투 훈련용 가상현실 시뮬레이터의 힘!
	--가디언 선택지
	--대 가디언… 뭐시기?(빨강)
	--인베이더 병사(nod) : 후후후… 넌 알 필요 없다!
	--역시 대 가디언 전투 훈련용 가상현실 시뮬레이터인가…(초록)
	--인베이더 병사(nod) : 후후후… 그래, 대 가디언 전투 훈련용 가상현실 시뮬레이터다!
	--인베이더 병사(dagger_idle) : 이제 내 공격을 받아라!
	--그 때 파이몬이 아래쪽에서 나타나 위쪽으로 사라지며, 인베이더 병사를 치고 지나간다.
	--인베이더 병사 airspin으로 사망하면서 아이템을 하나 떨어뜨린다.
	--paper_piece 스프라이트 사용, 새로 추가 필요
	timeline_util.play_async(self.controller.director_name, 'qs_simulator_pre_1')

	--인베이더 병사(dagger_idle) : 이제 내 공격을 받아라!
	local invader = get_character('simulator_invader')
	local pymon = get_character('simulator_pymon')
	local drop_pos = invader.Position
	local move_done = false

	-- FIXME : 연출 변경 대응을 위해 scene_util쓰지않음
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(invader, 'dagger_idle')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader, { key = 'qs_virtual_simulator_pre_16', skip = true })

	--그 때 파이몬이 아래쪽에서 나타나 위쪽으로 사라지며, 인베이더 병사를 치고 지나간다.
	character_util.set_position(pymon, field_util.get_marker_pos('simulator_pymon_appear'))

	local rush_fx = self.get_fx_flame_rush_loop():Instantiate(pymon.Position,
			unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0), pymon.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
	local area_fx = self.get_fx_flame_area():Instantiate(pymon.Position,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, pymon.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)

	local pymon_speed = 9
	local pymon_target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('simulator_pymon_disappear')
	local pymon_jump_duration = 4.5 / 9

	wp_util.move(pymon, pymon_target_pos, pymon_speed, nil, { callback = function(wp_index)
		move_done = wp_index == 0
	end })

	camera_util.shake(0.05, 9999)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_break_rock_earthquake_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_01')

	wait_for_sec(3.5 / pymon_speed)

	character_util.jump(pymon, 1.5, pymon_jump_duration)

	while pymon.Position.z < invader.Position.z - 0.7 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	stage_camera:Shake({ magnitude = 0.3, duration = 0.3, name = 'pymon_crash' })

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(invader)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(invader)

	--인베이더 병사 airspin으로 사망하면서
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lana_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_01')
	character_util.air_spin(invader, { offset = vector(3, 0, 0) })

	--아이템을 하나 떨어뜨린다.
	--paper_piece 스프라이트 사용, 새로 추가 필요
	self.paper_piece_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = 20022, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		pos = drop_pos, target = drop_pos
	})

	self.get_paper_interactable().Position = drop_pos

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	while not move_done do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	rush_fx:Dispose()
	area_fx:Dispose()

	quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(self.get_paper_interactable())

	character_util.set_active_state(pymon, 'disabled')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:open_substage_scene()
	quest_icon_util.remove(self.get_paper_interactable())

	self.get_paper_interactable().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	self.paper_piece_item.ConsumeTarget = get_party_leader()
	self.paper_piece_item:Fly()

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--떨어진 아이템에 인터랙트하면 서브스테이지 오픈.
	--나레이션 박스 : 훈련 시뮬레이터에 대한 정보를 얻었다.
	-- 월드맵에서 서브스테이지 오픈 연출 진행.
	--훈련 시뮬레이터 스테이지가 열렸습니다.
	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = self.controller.simulation_stage_name,
		substage_open_string_key = 'qs_virtual_simulator_pre_17'
	})

	quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipWorldMapData')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller@
		QuestName = QueenShipWorldMapData @
		Comment = 15 챕터 월드맵 데이터 저장용 퀘스트 @
]]
function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.constants_data = require('Frontend/QueenShipWorldMapConstants')

	self.all_open_obstacle_key_name = 'all_open_obstacle'
	self.total_custom_data_num = 21
end

-- 스테이지 로드가 완료되면 실행됨.
function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	yield_return_func(self.init_custom_state_setting, self)
end

function local_class:init_custom_state_setting()
	if CS.Oak.QuestReplaySystem.IsReplaying then
		return
	end

	if self.quest_progress == nil then
		return
	end

	local check_length = self.quest_progress.CustomStates.Count

	-- 필요한 커스텀 데이터 개수만큼 저장되어 있는지 확인, 및 기본 값으로 세팅
	if check_length >= self.total_custom_data_num then
		return
	end

	local data_dictionary = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Int32)
	local state_val = -1

	data_dictionary:Add(self.all_open_obstacle_key_name, state_val)

	-- 장애물 관련 기본 데이터 세팅 총 17개
	for k,v in pairs(self.constants_data.obstacle) do
		if not data_dictionary:ContainsKey(k) then
			-- data_quest_progress에 키가 있으면 해당 값, 없으면 -1
			state_val = self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(k)
			data_dictionary:Add(k, state_val)
		end
	end

	-- ammi 관련 기본 데이터 세팅 총 3개
	for k,v in pairs(self.constants_data.ammi) do
		local key_name = v.data_key_name

		if not data_dictionary:ContainsKey(key_name) then
			-- data_quest_progress에 키가 있으면 해당 값, 없으면 -1
			state_val = self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(key_name)
			data_dictionary:Add(key_name, state_val)
		end
	end

	local stage_custom = CS.Oak.StageCustom()
	stage_custom.QuestId = self.quest_progress.QuestId
	stage_custom.QuestCustomState = data_dictionary

	local req = CS.Oak.NetworkManager.ApiConnection:SendSetCustom(stage.StageId, stage_custom)
	              :Then(function(res)
		for k,v in pairs(data_dictionary) do
			user_progress:SetQuestCustomState(self.quest_progress, k, v)
		end
	end)

	coroutine.yield(req)
end

end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section1')
	}
end

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine()
end

-- 특별한 스테이지 시작 이벤트가 필요할 때 사용.
function local_class:need_on_launch()
	return false
end

-- need_on_launch의 반환값이 true인 경우에 불리는 콜백 함수
function local_class:on_launch()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil

	-- 컨트롤러 관련 변수 해제
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:setting_section()
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_pivot_pos')
		end,
	}

		spec = {
			pirate = 'pirate',
			staff = 'staff',
		}
	}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			return get_character(this.spec[key])
		end

end

end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	end)

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:opening_scene()
	local pirate = self.character.pirate
	local staff = self.character.staff
	local pivot_pos = self.pivot_pos.opening_scene()

	--화면 전환 전 세팅

	--카메라 이미지의 연두색 마름모 위치에 세팅
	camera_util.set_position(pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 3.5))

	--NPC 이미지의 위치에 배치

	--직원(down, idle, idle)
	staff.Position = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 1.5)
	scene_util.set_direction(staff, 'down', false)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(staff, active_state_type.enabled)

	--레이첼(up, idle, idle)
	pirate.Position = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)
	scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'up', false)

	--화면 2초간 페이드 인 시작
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(2, unity_class.color.black)

	--카메라 2초간 이미지의 노란색 마름모 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	camera_util.move_async(pivot_pos, 2)

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--직원(down, idle, idle): …그럼 마지막으로 확인하겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ww_angel_fruits_s1_1')

	--직원(down, idle, idle): 귀하께서는 미스터 플라밍고 님께서 주최하신 천사의 열매 쟁탈전 3종에 모두 참가 등록하셨습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ww_angel_fruits_s1_2')

	--직원(down, idle, idle): 승리하신 분들께는 매 경기마다 지정된 천사의 열매가 상품으로 지급되며….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ww_angel_fruits_s1_3')

	--직원(down, sleep_deep, nod 2회): 경기 도중 발생할 수 있는 모든 종류의 피해에 대해서 주최측은 일체 책임지지 않습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'sleep_deep', 'ww_angel_fruits_s1_4')

	--직원(down, idle, idle): 링네임은… 붉은 장미. 맞으십니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ww_angel_fruits_s1_5')

	--직원(down, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(staff, 'down', false)

	--레이첼(up, idle, nod 2회) 애니메이션 끝날 때까지 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(pirate, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	--레이첼

	--직원(down, idle, idle): …네. 이걸로 참가 접수 완료 됐습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ww_angel_fruits_s1_6')

	--직원(down, idle, idle): 오른쪽의 대기실로 가서 기다려 주세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(staff, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ww_angel_fruits_s1_7')

	--직원(down, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(staff, 'down', false)

	--레이첼(attack) 1초간 아래로 1칸 이동 시작
	local move_dur = 1
	local wp = pirate.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)

	--카메라 1초간 레이첼 도착 위치로 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	--이후 카메라 레이첼 따라감
	camera_util.move(wp, move_dur, { end_target = pirate })
	wp_util.move_async(pirate, wp, nil, move_dur, { run = false })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--레이첼(down, attack, nod 2회): 좋아. 여기서 천사의 열매를 얻고 해적왕의 전설을 시작하는거야…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'ww_angel_fruits_s1_8')

	--카메라 shake(0.3, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	--레이첼(right, attack, victory_extra, shout 말풍선, 말풍선 크기 1.2): 천사의 열매야, 기다려라! 붉은 장미 레이첼 님이 간다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(pirate, self, 'right',
			'victory_extra', 'attack',
			{ key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s1_9', scale = 1.2, skip = true })

	--레이첼 표정&애니메이션 제거

	--스테이지 시작 연출
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	music_player:PlayStageIntroMusic()
	screen_util.show_stage_title()
	scene_util.set_direction(pirate, direction_constants.right, false)

	scene_util.set_anim_async(pirate, self, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(pirate)

	--컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료
	self.controller:progress_section()
end

return local_class

--[[QuestAttribute

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

		waiting_room = 's2_waiting_room_in_pos',

	self.marker = setmetatable({}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			local name = marker_names[key]

			if name ~= nil then
				return field_util.get_marker_pos(name)
			end
		end
	})

	local character_names = {
		pirate = 'pirate',
		flamingo = 'flamingo',
		sabo = 'sabo',
		smoker = 'smoker',
		captain= 'blue_rose_captain',
		seaman_1 = 'blue_rose_seaman_1',
		seaman_2 = 'blue_rose_seaman_2',
		bad_golem = 'bad_golem',
		bad_human = 'bad_human',
		bad_mermaid = 'bad_mermaid',
		bad_ogre = 'bad_ogre',
		bad_hulk = 'bad_hulk'
	}

	self.character = setmetatable({}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			local name = character_names[key]

			if name ~= nil then
				return get_character(name)
			end

			return nil
		end
	})

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		fx_ww_spotlight = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_ww_spotlight')
		end,

	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.interact_npcs = {
		smoker = false,
		sabo = false
	}

	self.quest_id = 476

	self.quest_marker_key = 'angel_fruits_quest'

	self.is_quiz_time = false

	self.nowhere = vector(999,0,999)

	-- 커스텀 데이터 이름
	self.quiz_all_clear = 'quiz_all_clear'

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = {'substage_21_1'}

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()

end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self:npcs_setting()

	self.current_state = self.states.before_interact_inner
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller:dispose_audience()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_inner and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_waiting_room_inner()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.before_interact_npc

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.get_waiting_room_inner().Name)

		do
			local inner = self.get_waiting_room_inner()
			local move_info = CS.Oak.OpenPathInfo()
			move_info.OpenWaypoint = 's2_waiting_room_in_pos'
			inner.Interactable = CS.Oak.ExitInteractable()
			inner.Interactable.MoveStage = move_info
		end

		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_exit_scene, self)
		return true
 	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_npc and
			self.interact_npcs.smoker == false and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.character.smoker) then
		self.interact_npcs.smoker = true

		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.character.smoker, self.controller)

		start_coroutine(self.interact_smoker_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.before_interact_npc and
			self.interact_npcs.sabo == false and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.character.sabo) then
		self.interact_npcs.sabo = true
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.character.sabo, self.controller)

		start_coroutine(self.interact_sambo_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_exit_scene()
	local pirate = self.character.pirate

	--컨트롤 뻇길 때, BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 조절, 믹스 디폴트값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--이미지에 빨간색으로 표시한 exit와 상호작용시 이벤트 시작
	--화면 0.75초간 서큘러 페이드 아웃. 끝날 때까지 대기
	local fade_duration = 0.75
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(fade_duration, 'linear')

	do
		--레이첼(right, tired, idle) 이미지의 시작 위치에 세팅
		character_util.set_position(pirate, self.marker.waiting_room)

		scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(pirate, self, 'tired')

		--1초 대기
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	--화면 0.75초간 서큘러 페이드 인 시작
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(fade_duration, 'linear')

	--레이첼(tired) 1초간 이미지의 경로를 따라 이동. 끝날 때까지 대기
	do
		local pos = pirate.Position + vector(3,0,0)

		wp_util.move_async(pirate, pos, nil, 1)
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--레이첼 shake(0.03, 0.3)
	scene_util.shake(pirate, 0.03, 0.3)

	--레이첼(right, tired, idle): 으으… 다들 인상 한번 험악하네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self, 'right',
	nil, 'tired', 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_1')

	--레이첼 표정&애니메이션 제거
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pirate)

	--삼보 / 스모커 NPC에게 각각 서브 퀘스트 마커
	do
		local smoker = self.character.smoker
		local sabo = self.character.sabo

		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key, {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = smoker }
		}, smoker.name, self.quest_id, false)
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key, {
			{ zone = 'main_field', target = sabo },
		}, sabo.name, self.quest_id, false)
	end

	--컨트롤 회복. 이벤트 종료

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end
