function local_class:check_interact_end()
	local clear = true

	for _, npc_interact in pairs(self.interact_npcs) do
		if npc_interact == false then
			clear = false
		end
	end

	if clear then
		self:interact_npcs_end_scene()

		return true
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_npcs_end_scene()

	local flamingo = self.character.flamingo

function local_class:quiz_scene()
	local pirate = self.character.pirate
	local captain = self.character.captain
	local flamingo = self.character.flamingo
	local sabo = self.character.sabo
	local seaman = self.character.seaman_1
	local bad_human = self.character.bad_human
	local bad_hulk = self.character.bad_hulk
	--화면 가려진 동안 세팅

	--NPC 이미지의 위치에 세팅
	character_util.set_position(pirate, self.marker.pirate_quiz_pos)
	character_util.set_position(captain, self.marker.captain_quiz_pos)
	character_util.set_position(sabo, self.marker.sabo_quiz_pos)
	character_util.set_position(seaman, self.marker.seaman_quiz_pos)
	character_util.set_position(bad_human, self.marker.bad_human_quiz_pos)
	character_util.set_position(bad_hulk, self.marker.bad_hulk_quiz_pos)
	character_util.set_position(flamingo, self.marker.flamingo_quiz_pos)

	--레이첼(down, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pirate, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(pirate)

	--회색 수염(down, attack, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(captain, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(captain, self, 'attack')

	--해적 단원(down, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(seaman, 'down', false)

	--삼보(down, attack, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(sabo, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(sabo, self, 'attack')

	--불량배 인간(down, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(bad_human, 'down', false)

	--불량배 헐크(down, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(bad_hulk, 'down', false)

	--미스터 플라밍고(down, doyagao, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(flamingo, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(flamingo, self, 'doyagao')

	--NPC 전원 90% 검은색으로 틴트 처리
	local npcs_table = {
		pirate, captain, seaman, sabo, bad_hulk, bad_human, flamingo
	}
	local tint_magnitude = 0.9

	for index = 1, table_util.get_size(npcs_table) do
		local npc = npcs_table[index]

		character_util.add_color(npc, npc.Name, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), tint_magnitude, 0)
		npc.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
	end

	--배경 70% 검은색으로 틴트 처리
	local tint_key = 'black_tint'
	field:Tint(tint_key, unity_color({0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1}), 0.1)

	--카메라 미스터 플라밍고 위치에 세팅
	--이후 카메라 미스터 플라밍고 따라다님
	camera_util.move_async(flamingo.Position, 0.1)

	--카메라 크기 2.5로 세팅
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.5, 0.1)

	self.controller:create_audience()

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라 1초간 페이드 인. 끝날 때까지 대기
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--미스터 플라밍고 위치에 fx_ww_spotlight 이펙트 생성 0.5배
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_spotlight_01')
	local loop_spotlight = self.fx.fx_ww_spotlight():Instantiate(flamingo.Position)
	loop_spotlight.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

	--미스터 플라밍고 0.1초간 틴트 처리 해제 시작
	character_util.remove_color(flamingo, flamingo.name, 0.1)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	--미스터 플라밍고(down, doyagao, idle): 신사 숙녀 여러분. 오래 기다리셨습니다….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flamingo, self, 'down',
			nil, { name = 'doyagao', keep = true }, 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_41')

	--카메라 shake(0.2, 0.1)
	camera_util.shake(0.2,0.1)

	--미스터 플라밍고(down, doyagao, bomb_idle, shout 말풍선): 지금 바로 시작합니다! 화끈화끈 열매를 걸고 펼쳐지는…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(flamingo, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'bomb_idle', keep = true }, nil, 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_42')

	--NPC 전원 0.1초간 틴트 처리 해제 시작
	do
		local duration = 0.1
		for index = 1, table_util.get_size(npcs_table) do
			local npc = npcs_table[index]

			character_util.remove_color(npc, npc.name, duration)
		end

		--배경 0.1초간 틴트 처리 해제 시작
		field:RemoveTint(tint_key, duration)
	end

	--틴트 처리 해제 완료 후 fx_ww_spotlight 이펙트 제거
	loop_spotlight:Dispose()

	--카메라 0.1초간 위로 1칸 이동 시작
	--async 아님
	do
		local pos = flamingo.Position + vector(0,0,1)

		camera_util.move(pos, 0.1)
	end

	--카메라 줌아웃(5.5, 0.1) async 아님
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5.5, 0.1)

	--카메라 shake(0.4, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.4,0.3)

	--미스터 플라밍고(shout 말풍선, 말풍선 크기 1.3, 위치 vector(0.5, 0.75)): 도전! 해적 퀴즈왕!!!
	--위 대사와 함께 BGM 재생, 믹스 1초
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'ondemand/v3_21_waterworld/audio:bgm_waterworld_arena_rollout', mix = 1})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01', 0.8)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_arena_exclamation_03', 0.8)
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(flamingo, self, nil,
			nil, nil,
			{ key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_43', skip = true, viewport_pos = vector(0.5,0.75), scale = 1.3 })

	--(여)관객(shout 말풍선, 위치 vector(0.3, 0.6)): 와아아아아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_arena_exclamation_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(flamingo, self, nil,
			nil, nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_44', skip = true, viewport_pos = vector(0.3,0.6) })

	--(남)관객(shout 말풍선, 위치 vector(0.8, 0.5)): 회색 수염! 회색 수염!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(flamingo, self, nil,
			nil, nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_45', skip = true, viewport_pos = vector(0.8, 0.5) })

	--(남)관객(shout 말풍선, 위치 vector(0.4, 0.3)): 빨간 놈 이겨라! 난 너한테 걸었어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_arena_exclamation_02')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(flamingo, self, nil,
			nil, nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_46', skip = true, viewport_pos = vector(0.4,0.3) })

	--카메라 줌인(4, 1) async 아님
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6, 3)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)

	--1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--레이첼(down, tired, idle): …뭐야, 이게?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self, 'down',
			nil, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_47')

	--미스터 플라밍고(left, doyagao, release): 어깨에 힘 좀 주고 다닌다는 해적들이 얌전히 앉아서 퀴즈나 푸는 꼴이라니….
	scene_util.set_direction(flamingo, 'left', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flamingo, self, nil,
			'release', { name = 'doyagao', keep = true }, 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_48')

	--미스터 플라밍고(left, doyagao, bomb_idle): 정말 언제봐도 질리지가 않는다니까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_laugh_at_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flamingo, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_49')

	--삼보(down, attack, idle): …악취미군.

			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_51')

	--카메라 shake(0.2, 0.1)

	--미스터 플라밍고(down, doyagao, bomb_idle): 각설하고! 바로 시작해 보도록 하겠습니다.

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'bgm_arena_master', volume = 0.6, mix = 3})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flamingo, self, 'down',
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_52')

	--미스터 플라밍고(down, doyagao, idle): 바닷사람들에 대해 말할 때 배를 때놓을수가 없겠죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flamingo, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_53')

	--미스터 플라밍고(down, doyagao, nod 2회): 별무리섬에서는 매년 최고의 선장을 뽑는 밀키웨이 레이싱이란 대회가 열리는데요….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(flamingo, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_54')

	--카메라 shake(0.2, 0.1)
	camera_util.shake(0.2,0.1)

	--레이첼(down, smile, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(pirate, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(pirate, self, 'smile')

	--미스터 플라밍고(down, doyagao, twohand_attack3 1회, 마지막 프레임 대기, shout 말풍선): 그렇다면! 밀키웨이 레이싱의 102회 우승팀은 어디일까요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(flamingo, self, nil,
			{ name = 'twohand_attack3', loop = false }, nil, 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_55')

	--미스터 플라밍고(down, doyagao, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(flamingo, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(flamingo, self, 'doyagao')

	--회색 수염(down, attack, idle): 뭐, 뭐야? 이걸 내가 어떻게 알아?

			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_56')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pirate, self, 'down',
			nil, { name = 'doyagao', keep = true }, 'ww_angel_fruits_s2_57')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	field_ui_util.show_ui({
		hide_target = CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState,
		hide_minimap = true,
		hide_navigation_bar = true,
	})

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, captain)
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, flamingo)
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, sabo)
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, seaman)
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, bad_human)
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, bad_hulk)

	timer_util.start_timer({
		duration = timer_duration, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished', show_ui = true
	})

	--(normal) 소히와 고릴라즈
	--(normal) 붉은 장미 해적단
	--(normal) 마계 레이디스

function local_class:choose_event(branch_datas, reaction_func)
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	local wait = true
	local result = -1

	for i, data in ipairs(branch_datas) do
		local branch = {}
		local text

		local predicate_result = true
		local predicate = data[4]

		if predicate ~= nil then
			if type(predicate) == 'function' then
				predicate_result = predicate()
			elseif type(predicate) == 'boolean' then
				predicate_result = predicate
			end
		end

		if predicate_result then
			if type_util.is_array(data[1]) then
				text = game_string:FormatWithReservedKeywords(table.unpack(data[1]))
			else
				text = game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(data[1])
			end

			branch.Text = text
			branch.Tendency = choose_util.get_tendency(data[2])
			branch.Callback = function()
				wait = false
				result = i
			end

			branches:Add(branch)
		end
	end

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party_leader, branches)

	while wait and self.is_quiz_time do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

	if not self.is_quiz_time then
		ui_scene_manager:PopOverlay()
		return false
	end

	-- 체인된 콜백이 있으면 호출해줌.
	local chained_cb = branch_datas[result][3]
	if chained_cb ~= nil then
		chained_cb()
	end

	local reaction = choose_util.get_leader_reaction(reaction_func)
	if reaction ~= nil then
		reaction()
	end

	return result
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.start_scene(self.opening, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	timer_util.end_timer(self)

	self.blockaura_red_boss_effect:Dispose()

	self.controller:dispose_audience()

	if self.dynamic_npc then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_npc)
		self.dynamic_npc = nil
	end

	for i = 1, #self.npcs do
		local npc = self.npcs[i]
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		npc.Interactable.Talk = nil
		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
		npc.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.end_opening and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.arena_entrance) then
		self.current_state = self.states.enter_arena
		start_coroutine(self.enter_arena, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.sabo_event_data.is_playing and not self.sabo_event_data.is_ended and self.current_state ~= self.states.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_field') then

		start_coroutine(self.sabo_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.sabo_event_data.is_playing and not self.sabo_event_data.is_ended and
		type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_field') then

		if self.fire_harpy_emoticon then
			self.fire_harpy_emoticon:Clear()
			self.fire_harpy_emoticon = nil
		end

		if self.burning_skull_emoticon then
			self.burning_skull_emoticon:Clear()
			self.burning_skull_emoticon = nil
		end

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.character.sabo)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.character.fire_harpy)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.character.burning_skull)

		self:sabo_event_setting()
		self.sabo_event_data.is_playing = false
		self.sabo_event_data.current_request = self.sabo_event_data.current_request + 1

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 시간 제할 끝났거나 도중에
function local_class:timer_finished(e)
	if self.is_end_mini_game then
		return
	end

	-- 새로운 패턴 추가
	if not e.IsComplete then
		start_coroutine(self.random_attack_range_action, self)
		return
	end

	timer_util.end_timer(self)

	self.is_end_mini_game = true

	self.attack_range:destroy(self.character.pirate)
	self.attack_range:destroy(self.character.flamingo)

	start_coroutine(self.success, self)
end

function local_class:smoker_evasion_routine()
	local smoker = self.character.smoker
	local center = self.get_arena_pos(6)

	local wp = {
		center + vector(-1.5, 0, 1.5),
		center + vector(-1.5, 0, -1.5),
		center + vector(1.5, 0, -1.5),
		center + vector(1.5, 0, 1.5),
	}

	self.smoker_run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_dash_01',
		loop = true,
		parent = smoker,
		volume = 0.7
	})

	scene_util.set_emotion(smoker, self, 'attack')
	wp_util.move(smoker, wp, 5, nil, { end_type = 'loop', run = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	while not self.is_end_mini_game do
		local target_pos = center - smoker.Position + center
		self:gunshot_action(target_pos, true)

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end
end

--- 랜덤 위치에 생성 되는 attack_range
function local_class:random_attack_range_action()
	local pirate = self.character.pirate
	local flamingo = self.character.flamingo

	local center = self.get_arena_pos(5)

	while not self.is_end_mini_game do
		local rand_x = random_util.get_random_int((center.x - 2) * 100, (center.x + 2) * 100) * 0.01
		local rand_z = random_util.get_random_int((center.z - 2) * 100, (center.z + 2) * 100) * 0.01
		local target_pos = vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z)

		self.attack_range:set_pos_and_show(flamingo, target_pos, 2)
		wait_for_sec(2)

		self.attack_range:hide(flamingo)

		if self.is_end_mini_game then
			return
		end

		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)

		if (target_pos - pirate.Position).sqrMagnitude <= 1 then
			self:fail(target_pos)
			return
		end

		self:gunshot_action(target_pos)

		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	end
end

--- 원형 총탄 연출
function local_class:gunshot_action(target_pos, is_mute_sfx)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time

	local sfx

	if not is_mute_sfx then
		sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_05',
			loop = true,
			volume = 0.7
		})
	end

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < 0.5 do
		local rad = math.pi * random_util.get_random_value() * 2
		local target_x = math.cos(rad) * random_util.get_random_int(0, 100) * 0.01
		local target_z = math.sin(rad) * random_util.get_random_int(0, 100) * 0.01

		self.fx.gunshot():Instantiate(target_pos + vector(target_x, 0, target_z))
		wait_for_sec(0.025)
	end

	if sfx then
		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(sfx, 0.5)
	end
end

function local_class:sabo_event()
	self.sabo_event_data.is_playing = true

	local request_index = self.sabo_event_data.current_request

	local sabo = self.character.sabo
	local fire_harpy = self.character.fire_harpy
	local burning_skull = self.character.burning_skull

	local play_sfx = function(target, sfx_name)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = sfx_name,
			parent = target,
			type_priority = 'event',
			player_priority = 'npc'
		})
	end

	--삼보(left, attack, boong_attack_ready_loop): 하아압…! 이게 화끈화끈 열매의 힘…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sabo, self, 'left',
		nil, nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s3_4' })

	if request_index ~= self.sabo_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--신틸라&미야 동시에 silence 이모티콘 출력
	self.fire_harpy_emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon(fire_harpy, nil, 'silence')
	self.burning_skull_emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon(burning_skull, nil, 'silence')
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	if request_index ~= self.sabo_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--삼보(left, tired, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sabo)
	scene_util.set_emotion(sabo, self, 'tired')

	--신틸라(right, tired, release): …그게 다야? 몸에서 불 나오는게?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_harpy, self, 'right',
		'release', nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s3_5' })

	if request_index ~= self.sabo_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--불타는 전사(right, idle, cast): 나처럼?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(burning_skull, self, 'right',
		'cast', nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s3_6' })

	if request_index ~= self.sabo_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--삼보(left, tired, bomb_idle): 아니, 뭐… 또 불을 조작한다던가, 불을 쏜다던가….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sabo, self, 'left',
		'bomb_idle', nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s3_7' })

	if request_index ~= self.sabo_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--불타는 전사(left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(burning_skull, 'left', false)

	--신틸라(left, tired, idle): 이런거?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_harpy, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false },
		nil, nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s3_8' })

	if request_index ~= self.sabo_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--신틸라 위치에 fx_cwp_fireharpy_cast 이펙트 생성
	self.fx.fireharpy_cast():Instantiate(fire_harpy.Position)

	--신틸라(left, attack, gauntlet_boong_attack_ready, 애니메이션 속도 1.6)
	scene_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, self, 'attack')
	play_sfx(fire_harpy, '02_fire_harpy_charge_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, self, { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack_ready', loop = false, scale = 1.6 })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if request_index ~= self.sabo_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--신틸라(left, attack, gauntlet_boong_attack 1회, 애니메이션 속도 1.6, 마지막 프레임 대기)
	--신틸라 위치에 fx_cwp_fireharpy_fire 이펙트 180도 회전시켜 생성
	--이펙트 진행방향이 왼쪽이 되도록
	play_sfx(fire_harpy, '02_fire_harpy_explosion_02')
	local fire_effect = self.fx.fireharpy_fire():Instantiate(fire_harpy.Position)
	fire_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)

	scene_util.set_anim(fire_harpy, self, { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack', loop = false, scale = 1.6 })

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if request_index ~= self.sabo_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--신틸라(left, tired, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim(fire_harpy)
	scene_util.set_emotion(fire_harpy, self, 'tired')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if request_index ~= self.sabo_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--신틸라(right, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(fire_harpy, 'right', false)

	--불타는 전사(right, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(burning_skull, 'right', false)

	--삼보(left, tired, cast): 어….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(sabo, self, 'left',
		{ name = 'cast', keep = true }, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s3_9' })

	if request_index ~= self.sabo_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--신틸라(right, tired, release): …아무래도 사기 당한 것 같은데, 너.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(fire_harpy, self, 'right',
		'release', nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s3_10' })

	if request_index ~= self.sabo_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--불타는 전사(right, idle, idle): 힘내….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(burning_skull, self, 'right',
		nil, nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s3_11' })

	if request_index ~= self.sabo_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	sabo.Interactable.Talk = 'ww_angel_fruits_s3_9'
	fire_harpy.Interactable.Talk = 'ww_angel_fruits_s3_10'
	burning_skull.Interactable.Talk = 'ww_angel_fruits_s3_11'

	self.sabo_event_data.is_ended = true
end

	self.fx:load_async()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.start_scene(self.opening, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.controller:dispose_audience()

	for i = 1, #self.npcs do
		local npc = self.npcs[i]
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		npc.Interactable.Talk = nil
		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
		npc.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	local smoker = self.character.smoker
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(smoker, 1, 0)
	smoker.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.end_opening and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.field_object.arena_entrance) then
		self.current_state = self.states.enter_arena
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_arena, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.smoker_event_data.is_playing and not self.smoker_event_data.is_ended and self.current_state ~= self.states.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_field') then

		start_coroutine(self.smoker_event, self)
		return true
	end

	if not self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.is_playing and not self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.is_ended and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's4_event_zone') then

		start_coroutine(self.blue_rose_captain_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.smoker_event_data.is_playing and not self.smoker_event_data.is_ended and
		type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_field') then

		local smoker = self.character.smoker
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(smoker)
		smoker.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

		local bad_golem = self.character.bad_golem
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(bad_golem)
		character_util.stop(bad_golem)

		if self.bad_golem_emoticon then
			self.bad_golem_emoticon:Clear()
			self.bad_golem_emoticon = nil
		end

		self:smoker_event_setting()
		self.smoker_event_data.is_playing = false
		self.smoker_event_data.current_request = self.smoker_event_data.current_request + 1
		return true
	end

	if self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.is_playing and not self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.is_ended and
		type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_field') then

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.character.blue_rose_captain)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.character.blue_rose_seaman_1)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.character.blue_rose_seaman_2)

		self:blue_rose_captain_event_setting()
		self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.is_playing = false
		self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.current_request = self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.current_request + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.enter_arena and e.BattleGroupName == 's4_battle' then
		self.current_state = self.states.end_battle
		start_coroutine(self.end_battle, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:smoker_event()

	local request_index = self.smoker_event_data.current_request

	local smoker = self.character.smoker
	local bad_golem = self.character.bad_golem

	--스모커(right, attack, release): 뭐야? 뭘 꼬나봐?

		'release', { name = 'attack', keep = true }, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_3' })

	if request_index ~= self.smoker_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--불량배 골렘(left, idle, idle) question 이모티콘 출력
	self.bad_golem_emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon(bad_golem, nil, 'question')
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	if request_index ~= self.smoker_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--스모커(right, attack, idle): 하, 해적 주제에 건방지게 무시를 해…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(smoker, self, 'right',
		nil, nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_4' })

	if request_index ~= self.smoker_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--스모커(right, attack, boong_attack_ready_loop): 마침 잘 됐군. 새로 얻은 능력을 시험해 볼 상대가 필요했는데 말이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(smoker, self, 'right',
		{ name = 'boong_attack_ready_loop', keep = true }, nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_5' })

	if request_index ~= self.smoker_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--스모커(right, attack, boong_attack_ready_loop, shout 말풍선, 말풍선 크기 1.2): 간다! 구름구름 블로우!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_coop_matched_01',
		parent = smoker,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(smoker, self, 'right',

	local is_play_punch = true

			loop = true,
			type_priority = 'event',
			player_priority = 'npc'
		})

		while is_play_punch and request_index == self.smoker_event_data.current_request do
			local offset = vector(random_util.get_random_int(0, 3), 0, random_util.get_random_int(0, 3)) * 0.1
			self.fx.jump_smoke():Instantiate(smoker.Position + vector(0.5, 2, -1) + offset)
			wait_for_sec(0.1)
		end

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(loop_sfx)
	end)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if request_index ~= self.smoker_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--불량배 골렘(left, idle, idle) question 이모티콘 출력
	self.bad_golem_emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon(bad_golem, nil, 'question')
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	if request_index ~= self.smoker_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--스모커의 주먹질 루틴 종료
	is_play_punch = false
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(smoker)
	scene_util.set_emotion(smoker, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(smoker, self, 'cast')

	--스모커(right, tired, cast): 허억… 허억….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(smoker, self, 'right',
		nil, nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_6_1' })

	if request_index ~= self.smoker_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--불량배 골렘(left, idle, idle): 화장실….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bad_golem, self, 'left',
		nil, nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_7' })

	if request_index ~= self.smoker_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--스모커의 주먹질 루틴 종료
	--스모커(right, damaged, damaged)
	scene_util.set_emotion(smoker, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(smoker, self, 'damaged')

	--골렘 이미지의 경로를 따라 4의 속도로 달려서 이동 시작
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_anim(bad_golem, self, 'run')
		field_object_util.set_active_state(bad_golem, active_state_type.visible)

		local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_03',
			parent = bad_golem,
			loop = true,
			type_priority = 'event',
			player_priority = 'npc'
		})

		local wp = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(bad_golem, self.marker.start_pos, { x = bad_golem.Position.x - 3 })
		wp_util.move_async(bad_golem, wp, 4)

		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(run_sfx, 0.5)

		if request_index ~= self.smoker_event_data.current_request then
			return
		end

		--이동 완료 후 run 애니메이션 유지한 채 0.5초간 완전히 투명해지며 사라짐
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(bad_golem, 0, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		if request_index ~= self.smoker_event_data.current_request then
			return
		end

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(bad_golem, 1, 0)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bad_golem)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(bad_golem, active_state_type.disabled)
	end)

	--스모커 위치에 fx_kanna_transform_smoke 이펙트 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_villain_explosion_01',
		parent = smoker,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	self.fx.role_smoke():Instantiate(smoker.Position)

	--스모커 0.5초간 완전히 투명해지며 사라짐
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(smoker, 0, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if request_index ~= self.smoker_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	smoker.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		nil, nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_7_1' })

	end

function local_class:blue_rose_captain_event()
	self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.is_playing = true

	local request_index = self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.current_request

	local blue_rose_captain = self.character.blue_rose_captain
	local blue_rose_seaman_1 = self.character.blue_rose_seaman_1
	local blue_rose_seaman_2 = self.character.blue_rose_seaman_2

	--회색 수염(left, attack, release): 멍청한 놈들! 이제 한 경기밖에 안남았잖아!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(blue_rose_captain, self, 'left',
		'release', nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_11' })

	if request_index ~= self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--회색 수염(left, attack, cast2): 여기 오는데만도 얼마를 썼는데… 이번 경기도 지면 너네 싹 다 각오해!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(blue_rose_captain, self, 'left',
		'cast2', nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_12' })

	if request_index ~= self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--해적 단원 1(right, tired, bomb_idle): 아니, 이런 경기를 할 줄 저희가 어떻게….
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(blue_rose_seaman_1, self, 'right',
		'bomb_idle', nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_13' })

	if request_index ~= self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--해적 단원 1(down, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(blue_rose_seaman_1)
	scene_util.set_direction(blue_rose_seaman_1, 'down', false)

	--해적 단원 2(right, doyagao, cross_arm): 잠깐. 꼭 경기를 이길 필요는 없잖아요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_rustle_01',
		parent = blue_rose_seaman_2,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(blue_rose_seaman_2, self, 'right',
		{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true, one_shot_sfx = false }, { name = 'doyagao', keep = true },
		{ key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_14' })

	if request_index ~= self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.current_request then
		return
	end

	--회색 수염(left, attack, idle): 오호…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(blue_rose_captain, self, 'left',
		nil, nil, { key = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_15' })

	blue_rose_captain.Interactable.Talk = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_15'
	blue_rose_seaman_1.Interactable.Talk = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_15_1'
	blue_rose_seaman_2.Interactable.Talk = 'ww_angel_fruits_s4_14'

	self.blue_rose_captain_event_data.is_ended = true
end

local local_class = newclass('WaterWorldCalypsoPastRecordSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = WaterWorldCalypsoPastRecord @
		Comment = @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type WaterWorldCalypsoPastRecordController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = { 'waterworld_6' }

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		past_calypso = 1,
		section_end = 2,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.past_calypso

	-- npc
	self.character = setmetatable({
		spec = {
		}
	}, {
		__index = function(this, key)
			return get_character(this.spec[key])
		end
	})

	self.zone_name = {
		trigger_calypso_flashback = 'trigger_calypso_flashback',
	}

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		camera_pos = function(scene_idx, pos_idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('past_calypso_camera_' .. scene_idx .. '_' .. pos_idx)
		end,

		wrestler = function(scene_idx, pos_idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('past_calypso_wrestler_' .. scene_idx .. '_' .. pos_idx)
		end,

		calypso = function(scene_idx, pos_idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('past_calypso_calypso_' .. scene_idx .. '_' .. pos_idx)
		end,

		prisoner = function(scene_idx, pos_idx)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('past_calypso_prisoner_' .. scene_idx .. '_' .. pos_idx)
		end,
	}

	self.dyn_npcs = {
		[self.states.past_calypso] = nil,
	}

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		calypso_blueproj = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_calypso_blueproj')
		end,

		calypso_blueproj_explosion = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_calypso_blueproj_explosion')
		end,

		calypso_teleport = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_calypso_teleport')
		end,

		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
	})

	self.dissolver = nil

	--환경음
	self.ambi_sfx = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()

	self.dissolver = get_or_create_global_table('utils/SpineCharacterDissolver')
	self.dissolver:load_async('ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/theatres/dissolve', 'dissolve_material_container')
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	start_coroutine(self.set_pre_npc, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil

	if self.ambi_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.ambi_sfx)
		self.ambi_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.dyn_npcs ~= nil then
		for key, npcs in pairs(self.dyn_npcs) do
			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(npcs)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zone_name.trigger_calypso_flashback)
			and self.current_state == self.states.past_calypso then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.play_calypso_flashback, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--region npc setting
function local_class:create_dyn_npcs(event_step, dyn_npcs)
	self.dyn_npcs[event_step] = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(dyn_npcs)
end

function local_class:set_pre_npc()
	self:create_dyn_npcs(self.states.past_calypso,
			{
				past_wrestler = 'ww_wrestler_initial',
				past_calypso = 'ww_boss_npc',
				past_prisoner = 'ww_bad_mermaid',
			}
	)

	-- npc 초기 셋팅 데이터 테이블
	self.pre_npc_data = {
		[self.states.past_calypso] = {
			{
				pos = self.markers.wrestler(1, 1),
				dyn_npc_name = 'past_wrestler',
				dir = 'down',

				alpha_value = 0.5,
			},

			{
				pos = self.markers.wrestler(1, 1),
				dyn_npc_name = 'past_calypso',
				dir = 'down',

				alpha_value = 0.5,
			},

			{
				pos = self.markers.prisoner(1, 1),
				dyn_npc_name = 'past_prisoner',
				dir = 'up',
				anim = 'bomb_idle',

				alpha_value = 0.5,
			},
		},
	}

	self:set_current_scene_npc()

	self:hide_calypso(0.1, false)
end

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc()
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[self.current_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = nil

		npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.dyn_npc_name ~= nil then
				local dyn_npc_list = self.dyn_npcs[self.current_state]
				npc = dyn_npc_list[npc_data.dyn_npc_name]
			else
				if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
					npc = user_party.Leader
				else
					return
				end
			end
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.interaction then
			npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		end

		if npc_data.string ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.string) then
			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.string
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.weapon_1_id then

---@class WWNpcPoolingGroupManager
local local_class = newclass('WWNpcPoolingGroupManager')

---@class WWNpcPoolingGroupBase
local event_group_base = newclass('WWNpcPoolingGroupBase')

---@class WWNpcPoolingGroup : WWNpcPoolingGroupBase
---@field super WWNpcPoolingGroupBase

---@return WWNpcPoolingGroupBase
local function make_event_group(name)
	return newclass('WWNpcPoolingGroup' .. name, event_group_base)
end

local event_groups = {
}

local dispose_actions = {
	speech = function(npc)
		local bubble = speech_bubble.instance:Get(npc)

		if bubble ~= nil then
			bubble:ResetBubble()
		end
	end
}

local get_position = function(data)
	if type_util.is_table(data) then
		return field_util.get_marker_pos(data.pivot) + data.offset
	else
		return field_util.get_marker_pos(data)
	end
end

function local_class:init()
	---@type table<string, WWNpcPoolingGroup>
	self.event_groups = {}

	self.main_quest_id = 465

	self.cur_zone_name = ''

	self.is_pause = false
end

function local_class:initialize()
	local _, npc_pooling_system = global_table_util.try_create_npc_pooling_system()

	local init_event_groups = function(pooling_constants)
		for group_name, group_constants in pairs(pooling_constants) do
			local creator = event_groups[group_name] or event_group_base

			self.event_groups[group_name] = {}

			for key, v in pairs(group_constants) do
				local group = creator(npc_pooling_system, v)
				self.event_groups[group_name][key] = group
			end
		end
	end

	local pooling_constants = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Main/WaterWorld/Common/WWNpcPoolingGroupConstant')
	npc_pooling_system:init_pools(pooling_constants.pools)
	init_event_groups(pooling_constants.groups)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent), 'on_quest_cleared_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	for key, v in pairs(self.event_groups) do
		for _, group in pairs(v) do
			self:deactivate_group(group)
			group:dispose()
		end

		self.event_groups[key] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId ~= self.main_quest_id then
		return false
	end

	return self:on_quest_condition_changed()
end

function local_class:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	if e.QuestId ~= self.main_quest_id then
		return false
	end

	return self:on_quest_condition_changed()
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
		return false
	end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self.cur_zone_name == zone_name then
		return false
	end

	local is_contain_zone = false

	for key, _ in pairs(self.event_groups) do
		if key == zone_name then
			is_contain_zone = true
			break
		end
	end

	if not is_contain_zone then
		return false
	end

	self.cur_zone_name = zone_name
	self:reset_group()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_quest_condition_changed(overriden_progress, overriden_cleared)
	self:reset_group(overriden_progress, overriden_cleared)

	return true
end

function local_class:reset_group(overriden_progress, overriden_cleared)
	if self.is_pause then
		return
	end

	local main_quest = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.main_quest_id)

	local progress = -1
	local cleared = false

	if main_quest ~= nil then
		progress = main_quest.InnerProgress
		cleared = main_quest.IsComplete
	end

	if overriden_progress ~= nil then
		progress = overriden_progress
	end

	if overriden_cleared ~= nil then
		cleared = overriden_cleared
	end

	local groups_to_init = {}
	local groups_to_dispose = {}

	for key, v in pairs(self.event_groups) do
		for group_name, group in pairs(v) do
			local is_activated = group.activated
			local is_valid = key == self.cur_zone_name and group:is_valid_condition(progress, cleared)

			if not is_activated and is_valid then
				table.insert(groups_to_init, group)
			elseif is_activated and not is_valid then
				table.insert(groups_to_dispose, group)
			end
		end
	end

	for _, group_name in ipairs(groups_to_dispose) do
		self:deactivate_group(group_name)
	end

	for _, group_name in ipairs(groups_to_init) do
		self:activate_group(group_name)
	end
end

function local_class:activate_group(group)
	if group == nil or group.activated then
		return
	end

	group.activated = true
	group:enter()
end

function local_class:deactivate_group(group)
	if group == nil or not group.activated then
		return
	end

	group:exit()
	group.activated = false
end

---@return WWNpcPoolingGroup
function local_class:get_group(zone_name, group_name)
	local groups = self.event_groups[zone_name]

	if groups == nil then
		return nil
	end

	for key, group in pairs(groups) do
		if key == group_name and group ~= nil and group.activated then
			return group
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:set_group_callback(zone_name, group_name, callback)
	local groups = self.event_groups[zone_name]

	if groups == nil then
		return
	end

	for key, group in pairs(groups) do
		if key == group_name and group ~= nil then
			group:set_callback(callback)
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:activate_group_by_zone_name(zone_name)
	local groups = self.event_groups[zone_name]

	if groups == nil then
		return nil
	end

	for key, group in pairs(groups) do
		if group ~= nil and not group.activated then
			self:activate_group(group)
		end
	end
end

		self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

		self.callback = nil

		if pooling_constants ~= nil then
			self.condition_data = pooling_constants.condition
			self.member_infos = pooling_constants.members
		end
	end

	function event_group_base:dispose()
		self.npc_pooling_system = nil
		self.condition_data = nil
		self.member_infos = nil
	end

	function event_group_base:is_valid_condition(progress, cleared)
		if self.condition_data == nil then
			return false
		end

		for i = 1, #self.condition_data.progress_infos do
			local info = self.condition_data.progress_infos[i]

			if info.from == cleared_value then
				if cleared then
					return true
				end
			elseif info.to == cleared_value then
				if info.from <= progress or cleared then
					return true
				end
			elseif info.from <= progress and progress <= info.to and not cleared then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	---@return LuaNpcPoolHandler
	function event_group_base:get_handler(name)
		return self.pooled_npc_handlers[name]
	end

	function event_group_base:wait_for_sec(duration)
		local end_time = unity_class.time.time + duration

		while self.activated and unity_class.time.time < end_time do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	function event_group_base:enter()
		if self.member_infos ~= nil then
			for npc_name, npc_info in pairs(self.member_infos) do
				local position = get_position(npc_info.position)
				local handler = self.npc_pooling_system:get_npc_handler(npc_info.key, position, npc_info.direction)

				handler:remove_emotion()
				handler:remove_anim()

				if npc_info.anim ~= nil then
					handler:set_anim(self, npc_info.anim)
				end

				if npc_info.emotion ~= nil then
					handler:set_emotion(self, npc_info.emotion)
				end

				if npc_info.talk ~= nil then
					if type_util.is_table(npc_info.talk) then
						handler:set_one_line(npc_info.talk.key, npc_info.talk.sfx)
					else
						handler:set_one_line(npc_info.talk)
					end
				end

				handler:force_update_spines()

				self.pooled_npc_handlers[npc_name] = handler
			end

			if self.callback then
				self:callback()
			end
		end
	end

	function event_group_base:exit()
		for npc_name, handler in pairs(self.pooled_npc_handlers) do
			handler:dispose()

			self.pooled_npc_handlers[npc_name] = nil
		end
	end

	---@param action fun(name:string, handler:LuaNpcPoolHandler, npc:ICharacter)
	function event_group_base:foreach(action)
		if not self.activated then
			return
		end

		for name, handler in pairs(self.pooled_npc_handlers) do
			action(name, handler, handler:get_npc())
		end
	end

	---@param handler LuaNpcPoolHandler
	function event_group_base:show_stoppable_speech_async(handler, key, data)
		local talker = handler:get_npc()

		if talker == nil then
			return
		end

		if data == nil then
			data = {}
		end

		data.key = key

		handler:add_dispose_action('speech', dispose_actions.speech)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, data)

		if self.activated then
			handler:add_dispose_action('speech', nil)
		end
	end

	function event_group_base:set_callback(callback)
		self.callback = callback
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

--- 발전소 상호 작용
function local_class:interact_power_station()
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.character.princess
	local companion_boy = self.character.companion_boy
	local companion_old = self.character.companion_old

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('companion_boy_quest')

	character_util.stop(companion_boy)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(companion_boy)

	character_util.stop(companion_old)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(companion_boy)

	self.field_object.power_station.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local power_station_pos = self.marker.power_station_pos

	--발전장치 오브젝트 인터렉트 시 플레이어 (right, idle, walk) / 꼬마 공주 (left, idle ,walk) 상태로 지정된 위치까지 1초에 걸쳐 이동.

		local duration = 1

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, power_station_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			nil, duration, self, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, power_station_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			nil, duration, self, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })

		nil, nil, 'ww_companion_boy_s1_62')

--- 주변을 도는 루틴
function local_class:go_around_routine()
	local companion_boy = self.character.companion_boy
	local companion_old = self.character.companion_old

	local play_sfx = function(target, sfx_name)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = sfx_name,
			parent = target,
			type_priority = 'event',
			player_priority = 'npc'
		})
	end

	local around_pos = {}

	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(around_pos, field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_companion_boy_around_pos_' .. i))
	end

	companion_boy.Position = around_pos[1]
	character_util.set_direction(companion_boy, 'right')
	field_object_util.set_active_state(companion_boy, active_state_type.visible)

	companion_old.Position = around_pos[1] + vector(1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(companion_old, 'left')
	field_object_util.set_active_state(companion_old, active_state_type.visible)

	-- 다음 이벤트 구역으로 이동
	local move_next_pos = function(pos_index, companion_old_offset, move_side_first)
		local speed = 3
		local move_end_count = 0

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(companion_boy)
		wp_util.move(companion_boy, wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(companion_boy, around_pos[pos_index], move_side_first),
			speed, nil, { last_direction = 'right', end_callback = function()
				move_end_count = move_end_count + 1
			end })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(companion_old)
		local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(companion_old, around_pos[pos_index] + companion_old_offset, move_side_first)
		wp_util.move(companion_old, wp, speed, nil, { last_direction = 'right', end_callback = function()
			move_end_count = move_end_count + 1
		end })

		while move_end_count < 2 and
			(companion_boy.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped or
				companion_old.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped) do

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	while self.current_state == self.states.meet_companion_boy do
		--시온 (left, attack, idle) / 우노 (left, sleep_deep, idle) 실행 유지.
		scene_util.set_emotion(companion_boy, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_emotion(companion_old, self, 'sleep_deep')

		--시온 (left, attack, idle) : 이렇게 되버린 거…! 저놈들보다 어떻게든 먼저 들어가야 해!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(companion_boy, self, { dir = 'left', by_3d_sfx = true },
			nil, nil, { key = 'ww_companion_boy_s1_40' })

		if self.current_state ~= self.states.meet_companion_boy then
			return
		end

		--우노 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : …그렇다면 이 앞쪽의 전기를…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(companion_old, self, { dir = 'left', by_3d_sfx = true },
			nil, nil, { key = 'ww_companion_boy_s1_41' })

		if self.current_state ~= self.states.meet_companion_boy then
			return
		end

		--시온 (right, attack, jump 1회) : 입 다물어! 여긴 내가 해결할 거니까!
		play_sfx(companion_boy, '01_small_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(companion_boy, false)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(companion_boy, self, { dir = 'right', by_3d_sfx = true },
			nil, nil, { key = 'ww_companion_boy_s1_42' })

		if self.current_state ~= self.states.meet_companion_boy then
			return
		end

		--시온 (right, attack, release 2회) : 넌 평소대로 입 다물고 있으라고! 알았지?!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(companion_boy, self, { dir = 'right', by_3d_sfx = true },
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', { key = 'ww_companion_boy_s1_43' })

		if self.current_state ~= self.states.meet_companion_boy then
			return

	scene_util.set_emotion(companion_old, self, 'sleep_deep')

	self.is_loaded_dynamic_npc = true
end

return local_class

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	return false

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.after_bancho_enter or
			self.current_state == self.states.after_interact_bancho and
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.bancho()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

			self:accept_interact_scene()

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.before_bancho_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_dtd_intro_enter_zone') then
		start_coroutine(function()
			self.current_state = self.states.talk_bancho
			self:intro_enter_scene()
			self.current_state = self.states.after_bancho_enter
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.stage_end = true
end

		local count = 3
		local item_data = {
			--staff_fishing_rod
			{
				id = 21544,
				scale = 0.7,
			},
			--fishing_bucket
			{
				id = 21545,
				scale = 0.8,
			},
			--paste_bait_2
			{
				id = 21546,
				scale = 0.6,

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bancho, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
			'question', nil, 'ww_sub_dave_the_diver_s1_21')

	--산쵸 (right, idle, nod 1회) : 잘 부탁하오, 제군.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bancho, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = false }, nil, 'ww_sub_dave_the_diver_s1_22')

	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ leader, princess })

	character_util.remove_relate_event(bancho, self.controller)

	self.controller:activate_quest()

	field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
	scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'down', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
	npc.Position = npc_pos
end

return local_class

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능

			if this.is_playing then
				this.data.fo.transform.position = target_pos

			local fishing_obj = self.fx.fishing_float():Instantiate(target_pos)

			this.data.fo = fishing_obj

			this.is_playing = true
			start_coroutine(function()
				while not self.stage_end and this.is_playing do
					this:update(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end
			end)
		end,

		---@param this self
		change_feeding_state = function(this)
			local start = this.data.fo.transform.position.y
			this:set_state(this.state.move, this.state.feeding_down, 0.2, start, -2.4)
		end,

		---@param this self
		hide = function(this)
			this.data.fo.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			this:set_state(this.state.hide, this.state.none, 0, 0, 0)
		end,

		---@param this self
		dispose = function(this)
			if not this.is_playing then

			this.is_playing = false

			this.data.fo:Dispose()
			this.data.fo = nil
		end,

		---@type fun():Vector3
		---@param this self
		get_pos = function(this)
			return this.data.fo.transform.position
		end,

		---@param this self
		---@param target number
		---@param current_state number
		---@param next_state number
		---@param duration number
		---@param start number
		---@param target number
		set_state = function(this, current_state, next_state, duration, start, target)
			this.data.current_state = current_state
			this.data.next_state = next_state
			this.data.time_passed = 0
			this.data.duration = duration
			this.data.start = start
			this.data.target = target
		end,

		---@param this self
		---@param dt number
		update = function(this, dt)
			if this.data.current_state == this.state.idle_up then
				this:set_state(this.state.move, this.state.idle_down, 0.8, -2.3, -2.2)

			elseif this.data.current_state == this.state.idle_down then
				this:set_state(this.state.move, this.state.idle_up, 0.5, -2.2, -2.3)

			elseif this.data.current_state == this.state.feeding_up then
				this:set_state(this.state.move, this.state.feeding_down, 0.1, -2.5, -2.4)

			elseif this.data.current_state == this.state.feeding_down then
				this:set_state(this.state.move, this.state.feeding_up, 0.1, -2.4, -2.5)

			elseif this.data.current_state == this.state.move then
				local progress = this.data.time_passed / this.data.duration
				local height = 0

				this.data.time_passed = this.data.time_passed + dt

				if progress > 1 then
					this.data.current_state = this.data.next_state
					height = this.data.target
				else
					height = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(this.data.start, this.data.target, progress)
				end

				this.data.fo.transform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(this.data.fo.transform.position, height)
			end
		end,

		state = {
			none = 1,
			idle_up = 2,

function local_class:start()
	self.current_state = self.states.accept_mission

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('dave_the_diver_sub_quest', {

function local_class:exit()

		self.bucket_item:Dispose()

	end

	self.fishing_float:dispose()

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state >= self.states.accept_mission and
			self.current_state < self.states.cleared_third_qte and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.gimmick.fishing()) then

		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

			self:fishing_interact_scene()

			for _, info in ipairs(self.state_by_action) do
				if self.current_state == info.target_state then
					self:fishing_action()

					if info.action(self) then
						self.current_state = info.next_state
					else
						self.capture_sfx:stop()
						break
					end
				end
			end

			scene_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader())
			character_util.spine_remove_attachment(get_party_leader(), '[base]weapon1')

			--클리어 여부
			if self.current_state == self.states.cleared_third_qte then
				self:fishing_clear_scene()

				quest_icon_util.remove(self.npc.bancho())
				quest_icon_util.set_quest_cleared(self.npc.bancho())

				quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('dave_the_diver_sub_quest', {
					{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.npc.bancho() },
					{ zone = 'sub_field', target = get_field_object('exit_inner_2') },
				})
			else
				self:fishing_fail_scene()
			end

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 3)
		end)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.cleared_third_qte and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.npc.bancho()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.quest_clear
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

			self:section_clear_scene()

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1, mix = 1 })
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:fishing_interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.npc.princess()
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('fishing_center_pos')

	--플레이어가 ■지점 인터렉트 시, 캐릭터들 정렬.
	--플레이어는 1초에 걸쳐 ■ 지점 right 방향 정렬.
	--꼬마공주는 1초에 걸쳐 ■ 지점 right 방향 정렬.
	do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, center_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess, center_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				nil, 1, self, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

		--플레이어 캐릭터 정렬 완료 이후, 이벤트 동시 실행
		--0.5초에 걸쳐 카메라 오른쪽으로 3칸 이동.
		camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(3, 0, 0), 1)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	do
		local is_wait = true
		local is_routine = false

		if self.current_state == self.states.accept_mission then
			self.current_state = self.states.drop_busket

			is_routine = true
			start_coroutine(function()
				local max_duration = 0.3
				local time_passed = 0

				--플레이어 (left, idle, attack) 자세
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx_name = function()
					is_wait = false
				end })

				while is_wait and time_passed < max_duration do
					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				--플레이어 캐릭터한테서 fishing_bucket 아이템이 0.6초에 걸쳐 ■ 지점에 default 드랍됨.
				self.bucket_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
					item_id = 21545,
					pos = leader.Position,
					target = leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
					spr_scale = 0.8,
					loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
					show_on_character = false,
				})

				wait_for_sec(0.7)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_boat_01')

				is_routine = false
			end)
		end

		while is_routine do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	--플레이어 (right, idle, idle) 로 전환 후 0.5초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function local_class:fishing_action()

	--플레이어 staff_fishing_rod 낚싯대 장착한 상태로 (right, idle, fishing/fishing_throw) 자세 출력.
	scene_util.show_weapon(leader)

				splash_fx.transform.position = splash_fx.transform.position + vector(-0.2, 0, 0)

		})

			self.fx.water_wave():Instantiate(splash_fx.transform.position)

		self:transform_move_curve(splash_fx, splash_fx.transform.position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 0, nil, 2.5)
	end)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--3차 QTE 출력
	--QTE 종류 : 스와이프 ( ↓ )
	--횟수 : 1번
	--QTE 도중 암전 없음
	--QTE 실패 조건
	--플레이어가 QTE 버튼을 누르지 않은지 2초가 지나면 실패
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
	do
		local tap_complete = qte_play_util.swipe('down', {
			darken = false,
			duration = 2,
		})

		if not tap_complete then
			self.fx.water_wave():Instantiate(splash_fx.transform.position)

			splash_fx:Dispose()
			splash_fx = nil

			return false
		end
	end


	--3차 QTE 성공 이후, fx_fish_water_splash2_loop 이펙트가 1초에 걸쳐 아래쪽으로 1.5칸 이동.
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.is_move = false

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		--3차 QTE 성공 이후, fx_fish_water_splash2_loop 이펙트가 1초에 걸쳐 아래쪽으로 1.5칸 이동.
		self:transform_move_curve(splash_fx,
				vector(splash_fx.transform.position.x, splash_fx.transform.position.y, fx_pos.z), 0, nil, 1.8)
	end)

	--4차 QTE 출력.
	--QTE 종류 : 매쉬 버튼
	--횟수 : 8번
	--QTE 도중 암전 없음
	--QTE 실패 조건
	--플레이어가 QTE 버튼을 누르지 않은지 2초가 지나면 실패
	do
		local tap_complete = self:custom_tap(8, {
			darken = false,
			touch_to_duration = 2,
			tap_count_callback = function()
				--화면 0.1값으로 shake 0.2
				camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)

				--fx_fish_water_splash2_loop 이펙트가 왼쪽으로 0.2칸씩 이동.
				if self.is_move then
					self.current_target_pos = self.current_target_pos + vector(-0.2, 0, 0)
				else
					splash_fx.transform.position = splash_fx.transform.position + vector(-0.2, 0, 0)
				end
			end,
		})

		if not tap_complete then
			self.fx.water_wave():Instantiate(splash_fx.transform.position)

			splash_fx:Dispose()
			splash_fx = nil

			return false
		end
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.is_move = false

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		--3차 QTE 성공 이후, fx_fish_water_splash2_loop 이펙트가 1초에 걸쳐 아래쪽으로 1.5칸 이동.
		self:transform_move_curve(splash_fx,
				vector(splash_fx.transform.position.x, splash_fx.transform.position.y, fx_pos.z - 1.5), 0, nil, 2.5)
	end)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--5차 QTE 출력
	--QTE 종류 : 스와이프 ( ↑ )
	--QTE 실패 여부 있음.
	--횟수 : 1번
	--QTE 도중 암전 없음
	--QTE 실패 조건
	--플레이어가 QTE 버튼을 누르지 않은지 2초가 지나면 실패
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
	do
		local tap_complete = qte_play_util.swipe('up', {
			darken = false,
			duration = 2,
		})

		if not tap_complete then
			self.fx.water_wave():Instantiate(splash_fx.transform.position)

			splash_fx:Dispose()
			splash_fx = nil

			return false
		end
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.is_move = false

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		--5차 QTE 성공 이후, fx_fish_water_splash2_loop 이펙트가 1초에 걸쳐 위쪽으로 1.5칸 이동.
		self:transform_move_curve(splash_fx, vector(splash_fx.transform.position.x, splash_fx.transform.position.y, fx_pos.z), 0, nil, 1.8)
	end)

	--6차 QTE 출력.
	--QTE 종류 : 매쉬 버튼
	--횟수 : 10번
	--QTE 도중 암전 없음
	--QTE 실패 조건
	--플레이어가 QTE 버튼을 누르지 않은지 2초가 지나면 실패
	do
		local tap_complete = self:custom_tap(7, {
			darken = false,
			touch_to_duration = 2,
			tap_count_callback = function()
				--화면 0.1값으로 shake 0.2
				camera_util.shake(0.08, 0.2)

				--fx_fish_water_splash2_loop 이펙트가 왼쪽으로 0.2칸씩 이동.
				if self.is_move then
					self.current_target_pos = self.current_target_pos + vector(-0.2, 0, 0)
				else
					splash_fx.transform.position = splash_fx.transform.position + vector(-0.2, 0, 0)
				end
			end,
		})

		if not tap_complete then
			self.fx.water_wave():Instantiate(splash_fx.transform.position)

			splash_fx:Dispose()
			splash_fx = nil

			return false
		end
	end

	while self.is_move do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:qte_clear_routine(leader, princess, fish, splash_fx)
	splash_fx = nil

	return true
end

function local_class:qte_clear_routine(leader, princess, fish, splash_fx)
	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	self.capture_sfx:stop()

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local start_pos = splash_fx.transform.position

			--fx_fish_water_splash2_loop 이펙트 지점에 fx_common_water_splash_out 이펙트 출력
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fish_catch_01')
			self.fx.water_wave():Instantiate(start_pos)

			--fx_fish_water_splash2_loop 이펙트 제거
			splash_fx:Dispose()

			--ww_fish_small_medaka 캐릭터가 (left, idle, idle)로 생성
			fish.Position = start_pos
			scene_util.set_direction(fish, 'left', false)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(fish, active_state_type.enabled)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fish)

			--플레이어 캐릭터의 1칸 위쪽 지점으로 jump. 시간 : 0.6초
			self:move_curve(fish, leader.Position + vector(0, 0.9, 0), 1.5, 0.6)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_get_head_01')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			--플레이어 (down, smile, get) 자세로 전환.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_new_quest_accept_01')
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'get')

			--꼬마공주(right, smile, clap 지속)
			scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'clap')

			--1.5초 대기
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--1초에 걸쳐 Stage Camera 값 3으로 줌인.
			--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 플레이어를 향해 포커스.
			local duration = 1

			camera_util.move(leader.Position, duration)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, duration)
		end),
	})

	self.eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	--플레이어 (left, idle, eat 지속) 자세 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')

	--꼬마공주 (right, idle, idle) 자세 전환.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	--ww_fish_small_medaka 캐릭터 0초만에 플레이어 캐릭터의 0.3칸 왼쪽 지점으로 위치 변경.
	fish.Position = leader.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--ww_fish_small_medaka 캐릭터가 fishing_bucket 아이템 지점으로 흡수되며 삭제.
	self:move_curve(fish, self.bucket_item.Position, 0, 0.1)

	--(흡수될 때 FX_get 이펙트 출력)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_item_01')
	self.fx.get():Instantiate(fish.Position)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(fish, active_state_type.disabled)

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
end

function local_class:fishing_clear_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self.fishing_float:dispose()

	--fishing_bucket 아이템 플레이어한테로 흡수.
	quest_drop_item_util.consumed(self.bucket_item, leader)
	self.bucket_item = nil

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	self.eat_sfx:Stop()
	self.eat_sfx = nil

	--플레이어 (left, idle, idle) 전환.
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	--1초에 걸쳐 Stage Camera 값 4로 원상복귀.
	camera_util.resize_to_default_async(1)

	character_util.add_listener(self.npc.bancho(), self.controller)

	--산쵸 NPC한테 서브 퀘스트 마커 출력되도록 변경.

	--인터렉트 불가능 처리로 변경.
	local interact_fo = self.gimmick.fishing()
	interact_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
end

function local_class:fishing_fail_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.npc.princess()

	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	--(낚시 QTE 실패 이벤트 및 재도전)
	--동시 실행
	--0.2초에 걸쳐 Stage Camera 값 4로 원상복귀.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.2)

	--플레이어 (right, surprise, idle 자세로 jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_player_jump_01')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--동시 실행
	--플레이어 (left, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')

	--꼬마공주 (right, tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'tired')

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 플레이어 한테로 원상복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')

	--1.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion({ leader, princess })
end

function local_class:section_clear_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess = self.npc.princess()
	local bancho = self.npc.bancho()

	self.stage_event_controller.can_amb_sfx = false

	quest_icon_util.remove(bancho)

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('dave_the_diver_sub_quest')

	--24, 0, -36
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_dtd_npc_pos')

	--30.5, 0, 61.5
	local dark_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_dtd_darkness_pos')

	scene_util.set_direction(bancho, 'right', false)

	--플레이어가 ■지점 인터렉트 시, 캐릭터들 정렬.

			nil, 'smile', 'ww_sub_dave_the_diver_s1_26')

	--산쵸 (right, smile, idle) : 수고 많았소, 제군. 덕분에 늦지 않을 수 있겠소.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bancho, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'ww_sub_dave_the_diver_s1_27')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 4 })

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--캐릭터들 다음과 같이 배치.
	do
		--산쵸 (down, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(bancho, 'down', false)

		--플레이어 (up, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up', false)
		leader.Position = center_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)

		--꼬마공주 (up, idle, idle)
		scene_util.set_direction(princess, 'up', false)
		princess.Position = center_pos + vector(2, 0, 0)

		camera_util.set_position(center_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 1.5), true)
	end

	--rice_food
	local rice_food = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		item_id = 21559,
		pos = center_pos + vector(2.6, 0.6, 1.7),
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = false,
	})

	local medaka = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		item_id = 21560,
		pos = center_pos + vector(0.2, 0.6, 1.8),
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = false,
	})

	local bass = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		item_id = 21561,
		pos = center_pos + vector(1.6, 0.6, 1.9),
		spr_scale = 0.7,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = false,
	})

	local cat_fish = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		item_id = 21562,
		pos = center_pos + vector(1.2, 0.6, 2.2),
		spr_scale = 0.7,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
		show_on_character = false,
	})

	quest_drop_item_util.set_shadow_active(rice_food, false)
	quest_drop_item_util.set_shadow_active(medaka, false)
	quest_drop_item_util.set_shadow_active(bass, false)
	quest_drop_item_util.set_shadow_active(cat_fish, false)

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--산쵸 (down, idle, idle) : 자연의 맛을 살리기 위해선 고도의 집중력이 필요하오.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bancho, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ww_sub_dave_the_diver_s1_28')

	--산쵸 (down, idle, idle) : 소생이 요리를 할동안 잠시 기다려주시오.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(bancho, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ww_sub_dave_the_diver_s1_29')

	scene_util.set_anim(bancho, self, 'cast')

	--동시 실행

		local duration = 1

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')

		self.stage_event_controller:fade_out_beach_amb(3)

		--1초에 걸쳐 Stage Camera 값 2로 줌인.

	--대기 0.8초

		local duration = 1.5
		local tint_color = unity_color({ 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1 })

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_shaolin_intro', mix = 3 })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_evolve_result_01')

		field_util.tint(tint_key, tint_color, 0.5, duration)
		wait_for_sec(duration)

		--대기 0.5초

			screen_util.fade_out_async(0.1, unity_class.color.white)

			--화이트 페이드 인 0.5초. async

		field_util.remove_tint(tint_key, 0)
	end

	--1번째 컷
	--최초 NPC 및 아이템 배치
	local first_check = false

	do
		--반쵸 (left, idle, twohand_attack 지속중)
		scene_util.set_direction(bancho, 'left', false)

		bancho.Position = dark_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

		medaka.Position = dark_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5)
		bass.Position = dark_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)

		character_util.remove_emotion(bancho)
		scene_util.set_anim(bancho, self, 'twohand_attack')

		start_coroutine(function()
			while not first_check do
				local animation_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(bancho, 'twohand_attack')

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lynn_ride_01')

				wait_for_sec(0.36)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_slash_01')

				local fx_lasthit_1 = self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(dark_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5))
				fx_lasthit_1.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

				local fx_lasthit_2 = self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(dark_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
				fx_lasthit_2.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

				if not first_check then
					quest_drop_item_util.shake(bass, 'bass', 0.03, 0.3)
					quest_drop_item_util.shake(medaka, 'medaka', 0.03, 0.3)

					wait_for_sec(animation_duration - 0.36)
				end
			end
		end)

		camera_util.set_position(dark_pos + vector(0, 0, -3), true)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(1.8, 0)

---@class QtePlayUtilTapInfo
---@field duration nil|number Qte 제한 시간
---@field touch_to_duration nil|number 1회 터치당 제한 시간
---@field is_wait_duration nil|boolean is_wait_duration가 true일 경우, duration 시간을 모두 대기 하고 qte를 끝냄
---@field tap_sfx_name nil|string 탭 할 때마다 재생할 sfx
---@field time_mod nil|number time_mod 값
---@field show_tutorial_spine nil|boolean QTE 중에 튜토리얼 스파인을 표시할지
---@field darken nil|boolean field 에 darken을 적용 할지
---@field set_pos nil|Vector2 Qte 가 생성될 위치 Vector2 값
---@field anim_time_scale nil|number qte 애니메이션의 time_scale 값
---@field anim_unscaled_time nil|boolean qte 애니메이션에 unscaled_time을 적용 할지
---@field tap_count_callback nil|function 터치 이벤트 발생할 때 마다 tap 횟수를 콜백으로 전달

---@param count number tap count
---@param data QtePlayUtilTapInfo
---@return boolean
function local_class:custom_tap(count, data)
	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration', 99999)
	local touch_to_duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'touch_to_duration', 99999)
	local is_wait_duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'is_wait_duration', false)
	local tap_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'tap_sfx_name', nil)
	local show_tutorial_spine = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'show_tutorial_spine', true)
	local darken = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'darken', true)
	local set_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'set_pos', vector(0, 0))
	local anim_time_scale = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'anim_time_scale', 0.85)
	local anim_unscaled_time = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'anim_unscaled_time', false)
	local tap_count_callback = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'tap_count_callback', nil)

	local tap_count = 0
	local event_listener = {}
	local touch_to_time_passed = 0

	-- TouchEvent EventListener 생성
	event_listener.on_touch_event = function(_, e)
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
			if tap_sfx_name ~= nil then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(tap_sfx_name)
			end

			tap_count = tap_count + 1
			touch_to_time_passed = 0

			if tap_count_callback ~= nil then
				tap_count_callback(tap_count)
			end

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	event_listener.on_stage_end_event = function(_, _)
		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	-- 탭 횟수가 1회인 경우, turbo_tap이 아니라 일반 tap으로 띄움
	if show_tutorial_spine then
		if count == 1 then
			qte_play_util.show_tap(darken, set_pos, anim_time_scale, anim_unscaled_time)
		else
			qte_play_util.show_turbo_tap(darken, set_pos, anim_time_scale, anim_unscaled_time)
		end
	else
		if darken then
			field_util.darken('qte_darken', 0.5, 0.1)
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(false))
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	local dt = 0

	while tap_count < count and time_passed < duration and touch_to_time_passed < touch_to_duration do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		if tap_count > 0 then
			touch_to_time_passed = touch_to_time_passed + dt
		end
	end

	if show_tutorial_spine then
		screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
	else
		if darken then
			field_util.undarken('qte_darken')
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(true))
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	-- is_wait_duration가 true일 경우, duration 시간을 모두 대기하고 qte를 끝냄
	while is_wait_duration and time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	return tap_count >= count
end

function local_class:move_curve(fo, target_pos, height, duration)
	local start_pos = fo.Position

	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
		local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		local lerp_pos = cur_value + vector(0, h, 0)

		fo.Position = lerp_pos
	end)
end

function local_class:transform_move_curve(fo, target_pos, height, duration, speed)
	local start_pos = fo.transform.position
	self.current_target_pos = target_pos

	if duration == nil and speed ~= nil then
		local distance = unity_class.vector3.Distance(fo.transform.position, self.current_target_pos)
		duration = distance / speed
	end

	self.is_move = true
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration and self.is_move do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

		fo.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, self.current_target_pos, progress) + vector(0, h, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	if self.is_move then
		fo.transform.position = self.current_target_pos
		self.current_target_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
		self.is_move = false
	end
end

return local_class
