	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(beach_side_bad_male, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'push', keep = true }, 'doyagao', 'mm_bootcamp_main_s2_5')

	--동시 시작
	do
		--카메라 1타일 위로 포커스 1초간 이동
		camera_util.move(cam_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

		--아칠이 바다에서 올라오는 연출
		--AA72 (-5.25, 2.5, -29) 위치에 검은틴트, 알파값 0% 상태로 생성
		--AA72, 1초간 물 위로 페이드인 되며 스르륵 올라옴
		--y값 (-2.5) -> y값 (-1.2)
		--검은 틴트, 알파값 0% -> 검은틴트, 알파값 100%

		--vector (-5.25, 1.5, -29)
		local start_pos = pivot_pos + vector(-0.25, -2.5, 3.5)
		local end_pos = pivot_pos + vector(-0.25, -1.2, 3.5)
		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 1

		summer_android.Position = start_pos
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(summer_android, 1, duration)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_float_01')
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local cur_pos = end_pos * progress + start_pos * (1 - progress)

			summer_android.Position = cur_pos

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		summer_android.Position = end_pos
	end

			function()

				wp_util.move_async(summer_android, summer_android.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5), nil, 1)

				wp_util.move_async(summer_android, summer_android.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5), nil, 1)
			end,
			function()
				--불량 여성 (left, smile, push) : 아잉, 정말 로맨틱하다…

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	start_coroutine(function()
		local is_create
		is_create, self.place_controller = global_table_util.try_get_character_place_controller()

		self.place_controller:activate_group('s3_oneline_1')
		self.place_controller:activate_group('s3_oneline_2')

		self.place_controller:activate_group('s2_s3_oneline_1')
	end)
end

function local_class:start()
	if not self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.start_scene_from_section_2, self)
	end

	local instructor = self.npc.instructor()
	character_util.add_listener(instructor, self)

	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = instructor
		},
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.place_controller ~= nil then
		self.place_controller:deactivate_group('s3_dynamic')
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local instructor = self.npc.instructor()
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, instructor) then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.instructor_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

end

function local_class:setting_shoot_helper()
	local summer_android = self.npc.summer_android()

	local pattern_info = { columns = 1 }
	local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
	local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec('summer_android_proj'):Clone()
	local proj_shooter = shoot_helper_util.create_projectile_shooter(self, summer_android)
	self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			proj_shooter,
			proj_spec,
			pattern_info,
			CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset,
			0.5,
			CS.Oak.WeaponType.AssaultRifle)
end

function local_class:shoot_bullet(shoot_npc, target_pos, anim_reset)
	local dir = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(shoot_npc.Direction)
	local rifle_shoot_anim_name = 'rifle_shoot'
	local rifle_shoot_anim_scale = 1

	local shot_offset = dir * 0.2 + vector(0, 0, 0)

	local shoot_fx_dir = (target_pos - shoot_npc.Position).normalized
	local shoot_fx_angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(-shoot_fx_dir.z, shoot_fx_dir.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg

	if shoot_fx_angle < 0 then
		shoot_fx_angle = shoot_fx_angle + 360.0
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stella_hit_01')
	self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(target_pos, shot_offset, 0)

	if anim_reset then
		scene_util.set_anim_async(shoot_npc, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', scale = rifle_shoot_anim_scale, count = 1 })

		scene_util.set_anim(shoot_npc, self, 'rifle_idle')
	else
		scene_util.set_anim(shoot_npc, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', scale = rifle_shoot_anim_scale, count = 1 })
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	if label == 0 then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.npc.summer_android()) then
			return false
		end

		local drunk = self.npc.drunk()
		local hit_target = lua_helper.get_or_default(hit_info.target, drunk)

		--동시 시작
		--취객 위로 fx_summer_android_basic_fire 이펙트 출력
		self.fx:summer_android_basic_fire():Instantiate(drunk.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))

		--화면 shake (0.1, 0.3)
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

		--캐릭터 shake (0.03,0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(drunk, 0.03, 0.3)

		--취객 위에 fx_lasthit 출력
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(drunk.Bounds.center)

		if self.drunk_hit_count == 0 then
			start_coroutine(function()
				--취객 (left, damaged, hurt) : [shout] 으악!
				scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(drunk, self, 'left',
						'hurt', 'damaged', { key = 'mm_bootcamp_main_s3_85', skip = false })

				--취객 (left, confused, hurt)
				scene_util.set_direction(drunk, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(drunk, self, 'confused')
				scene_util.set_anim(drunk, self, 'hurt')
			end)

		end

		self.drunk_hit_count = self.drunk_hit_count + 1

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor(self.fx):load_async()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.resource_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	start_coroutine(function()
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.resource_holder, 'ui/prologue', 'typing_text', function(prefab)
					local typing_text_go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
					self.typing_text = typing_text_go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))
				end)
	end)

	local is_create
	is_create, self.place_controller = global_table_util.try_get_character_place_controller()

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		self.place_controller:activate_group('s4_main_1')
	else
		--NPC들은 각자 아래 위치, 속도 4로 이동 후 원라인 전환.
		start_coroutine(self.trainee_grand_move, self)
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	local instructor = self.characters.instructor()
	character_util.add_listener(instructor, self.controller)

	self.quest_marker:add({
		{
			zone = 'main_field',
			target = instructor
		},
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.ball_item ~= nil then
		quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.ball_item)
		self.ball_item = nil
	end

	if self.typing_text ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text)
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	if self.resource_holder ~= nil then
		self.resource_holder:Dispose()
		self.resource_holder = nil
	end

	if self.loop_effect ~= nil then
		self.loop_effect:Dispose()
		self.loop_effect = nil
	end

	local instructor = self.characters.instructor()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(instructor, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.section_start and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.instructor()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.guard_interact
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			self:guard_interact_scene()

			self:training_scene()

			self:qte_scene()

			self:qte_ending_scene()

			self:finish_class_scene()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

	--화면 1초간 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

end

function local_class:qte_scene()
	self.place_controller:activate_group('s4_main_qte_1')
	local group = self.place_controller:get_group('s4_main_qte_1')
	local summer_android = get_party_leader()
	local summer_android_tube = group:get_dynamic_member('summer_android_tube')
	local dolphin = group:get_dynamic_member('dolphin')

	local qte_set = function(reset)
		if reset then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(summer_android_tube)
			character_util.set_position(summer_android_tube, field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_rock_pos') + vector(2, 0, 0))
		end

		--포커스 AA72, 카메라값 3
		camera_util.move_async(summer_android_tube.Position, 0, { end_target = summer_android_tube, ignorecameragrids = true })
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0)
	end

	--set
	do
		qte_set(false)
	end

	local ball_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_qte_ball_pos') + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
	self.ball_item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
		item_id = 21624,
		pos = ball_pos,
		loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
	})

	self.ball_item:SetSortingLayer(true)

	--화면 1초간 페이드 인 되면 아래 위치에 배치, 포커스 AA72, 카메라값 3
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = 'ondemand/short_story_summer/audio:bgm_summer_game', state = 'event', volume = 0.6 })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--수영 QTE 1차
	--QTE 종류 : 터보탭
	--제한 시간 : 30초 / 시간 제한으로 실패시 공통 실패연출 적용
	--횟수 : 22번
	--탭 1번마다 AA72 eat 자세, 표정 attack으로 속도 6으로 1타일씩 우측 이동.
	--카메라 AA72 포커스로 따라감
	--캐릭터 아래 fx_fish_water_splash2_loop 지속 출력.
	--QTE 암전 미적용.
	do
		local tap_count = 20
		local is_move = true
		local one_count_move = false
		local move_count = 0
		local cur_move = 0
		local speed = 6
		local start_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
		local target_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
		local move_pos = unity_class.vector3.right
		local time_passed = 0
		local to_duration = 0
		local progress = 0

		local intro_routine = function()
			--시작 QTE 진행
			--QTE 종류 : 탭
			--제한 시간 : 없음/ 실패 없음
			--횟수 : 1회
			--QTE 암전 적용.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
			qte_play_util.tap(1)

			--시작 QTE 성공 연출
			--AA72 (right, attack, idle) : 반드시 구해내겠습니다!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android_tube, self, 'right',
					nil, 'attack', 'mm_bootcamp_main_s4_qte_1')
		end

		local move_init = function()
			one_count_move = false
			move_count = 0
			cur_move = 0
		end

		--move logic
		start_coroutine(function()
			while is_move do
				if not one_count_move and cur_move < move_count then
					--set
					one_count_move = true
					cur_move = cur_move + 1
					start_pos = summer_android_tube.Position
					target_pos = start_pos + move_pos
					to_duration = vector_util.distance(start_pos, target_pos) / speed
					time_passed = 0

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_01')
					scene_util.set_anim(summer_android_tube, self, 'eat')

					if self.loop_effect == nil then
						self.loop_effect = self.fx.water_splash():Instantiate(vector(summer_android_tube.Position.x, -0.3, summer_android_tube.Position.z), summer_android_tube)
						self.loop_effect.transform:SetParent(summer_android_tube.Transform)
					else
						self.loop_effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)
					end

				elseif one_count_move then
					--move
					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					progress = time_passed / to_duration

					if progress < 1 then
						summer_android_tube.Position = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
					else
						summer_android_tube.Position = target_pos
						one_count_move = false

						character_util.remove_anim(summer_android_tube)
						self.loop_effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)

						--end
						if cur_move == tap_count then
							is_move = false
						end
					end
				end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end)

		local qte_result = false

		while not qte_result do
			intro_routine()

			qte_result = qte_play_util.tap(tap_count, {
				duration = 5,
				darken = false,
				tap_count_callback = function()
					move_count = move_count + 1
				end,
			})

			--실패 루틴
			if not qte_result then
				move_init()

				if self.loop_effect ~= nil then
					self.loop_effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
				end

				--그 자리에서 바로 멈춘 뒤 화면 shake (0.3,0.3)
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

				--AA72 (right, scared, embarrassed) : 으아아, 기체가 뒤집힙니다!
				scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android_tube, self, 'scared')
				scene_util.set_anim(summer_android_tube, self, 'embarrassed')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android_tube, self, 'right',
						nil, nil, 'mm_bootcamp_main_s4_qte_2')

				--AA72 (right, scared, unique/overturn1 1회)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_02')
				scene_util.set_anim(summer_android_tube, self, { name = 'unique/overturn_1', count = 1, loop = false })

				--y값 -0.5상태
				character_util.move_to_async(summer_android_tube, summer_android_tube.Position + vector(0, -1.2, 0), 0.5, nil, false, false)

				--AA72 (right, scared, unique/embarrassed)
				scene_util.set_anim(summer_android_tube, self, 'unique/overturn_embarrassed')

				--캐릭터 아래 fx_fish_water_splash2_loop 지속 출력.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_float_01')
				local splash_fx = self.fx.water_splash():Instantiate(vector(summer_android_tube.Position.x, -1.1, summer_android_tube.Position.z))

				--1초간 서클로 페이드 아웃
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
				screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

				splash_fx:Dispose()
				splash_fx = nil

				qte_set(true)

				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				--1초간 서클로 페이드 인
				screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		--클리어 시 이동 중이라면 이동 완료 까지 대기
		while qte_result and is_move do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

	end

	self.loop_effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	--tube 스파인은 따로 z값 처리 없이 그냥 띄워주셔도 무방할듯 합니다.

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--AA72 (right, attack, idle) : 조금만 더…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android_tube, self, 'right',
			nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'mm_bootcamp_main_s4_3_2')

	--동시 시작
	--AA72 (right, attack, eat) + fx_fish_water_splash2_loop 지속 출력.
	--AA72, 위 자세로 속도 2로 2.5타일 이동
	--1초간 화면 페이드 아웃.
	local water_dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_21', loop = true })
	self.loop_effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				scene_util.set_anim_async(summer_android_tube, self, 'eat')
			end,
			function()
				wp_util.move_async(summer_android_tube, summer_android_tube.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0), 2, nil)
			end,
			function()
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_heroic_moment' })
				screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)
			end
	)

	local black_area_pos = vector(-999, 0, -999)
	camera_util.move(black_area_pos, 0)

	local text_width = 1000
	local text_speed = 0
	local text_fade_duration = 0.5
	local text_lifetime = text_fade_duration + 3

	self.typing_text.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0
	self.typing_text.Widget.pivot = CS.UIWidget.Pivot.Bottom
	self.typing_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 100, 1, 0)
	self.typing_text.Label.fontSize = 40
	self.typing_text.Label.alignment = CS.NGUIText.Alignment.Center
	self.typing_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black)

	--fx_fish_water_splash2_loop 제거
	if self.loop_effect ~= nil then
		self.loop_effect:Dispose()
		self.loop_effect = nil
	end

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(water_dash_sfx)

	--AA72 : 유즈 언니… 보고 있나요?
	--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
	--		self.s1_typing_text:SetTypedText(text, text_width, text_speed, text_lifetime))
	local text = game_string:GetString('mm_bootcamp_main_s4_3_3')
	coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText(text, text_width, text_speed, text_lifetime))

	wait_for_sec(text_fade_duration * 2)

	--AA72 : 이제 과거의 스텔라는 잊어주시고….
	text = game_string:GetString('mm_bootcamp_main_s4_3_4')
	coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText(text, text_width, text_speed, text_lifetime))

	wait_for_sec(text_fade_duration * 2)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--AA72 : 지금부턴 부유성의 돌고래 스텔라라고 불러주세요!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
				text = game_string:GetString('mm_bootcamp_main_s4_3_5')
				coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText(text, text_width, text_speed, text_lifetime))

				wait_for_sec(text_fade_duration * 2)
			end,
			function()
				--화면 shake (0.5, 0.3)
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
			end,
			function()
				--화면에 돌고래, AA72 즉시 출력. 캐릭터 크기는 2.5배
				character_util.set_scale_factor(summer_android, summer_android.Name, 2.5)
				scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'smile')
				scene_util.set_anim(summer_android, self, 'get')

				character_util.set_scale_factor(dolphin, dolphin.Name, 2.5)
				character_util.spine_rotate(dolphin, 50, 0)

				--돌고래 (right, smile, tail_swing) / 화면 기준 x (0.35) y (0.5) / 로테이션의 z값을 50으로
				character_util.set_position(dolphin, black_area_pos + vector(-2.5, 0, -0.5))
				scene_util.set_anim(dolphin, self, { name = 'tail_swing', loop = false })

				--AA72 (right, attack, get) / 화면 기준 x (0.65) y (0.5)
				character_util.set_position(summer_android, black_area_pos + vector(2.5, 0, -1))
			end
	)

	--1.5초간 화면 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)

	if self.loop_effect ~= nil then
		self.loop_effect:Dispose()
		self.loop_effect = nil
	end

	character_util.set_position(summer_android_tube, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_scale_factor(summer_android, summer_android.Name)

	local succubus = self.characters.succubus_noble_mask()

	character_util.set_position(succubus, field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_trainee_group_pivot') + vector(1.5, 0, -1.5))
	scene_util.set_direction(succubus, 'up', false)

	local lifeguard = self.characters.instructor()
	character_util.set_position(lifeguard, field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_trainee_group_pivot') + vector(0, 0, 1.5))

	self.resource_holder = nil
	self.typing_text = nil
end

	character_util.normal_jump(npc_2, true)

function local_class:item_move_curve(item, target_pos, height, speed, duration, rotation_num, frame_action)
	local start_pos = item.Position
	local distance = vector_util.distance(start_pos, target_pos)
	local to_duration = 0

	if type_util.is_number(speed) then
		to_duration = distance / speed
	elseif type_util.is_number(duration) then
		to_duration = duration
	end

	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(to_duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
		local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		local lerp_pos = cur_value + vector(0, h, 0)

		item.Position = lerp_pos

		local rotate_progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, progress)
		local cur_rotation = rotate_progress * 360 * rotation_num

		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.back)
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.back)

		if type_util.is_function(frame_action) then
			frame_action(progress, cur_value)
		end
	end)
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		local is_create
		is_create, self.place_controller = global_table_util.try_get_character_place_controller()
		self:progress_states(self.states.myth)

		--self:progress_states(self.states.run)
		--sp_util.start_scene(self.run_scene, self)
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.myth then
		local succubus_noble_mask = self.npc.succubus_noble_mask()

		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, succubus_noble_mask) then

			sp_util.start_scene(self.myth_scene, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.zone_name.transformation_zone) and
			self.current_state == self.states.transformation then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.transformation_scene, self)
		return true
	end

end

function local_class:progress_states(new_state)
	--기존 스테이트에 있던 동적 npc 및 아이템 등 제거
	if self.current_state == self.states.myth then
		self:unsetting_npc_myth()
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.transformation then
		self:unsetting_transformation()
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.run then
		self:unsetting_run()
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.cleaning then
		self:unsetting_cleaning()
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.scout then
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.inventory then
		self:unsetting_inventory()
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.boong then
		self:unsetting_boong()
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.cross_arm then
		self:unsetting_cross_arm()
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.montage_done then
	end

	--새로운 스테이트에 있어야할 npc 및 아이템, 퀘스트 마커 추가
	if new_state == self.states.myth then
		self:setting_npc_myth()
	elseif new_state == self.states.transformation then
		self:setting_transformation()
	elseif new_state == self.states.run then
		self:setting_run()
	elseif new_state == self.states.cleaning then
		self:setting_cleaning()
	elseif new_state == self.states.scout then
		self:setting_scout()
	elseif new_state == self.states.inventory then
		self:setting_inventory()
	elseif new_state == self.states.boong then
		self:setting_boong()
	elseif new_state == self.states.cross_arm then
		self:setting_cross_arm()
	elseif new_state == self.states.montage_done then
		self:setting_montage_done()
	end

	self.current_state = new_state
end

function local_class:setting_npc_myth()
	local succubus_noble_mask = self.npc.succubus_noble_mask()
	character_util.add_listener(succubus_noble_mask, self)

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = succubus_noble_mask }
	})
end

function local_class:unsetting_npc_myth()
	local succubus_noble_mask = self.npc.succubus_noble_mask()
	succubus_noble_mask.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
end

function local_class:setting_transformation()
	--비활성화 되어 있던 NPC 1~8 아래에 재생성

	--교관 (up, idle, idle)
	--1번 일반 여성 (down, idle, idle)
	--2번 일반 남성 (down, idle, idle)
	--3번 불량 여성 (down, idle, idle)
	--4번 일반 여성 (down, idle, idle)
	--5번 불량 남성 (down, idle, idle)
	--6번 일반 남성 (down, idle, idle)
	--7번 불량 여성 (down, idle, idle)
	--8번 일반 남성 (down, idle, idle)
	self.place_controller:activate_group('s5_transformation')
	self.place_controller:activate_group('s5_dynamic')

	local pivot_pos = self.marker.instructor_pos()

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = pivot_pos }
	})
end

function local_class:unsetting_transformation()
	self.place_controller:deactivate_group('s5_transformation')
	self.place_controller:deactivate_group('s5_dynamic')

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')
end

function local_class:transformation_scene()
	local instructor = self.npc.instructor()
	local summer_android = self.npc.summer_android()

	local succubus_noble_mask = self.npc.succubus_noble_mask()
	local succubus_noble = self.npc.succubus_noble()

	local pivot_pos = self.marker.instructor_pos()

	local trainee_1 = self.npc.trainee(1)
	local trainee_2 = self.npc.trainee(2)
	local trainee_3 = self.npc.trainee(3)
	local trainee_4 = self.npc.trainee(4)
	local trainee_5 = self.npc.trainee(5)
	local trainee_6 = self.npc.trainee(6)
	local trainee_7 = self.npc.trainee(7)
	local trainee_8 = self.npc.trainee(8)

	local trainees = {
		summer_android,
		trainee_1,
		trainee_2,
		trainee_3,
		trainee_4,
		trainee_5,
		trainee_6,
		trainee_7,
		trainee_8,
	}

	local group = self.place_controller:get_group('s5_dynamic')
	local lifeguard_female = group:get_dynamic_member('summer_lifeguard_female')

	--존에 진입하면 즉시 플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗고 연출 진행.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--AA72 (left, idle, idle) - jump 1회
	scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'left', false)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(summer_android, '01_small_jump_01')

	--이후 아래 위치, 7의 속도로 이동. 카메라 따라감 / 끝날때까지 대기.
	local sa_mid_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)
	local sa_end_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 2)
	local sa_wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(summer_android, sa_mid_pos, false)

	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	wp_util.move_async(summer_android, sa_wp, 7, nil, { run = true })
	wp_util.move_async(summer_android, sa_end_pos, 7, nil, { run = true })

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(dash_sfx)

	--AA72 (down, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'down', false)

	--비앙카 아래 경로, 7의 속도로 이동.
	local snm_end_pos = pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 5)
	local snm_start_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', snm_end_pos + vector(0, 0, -2.5), 1)

	succubus_noble_mask.Position = snm_start_pos
	field_object_util.set_active_state(succubus_noble_mask, active_state_type.enabled)

	local snm_start_wp = {
		snm_start_pos,
		vector(pivot_pos.x + 6.5, 0, snm_start_pos.z),
		vector(pivot_pos.x + 6.5, 0, snm_end_pos.z),
		snm_end_pos
	}
	wp_util.move_async(succubus_noble_mask, snm_start_wp, 7)

	--비앙카 (down, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(succubus_noble_mask, 'down', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(succubus_noble_mask)

	--교관 (up, idle, idle) : 이번 훈련은 라이프가드가 수행할 수 있는 고급 기술을 배울 수 있는 시간이 될 거다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(instructor, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'mm_bootcamp_main_s5_54')

	--교관 (up, idle, idle, jump 1회) : 바로 응급 처치 기술이다!

	character_util.normal_jump(instructor, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(instructor, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'mm_bootcamp_main_s5_55')

	--동시 시작
	do
		--1번 일반 여성 (down, smile, clap)
		scene_util.set_direction(trainee_1, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(trainee_1, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(trainee_1, self, 'clap')

		--4번 일반 여성 (right, idle, idle)

		scene_util.set_emotion(trainee_5, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(trainee_5, self, 'bomb_idle')

		--AA72 (down, smile, cast) : 응급 처치! 기대했던 겁니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(summer_android, self, 'down',
				'cast', 'smile', 'mm_bootcamp_main_s5_56')
	end


	--교관 (right, idle, idle) : 바로 시작하도록 하지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(instructor, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'mm_bootcamp_main_s5_58')

	--AA72 , NPC들 모두 (down, idle, idle) 전환
	for i = 1, #trainees do
		local trainee = trainees[i]
		scene_util.set_direction(trainee, 'down', false)

function local_class:setting_run()
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.run_pos()

	local instructor = self.npc.instructor()
	local summer_android = self.npc.summer_android()
	local succubus_noble = self.npc.succubus_noble()

	local flag = self.object.run_flag()

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	scene_util.set_direction(instructor, 'down', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(instructor)
	instructor.Position = pivot_pos
	field_object_util.set_active_state(instructor, active_state_type.enabled)

	scene_util.set_direction(succubus_noble, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_noble, self, 'attack')
	character_util.remove_anim(succubus_noble)
	succubus_noble.Position = pivot_pos + vector(-10, 0, -2)

	scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'attack')
	character_util.remove_anim(summer_android)
	summer_android.Position = pivot_pos + vector(-8, 0, -1)

	--obj 위치에 wall_tube_flag 오브젝트 생성
	--pivot_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(flag, active_state_type.enabled)
end

function local_class:unsetting_run()
	local flag = self.object.run_flag()
	--obj 제거.
	field_object_util.set_active_state(flag, active_state_type.disabled)
end

function local_class:cleaning_scene()
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.cleaning_pos()

	local instructor = self.npc.instructor()
	local summer_android = self.npc.summer_android()
	local succubus_noble = self.npc.succubus_noble()

	local dumpster = self.object.dumpster()
	local trash_table = {
		self.object.trash(1),
		self.object.trash(2),
		self.object.trash(3),
		self.object.trash(4),
		self.object.trash(5),
		self.object.trash(6),
	}

	--장면2

	--아래 배치로 전환, 카메라 포커스는 좌표 (30,0,-61). 카메라값 3
	local camera_pos = vector(30, 0, -61)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0)

	local trash_throw = function(trash, duration)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = trash.Position
		local end_pos = dumpster.Position + vector(0, 1.1, -0.5)
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local cur_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + end_pos * progress
			trash.Position = cur_pos
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		--obj_homeless 위로 fx_get 이펙트 출력 + 오브젝트 사라짐.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_wood_02')
		trash.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(trash, active_state_type.disabled)
		self.fx.get():Instantiate(end_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	end

	--동시 시작
	local equipping_sfx
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--비앙카가 동작 이벤트 시작 (async 아님)

				--비앙카 (down, attack, throw 1회) 하면
				scene_util.set_direction(succubus_noble, 'down', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_noble, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(succubus_noble, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
				command_util.publish_throw(succubus_noble, trash_table[1], vector(0, 0, -1), trash_table[1].Position,
						0, true)


				--머리 위 obj_homeless 오브젝트 wall_dumpster 위치로 0.3초간 이동.
				--obj_homeless 위로 fx_get 이펙트 출력 + 오브젝트 사라짐.
				trash_throw(trash_table[1], 0.3)


				--직후 비앙카 (up, attack, hold_loop) 자세로 머리 위로 obj_homeless 오브젝트 올라감 + 2번 오브젝트 사라짐
				scene_util.set_direction(succubus_noble, 'up', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_noble, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(succubus_noble, self, 'hold_loop')
				command_util.publish_holdup(succubus_noble, trash_table[2], succubus_noble.Position, 0.3, true)
				wait_for_sec(0.3)

				--비앙카 (down, attack, throw 1회) 하면 머리 위 obj_homeless 오브젝트 wall_dumpster 위치로 0.3초간 이동.
				scene_util.set_direction(succubus_noble, 'down', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_noble, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(succubus_noble, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
				command_util.publish_throw(succubus_noble, trash_table[2], vector(0, 0, -1), trash_table[2].Position,
						0, true)

				--obj_homeless 위로 fx_get 이펙트 출력 + 오브젝트 사라짐.
				trash_throw(trash_table[2], 0.3)


				--직후 비앙카 (up, attack, hold_loop) 자세로 머리 위로 obj_homeless 오브젝트 올라감 + 3번 오브젝트 사라짐
				scene_util.set_direction(succubus_noble, 'up', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_noble, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(succubus_noble, self, 'hold_loop')
				command_util.publish_holdup(succubus_noble, trash_table[3], succubus_noble.Position, 0.3, true)
				wait_for_sec(0.3)

				--비앙카 (down, attack, throw 1회) 하면 머리 위 obj_homeless 오브젝트 wall_dumpster 위치로 0.3초간 이동.
				scene_util.set_direction(succubus_noble, 'down', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_noble, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(succubus_noble, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
				command_util.publish_throw(succubus_noble, trash_table[3], vector(0, 0, -1), trash_table[3].Position,
						0, true)

				--obj_homeless 위로 fx_get 이펙트 출력 + 오브젝트 사라짐.
				trash_throw(trash_table[3], 0.3)

				--마지막엔 비앙카 (down, idle, idle) 자세로 전환
				scene_util.set_direction(succubus_noble, 'down', false)
			end,
			function()
				--위 이벤트 시작 1초 뒤 AA72 동작 이벤트 시작
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--AA72 (right, attack, hold_loop) 자세로 머리 위로 obj_homeless 오브젝트 올라간 상태 + 4번 오브젝트 사라짐
				scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(summer_android, self, 'hold_loop')
				command_util.publish_holdup(summer_android, trash_table[4], summer_android.Position, 0.3, true)
				wait_for_sec(0.3)

				--AA72 (right, attack, throw 1회) 하면 머리 위 obj_homeless 오브젝트 wall_dumpster 위치로 0.6초간 이동.
				scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(summer_android, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
				command_util.publish_throw(summer_android, trash_table[4], vector(1, 0, 0), trash_table[4].Position,
						0, true)

				trash_throw(trash_table[4], 0.6)

				--AA72 (left, attack, eat) 지속
				equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

				scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(summer_android, self, 'eat')
			end
	)

	--비앙카 동작 이벤트가 끝나면 즉시 종료 후 다음 연출 진행.

	--동시 시작
	do
		--화면 shake (0.3, 0.3)
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

		--비앙카 (down, smile, cast)
		scene_util.set_direction(succubus_noble, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_noble, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(succubus_noble, self, 'cast')

		--AA72 (right, surprise, idle) jump 1회
		scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.remove_anim(summer_android)
		character_util.normal_jump(summer_android,'01_small_jump_01')

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(equipping_sfx)

		--교관 (right, idle, release 2회) : 해변 청소 훈련은 비앙카 연수생 1등…!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_yuze_whistle_01')
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(instructor, self, 'right',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, { key = 'mm_bootcamp_main_s5_88', viewport_pos = vector(0.25, 0.5) })
	end

	--AA72 (right, tired, idle) + annoyed  이모티콘
	scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'tired')
	character_util.remove_anim(summer_android)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(summer_android, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'annoyed')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--obj_homeless 오브젝트 제거
	self:progress_states(self.states.scout)
	self:scout_scene()
end

					self.sa_balloon_item = nil
				end
			end,
			function()
				--비앙카 (left, attack, bow_idle, 아직 물풍선 들고있음) 상태로 jump 1회
				scene_util.set_direction(succubus_noble, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_noble, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(succubus_noble, self, 'bow_idle')

				local sn_balloon_item_sync_routine = true
				local balloon_diff = self.sn_balloon_item.Position - succubus_noble.Position

				start_coroutine(function()
					while sn_balloon_item_sync_routine do
						local jump_height = succubus_noble.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform.localPosition
						self.sn_balloon_item.Position = balloon_diff + succubus_noble.Position + jump_height
						coroutine.yield(nil)
					end
				end)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

				--높이 1.5 / 시간 0.7
				local time_passed = 0
				local duration = 0.7
				local height = 1.5
				local start_pos = succubus_noble.Position
				while time_passed < duration do
					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					local progress = time_passed / duration
					local y = math.sin(math.pi * 0.5 * progress) * height
					local pos = start_pos + vector(0, y, 0)

					character_util.set_position(succubus_noble, pos, true)
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				sn_balloon_item_sync_routine = false
			end
	)


	--동시 시작
	do
		--비앙카 (left, attack, gauntlet_boong_attack 1회)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(succubus_noble, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_noble, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(succubus_noble, self, { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack', count = 1 })

		--비앙카 손의 물풍선 아이템 아래 이미지처럼 일직선으로 AA72 위치까지 0.3초간 이동
		local start_pos = self.sn_balloon_item.Position
		local end_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(summer_android.Bounds.center) + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 0.3
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = time_passed / duration

			local cur_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + end_pos * progress

			self.sn_balloon_item.Position = cur_pos

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.sn_balloon_item.Position = end_pos
	end

	--동시 시작
	do
		local org_sa_pos = summer_android.Position

		--물풍선 아이템 AA72 위치 도착하면 AA72 위로 fx_boss_waterball_explosion 출력.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_03')
		self.fx.waterball_explosion():Instantiate(org_sa_pos)

		if self.sn_balloon_item ~= nil then
			quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.sn_balloon_item)
			self.sn_balloon_item = nil
		end

		self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(org_sa_pos)

		--AA72 위로 fx_lasthit 출력

		--AA72 (right, damagad, damaged2) 캐릭터 shake (0.1, 0.3)
		scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(summer_android, self, 'damaged2')
		character_util.shake(summer_android, 0.1, 0.3)

		--이후 0.3초간 비앙카 y값 0까지 내려옴
		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 0.3
		local height = 1.5
		local end_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(succubus_noble.Position, 0)
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local y = math.sin(math.pi * 0.5 + math.pi * 0.5 * progress) * height
			local pos = end_pos + vector(0, y, 0)

			character_util.set_position(succubus_noble, pos, true)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.set_position(succubus_noble, end_pos, false)

		--이후 AA72 (right, tired, hurt)로 전환
		scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(summer_android, self, 'hurt')

	end

	--동시 시작

	--화면 shake (0.3, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	--교관 (down, idle, release 2회) : [shout] 비앙카 연수생 승리다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_yuze_whistle_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(instructor, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2, sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false }, nil, 'mm_bootcamp_main_s5_91')

	--비앙카 (left, smile, success)
	scene_util.set_direction(succubus_noble, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_noble, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(succubus_noble, self, 'success')

	--AA72 (right, tired, hurt)
	scene_util.set_direction(summer_android, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(summer_android, self, 'hurt')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(summer_android, self, 'right',
			nil, nil, 'annoyed')

	self:progress_states(self.states.boong)
	self:boong_scene()
end

function local_class:boong_scene()
	--교관 위치 기준
	local pivot_pos = self.marker.boong_pos()

	local instructor = self.npc.instructor()
	local summer_android = self.npc.summer_android()
	local succubus_noble = self.npc.succubus_noble()
	--장면 5

	--화면 즉시 페이드 인 되며 아래 배치로 전환, 카메라 포커스 교관, 카메라값 3
	local camera_pos = pivot_pos
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0)

	--동시 시작
	do
		local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

		--AA72 속도 4, run 자세, attack 표정으로 2.5타일 우측 이동
		character_util.remove_anim(summer_android)
		wp_util.move(summer_android, summer_android.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0), 4, nil, { run = true })

		--비앙카 속도 4, run 자세, attack 표정으로 2.5타일 좌측 이동
		character_util.remove_anim(succubus_noble)
		wp_util.move_async(succubus_noble, succubus_noble.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0), 4, nil, { run = true })

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(dash_sfx)
	end

	do
		--동시 시작 / timescale 0.5 적용 / 아래 연출 리얼타임 2초간 진행.
		local time_scale = 0.5
		local time_mod_key = 's5_boong_time_mod'
		time_util.mod(time_mod_key, time_scale)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')

		--AA72 (right, attack, prostrate) 자세로 전환하며 포물선, 최대 높이 1까지 올라가며 깃발 위치까지 이동.
		scene_util.set_emotion(summer_android, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(summer_android, self, 'prostrate')
		character_util.jump_move(summer_android, summer_android.Position + vector(2, 0, 0)
		, 2, 1, false, 'right')

		--비앙카 (left, attack, prostrate) 자세로 전환하며 포물선, 최대 높이 1까지 올라가며 깃발 위치까지 이동.
		scene_util.set_emotion(succubus_noble, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(succubus_noble, self, 'prostrate')
		character_util.jump_move(succubus_noble, succubus_noble.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0)
		, 2, 1, false, 'left')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		time_util.unmod(time_mod_key)
	end

	--화면 0초만에 즉시 페이드 아웃
	self.controller:custom_fade_out_stage_music('event',3)
	local somewhere_dark = vector(666, 0, 666)
	camera_util.move_async(somewhere_dark, 0)

	--동시 시작

	--검은 화면에 말풍선 출력

	--위치 x (0) y (0)
	--말풍선 크기 1.25배
	--교관 : [shout] 스텔라, 비앙카 공동 1등!
	--화면 shake (0.1, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(instructor, 'mm_bootcamp_main_s5_93_1', false, {
		viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.5),
		scale = 1.25
	})

	--1초간 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--장면 몽타주 종료.
	self:progress_states(self.states.cross_arm)
	self:cross_arm_scene()
end

function local_class:item_move_curve(item, target_pos, height, speed, duration, rotation_num, frame_action)
	local start_pos = item.Position
	local distance = vector_util.distance(start_pos, target_pos)
	local to_duration = 0

	if type_util.is_number(speed) then
		to_duration = distance / speed
	elseif type_util.is_number(duration) then
		to_duration = duration
	end

	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(to_duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
		local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		local lerp_pos = cur_value + vector(0, h, 0)

		item.Position = lerp_pos

		local rotate_progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, progress)
		local cur_rotation = rotate_progress * 360 * rotation_num

		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.back)
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.back)

		if type_util.is_function(frame_action) then
			frame_action(progress, cur_value)
		end
	end)
end

end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.npc.instructor() },
	})

	self.controller:set_light_night()
end

function local_class:start()
	local is_create
	is_create, self.place_controller = global_table_util.try_get_character_place_controller()
	self:setting_interactable()
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.firing_firework = false
	self.play_firing_sfx = false

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local instructor = self.npc.instructor()
	local succubus_noble = self.npc.succubus_noble()

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, instructor) or
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, succubus_noble) then

		sp_util.start_scene(self.ending, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's7_goal_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.in_ending
		sp_util.start_scene(self.ending, self)
	end
end

function local_class:setting_interactable()
	local instructor = self.npc.instructor()
	local succubus_noble = self.npc.succubus_noble()

	character_util.add_listener(instructor, self)
	character_util.add_listener(succubus_noble, self)
end

				--교관 (up,idle, release 2회)

			delay = 0.5,
			scale = 1.125,
			sfx = nil
		},
		{

			pos = self.marker.firework(1),
			delay = 0.8,
			scale = 1,
			sfx = '01_firework_03'
		},
		{
			effect = self.fx.fire_work_4(),
			pos = self.marker.firework(5),
			delay = 0.2,
			scale = 1,
			sfx = '01_firework_03'
		},
		{
			effect = self.fx.fire_work_3(),
			pos = self.marker.firework(2),
			delay = 0.2,
			scale = 1,
			sfx = nil
		},
		{
			effect = self.fx.fire_work_2(),
			pos = self.marker.firework(4),
			delay = 0.2,
			scale = 1,
			sfx = nil
		},
		{
			effect = self.fx.fire_work_1(),
			pos = self.marker.firework(6),
			delay = 0.1,
			scale = 0.75,
			sfx = '01_firework_03'
		},
		{
			effect = self.fx.fire_work_3(),
			pos = self.marker.firework(7),
			delay = 0.8,
			scale = 1,
			sfx = nil
		},
		{
			effect = self.fx.fire_work_1(),
			pos = self.marker.firework(9),
			delay = 0.2,
			scale = 0.75,
			sfx = '01_firework_03'
		},
		{
			effect = self.fx.fire_work_4(),
			pos = self.marker.firework(10),
			delay = 0.2,
			scale = 1,
			sfx = '01_firework_03'
		},
		{
			effect = self.fx.fire_work_2(),
			pos = self.marker.firework(12),
			delay = 0.2,
			scale = 0.75,
			sfx = nil
		},
		{
			effect = self.fx.fire_work_3(),
			pos = self.marker.firework(13),
			delay = 0.2,
			scale = 1,
			sfx = nil
		},
		{
			effect = self.fx.fire_work_1(),
			pos = self.marker.firework(8),
			delay = 0.5,
			scale = 1,
			sfx = '01_firework_03'
		},
		{
			effect = self.fx.fire_work_2(),
			pos = self.marker.firework(11),
			delay = 0.3,
			scale = 1,
			sfx = nil
		}
	}
	while self.firing_firework do
		for i = 1, #firework_table do
			local firework = firework_table[i]
			wait_for_sec(firework.delay)
			if not self.firing_firework then
				return
			end

			if firework.sfx ~= nil and self.play_firing_sfx then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(firework.sfx)
			end

			local firework_effect = firework.effect:Instantiate(firework.pos)
			firework_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(firework.scale, firework.scale, firework.scale)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

return local_class
